papers.title: Polariton BECs: Theory and Concepts
papers.abstract: Polaritons are a superposition of light and matter, that combine Strong Interferences (of light) with Weak Interactions (of excitons), making them WISI (Weakly-Interacting, Strongly-Interfering) particles. Their condensation is the main highlight of a field which occupies a unique position at the intersection of quantum optics, condensed matter physics and nonlinear dynamics of driven, dissipative systems. This chapter surveys selected theoretical concepts of polariton condensates' formation, coherence and dynamics, with an emphasis on their distinctions from their atomic counterparts and on points of ongoing controversy. We argue that linear and non-interacting effects are undervalued in polariton physics, and that a significant part of the phenomenology -- including bosonic correlations and coherence buildup -- can often be understood without invoking strong interactions or genuine quantum effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：survey（综述）、theoretical concepts（理论概念）、argue（论证）。；研究对象：极化激元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Polariton BECs），具体为光与物质叠加形成的弱相互作用、强干涉（WISI）准粒子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文指出，在极化激元物理中，线性和非相互作用效应常被低估；许多现象（包括玻色子关联和相干性建立）无需借助强相互作用或真正的量子效应即可理解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文指出，在极化激元物理中，线性和非相互作用效应常被低估；许多现象（包括玻色子关联和相干性建立）无需借助强相互作用或真正的量子效应即可理解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但强调了对“线性与非相互作用效应被低估”这一观点的论证，以及对当前领域争议点的梳理。
papers.method_zh: 理论综述与概念分析，对比极化激元凝聚体与原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的区别，并聚焦于形成、相干性和动力学中的争议点。

papers.title: The fractal dimension of Brownian dynamics in liquids
papers.abstract: The classical Einstein-Langevin theory of Brownian motion assumes a memoryless thermal bath, establishing a universal fractal dimension of $d_v = 3/2$ for the velocity fluctuations of a particle. In this Letter, we demonstrate experimentally and theoretically that fluid-inertial memory effects fundamentally redefine the fractal scaling of these fluctuations. In analyzing highly resolved measurements of Brownian microspheres in liquids, we show that the non-Markovian hydrodynamic thermal noise establishes a distinct velocity fractal dimension of $d_v = 7/4$. Coupled with theoretical analysis of non-equilibrium short-time dynamics and the initial scaling of the velocity autocorrelation function, this result establishes the non-equilibrium universality class of Brownian motion in fluid media possessing a finite non-vanishing density.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate experimentally and theoretically”，并涉及“highly resolved measurements”和“theoretical analysis”。；研究对象：液体中布朗粒子的速度涨落动力学，具体为流体惯性记忆效应对布朗运动分形维数的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 流体惯性记忆效应（非马尔可夫流体热噪声）将布朗粒子速度涨落的分形维数从经典爱因斯坦-朗之万理论预测的 \( d_v = 3/2 \) 重新定义为 \( d_v = 7/4 \)，确立了有限密度流体介质中布朗运动的非平衡普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：流体惯性记忆效应（非马尔可夫流体热噪声）将布朗粒子速度涨落的分形维数从经典爱因斯坦-朗之万理论预测的 \( d_v = 3/2 \) 重新定义为 \( d_v = 7/4 \)，确立了有限密度流体介质中布朗运动的非平衡普适类。；创新点：首次揭示流体惯性记忆效应从根本上改变了布朗运动速度涨落的分形标度，将经典无记忆热浴假设下的普适分形维数修正为新的非马尔可夫普适值。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨率实验测量液体中布朗微球的速度涨落，并结合非平衡短时动力学理论分析以及速度自相关函数的初始标度行为。

papers.title: Brownian motion: non-equilibrium states from equilibrium trajectories -- recovering hydrodynamic regimes from prepared displacement measurements
papers.abstract: Owing to the Chapman-Kolmogorov equation for Markovian dynamics,any equilibrium trajectory of a Brownian particle in a solvent fluid can be viewed as the superposition of an uncountable number of non-equilibrium states. This property permits the unraveling of fine details of fluid-particle interactions at microscales defined by its non-equilibrium properties from the analysis of a single Brownian trajectory and to connect them to the hydrodynamics of the solvent fluid, simply considering the lower-order (second) moments of particle position in trapped conditions. In this way, the acceleration due to thermal-hydrodynamic fluctuational forces is isolated from the other factors and the short-time displacement statistics is completely determined by the correlation properties of the fluctuational thermal-hydrodynamic force. This approach not only confirms the $t^{5/2}$-law obtained by Boynewicz et al. (2026), related to fluid inertial effects, but indicates that this scaling may be superseded by a $t^4$-scaling at very short times once the correlated nature of the stochastic forcings is taken into account. The latter result is related to the regularity properties of particle velocity realizations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Chapman-Kolmogorov equation”“Markovian dynamics”“理论框架”等关键词，未涉及具体实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：布朗粒子在溶剂流体中的布朗运动，特别是流体-粒子相互作用在微观尺度上的非平衡态特性，以及与之相关的流体动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分析单个布朗粒子的平衡轨迹，可以提取出非平衡态信息，并揭示流体惯性效应导致的短时位移统计规律：除了已知的 \( t^{5/2} \) 标度律，在极短时间尺度上，考虑随机力的关联性后，可能出现 \( t^4 \) 标度律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分析单个布朗粒子的平衡轨迹，可以提取出非平衡态信息，并揭示流体惯性效应导致的短时位移统计规律：除了已知的 \( t^{5/2} \) 标度律，在极短时间尺度上，考虑随机力的关联性后，可能出现 \( t^4 \) 标度律。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于马尔可夫过程的Chapman-Kolmogorov方程，利用平衡轨迹叠加非平衡态的理论框架，通过分析粒子在束缚条件下的低阶（二阶）位移矩，分离热-流体动力学涨落力的贡献，并研究短时位移统计与涨落力关联性质的关系。

papers.title: Near-degenerate competing magnetic orders in EuAgAs: a tunable route to altermagnetism
papers.abstract: Altermagnets (AMs) have recently emerged as a distinct magnetic class bridging central features of ferromagnets (FMs) and antiferromagnets (AFMs), offering new opportunities for spin-based electronics. While they possess zero net magnetization like collinear AFMs, they simultaneously exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting long thought exclusive to FMs. Despite intense theoretical interest, experimentally accessible materials hosting both altermagnetism and nontrivial band topology remain scarce. EuAgAs, crystallizing in space group $P6_3/mmc$, was previously identified via density functional theory (DFT) as a bulk altermagnetic Dirac semimetal. Contrary to these predictions, our neutron diffraction experiments reveal that the bulk ground state adopts a $\mathbf{q} = (0,0,\tfrac{1}{2})$ AFM structure with an in-plane $\uparrow\uparrow\downarrow\downarrow$ spin sequence. Systematic DFT calculations, however, uncover a remarkable near-degeneracy among competing magnetic orders: the FM and AM configurations lie only $0.11$ and $0.40~\text{meV/f.u.}$ above the AFM ground state, respectively. We further show that while a simple Heisenberg model favors a spin-spiral ground state, the inclusion of non-Heisenberg biquadratic coupling stabilizes the observed commensurate AFM phase. This near-degeneracy renders the magnetic state highly tunable, with DFT predicting a transition to the altermagnetic phase under hydrostatic pressure at approximately $14 \text{ GPa}$, establishing EuAgAs as a controllable platform for accessing topological altermagnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时提及“中子衍射实验”（neutron diffraction experiments）和“密度泛函理论计算”（DFT calculations）。；研究对象：EuAgAs 化合物（空间群 P6₃/mmc），具体研究其基态磁有序结构、竞争磁序（铁磁、反铁磁、交变磁）的简并性，以及压力诱导的交变磁相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中子衍射实验表明 EuAgAs 的基态为面内 ↑↑↓↓ 自旋序列的反铁磁结构（q=(0,0,1/2)），而非此前理论预测的交变磁态；但 DFT 计算揭示铁磁和交变磁态与反铁磁基态能量仅相差 0.11 和 0.40 meV/f.u.，这种近简并性使得磁态高度可调，约 14 GPa 静水压下可转变为交变磁相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中子衍射实验表明 EuAgAs 的基态为面内 ↑↑↓↓ 自旋序列的反铁磁结构（q=(0,0,1/2)），而非此前理论预测的交变磁态；但 DFT 计算揭示铁磁和交变磁态与反铁磁基态能量仅相差 0.11 和 0.40 meV/f.u.，这种近简并性使得磁态高度可调，约 14 GPa 静水压下可转变为交变磁相。；创新点：实验推翻了此前 DFT 对 EuAgAs 基态为交变磁半金属的预测，揭示了其基态为竞争磁序近简并体系，并指出通过压力可调控至拓扑交变磁态，为实验实现可调谐的交变磁材料提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 中子衍射实验确定磁结构；DFT 计算（密度泛函理论）评估不同磁序的相对能量；海森堡模型与双二次非海森堡耦合（biquadratic coupling）分析磁基态稳定性。

papers.title: Acoustic spin resonance in polariton condensates
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate acoustic spin resonance in a spatially homogeneous spinor polariton condensate. A longitudinal acoustic wave generates a time-periodic strain-induced effective magnetic field acting on the condensate pseudospin. When this field is transverse to the static in-plane linear-polarization splitting, it resonantly drives polarization oscillations. We show that spin-dependent interactions shift the resonance and produce nonlinear line shapes, while gain, reservoir dynamics, and spin relaxation make the response dissipative and history-dependent, producing amplitude hysteresis. In the presence of lifetime anisotropy, the condensate can develop a bifurcated stationary state with finite circular polarization, and a resonant acoustic drive can switch between the corresponding out-of-plane branches. A Zeeman splitting provides an additional conservative knob for tuning the resonance frequency. Our results identify coherent acoustic driving as a route to resonant, nonlinear, and switchable control of polariton pseudospin dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically investigate”“We show”“Our results identify”等理论分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：自旋极化激元凝聚体中的声学自旋共振现象。具体体系为空间均匀的自旋子极化激元凝聚体（spinor polariton condensate），研究声波驱动的自旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纵向声波通过应变诱导的有效磁场，可共振驱动极化激元凝聚体的自旋振荡；自旋依赖相互作用导致共振频移和非线性线型，增益与弛豫过程引入耗散和迟滞效应；寿命各向异性可产生分叉稳态，声驱动可实现面外极化分支的开关切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纵向声波通过应变诱导的有效磁场，可共振驱动极化激元凝聚体的自旋振荡；自旋依赖相互作用导致共振频移和非线性线型，增益与弛豫过程引入耗散和迟滞效应；寿命各向异性可产生分叉稳态，声驱动可实现面外极化分支的开关切换。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心新意在于提出利用相干声波驱动（而非传统光驱动或磁场驱动）实现对极化激元赝自旋动力学的共振、非线性及可开关控制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于自旋子极化激元凝聚体的赝自旋模型，引入声波产生的时变应变诱导有效磁场，考虑自旋依赖相互作用、增益、粒子库动力学、自旋弛豫、寿命各向异性及塞曼分裂等效应，解析和半解析地研究共振驱动下的极化振荡行为。

papers.title: Universal Magnetic Structure Prediction from Atomic Coordinates with Near-Experimental Accuracy
papers.abstract: Magnetic order is a fundamental property of materials, governing collective behavior and enabling a broad range of functionalities. Yet magnetic structure remains difficult to determine: experiments are costly and specialized, while first-principles methods often struggle with the noncollinear and incommensurate orders found in real materials. Here we introduce magnetic structure network (MSN), an E(3) equivariant graph neural network that predicts both collinear and non-collinear magnetic structures directly from atomic crystal structures, trained directly on experimentally determined structures from MAGNDATA. By proposing the primitive modulated structure representation (PMSR), we are able to encode commensurate and incommensurate structures in a unified way without symmetry assumptions. The model achieves strong performance across all modulation components and reconstructs experimental magnetic structures with high fidelity. Our approach provides a scalable framework for rapid magnetic structure prediction and opens a route to data-driven discovery of magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：graph neural network、prediction、trained on experimentally determined structures。；研究对象：磁性材料中的磁结构，包括共线（collinear）和非共线（non-collinear）磁序，以及公度（commensurate）和非公度（incommensurate）磁结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为磁结构网络（MSN）的E(3)等变图神经网络，能够直接从原子晶体结构预测磁结构，其预测精度接近实验水平。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为磁结构网络（MSN）的E(3)等变图神经网络，能够直接从原子晶体结构预测磁结构，其预测精度接近实验水平。；创新点：提出了原始调制结构表示（PMSR），首次实现了对公度与非公度磁结构的统一编码，无需依赖对称性假设，从而能够直接预测非共线和非公度磁序。
papers.method_zh: 采用E(3)等变图神经网络（MSN），并引入原始调制结构表示（PMSR），将公度与非公度磁结构统一编码，无需对称性假设。模型直接在MAGNDATA数据库中的实验测定磁结构上进行训练。

papers.title: Lattice Relaxation Flattens Chern Bands in Rhombohedral Graphene Stacks
papers.abstract: Motivated by recent observations of integer and fractional Chern insulators in rhombohedral graphene stacks aligned with hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), we propose and study a model in which the moiré potential is defined by the pattern of layer-shear strain fields produced by lattice relaxation in these heterostructures. Although these strain fields decrease exponentially with the number of layers, their imprints on electrons residing away from the contact layer are non-negligible. In the absence of a displacement field, lattice relaxation effects amplify the electronic differences among the two different stackings with hBN. These differences, although attenuated at the single-electron level, survive in the so-called moiré-distant regime and are further enhanced with the inclusion of electron interactions. We find that lattice relaxation plays a crucial role in flattening and isolating a valley-polarized Hartree-Fock electron band with $|C|=1$ Chern number. Our results challenge the conventional wisdom on moiré effects in these heterostructures by illustrating the intertwined effects of long-range Coulomb interactions and lattice relaxation, and opens the door to explore different regimes of twist angles and displacement fields for the search for topological states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“propose and study a model”（提出并研究模型），并采用Hartree-Fock方法计算电子能带结构。；研究对象：菱方石墨烯与六方氮化硼（hBN）对齐堆叠形成的异质结中的莫尔超晶格体系，具体关注晶格弛豫产生的层间剪切应变场对拓扑电子态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 晶格弛豫效应在菱方石墨烯/hBN异质结中起到关键作用：它能够使一个谷极化的、具有|C|=1陈数的Hartree-Fock电子能带变得平坦且孤立，从而支持整数和分数量子陈绝缘体的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：晶格弛豫效应在菱方石墨烯/hBN异质结中起到关键作用：它能够使一个谷极化的、具有|C|=1陈数的Hartree-Fock电子能带变得平坦且孤立，从而支持整数和分数量子陈绝缘体的出现。；创新点：挑战了传统上认为莫尔效应仅由hBN与石墨烯的晶格失配决定的观点，揭示了长程库仑相互作用与晶格弛豫效应相互交织的关键作用，并指出远离接触层的电子仍会受到弛豫应变场的非可忽略影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值计算：构建由异质结中晶格弛豫产生的层间剪切应变场定义的莫尔势模型；采用Hartree-Fock方法计算包含长程库仑相互作用的电子能带结构。

papers.title: Bridging Atomistic Simulation and Experimental Processing Timescales with Goal-Directed Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Atomic-scale modeling has advanced rapidly through integration of machine learning, yet a key bottleneck remains. Even with an accurate potential energy surface and a clear target material, we still lack a practical atomistic dynamics framework that can simulate how materials form under realistic synthesis and processing conditions. Many processing transformations are governed by rare events in non-idealized evolving environments, while direct molecular dynamics is limited by femtosecond timesteps and short accessible trajectories. Existing acceleration methods often require prior mechanistic knowledge, including reaction coordinates, collective variables, event tables, or pathway guesses, which is rarely available in real experiments. Here we present an E(3)-equivariant deep reinforcement learning framework that enables goal-directed pathway discovery without hand-crafted reaction coordinates. The framework introduces a complementary operating mode for atomistic simulation in which realistic, non-idealized environments can be addressed directly while retaining kinetic plausibility through barrier-aware rewards. As a challenging benchmark, we target silicon dry oxidation, where rare-event pathways in amorphous SiO2 are effectively inaccessible to conventional atomistic methods. We treat an O2 molecule as an agent that performs continuous rigid-body translations and rotations in a Si/a-SiO2 environment. The agent is trained with an episode-level objective that rewards verified O2 dissociation while preferring low effective activation barriers. We demonstrate that the learned policy discovers kinetically favorable O2 diffusion and dissociation pathways in a disordered Si/a-SiO2 environment, progressively improving success rate while reducing effective activation barriers over training. We also discuss how the approach can be generalized to other processing and synthesis problems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“atomic-scale modeling”、“machine learning”、“deep reinforcement learning”、“atomistic simulation”。；研究对象：硅的干法氧化过程（silicon dry oxidation），具体研究O₂分子在Si/a-SiO₂（晶体硅/非晶二氧化硅）界面环境中的扩散与解离路径。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过E(3)等变深度强化学习框架，无需预先定义反应坐标或集体变量，即可在非理想化、无序的Si/a-SiO₂环境中自主发现动力学上有利的O₂扩散和解离路径，并随着训练逐步提高成功率、降低有效激活势垒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过E(3)等变深度强化学习框架，无需预先定义反应坐标或集体变量，即可在非理想化、无序的Si/a-SiO₂环境中自主发现动力学上有利的O₂扩散和解离路径，并随着训练逐步提高成功率、降低有效激活势垒。；创新点：提出了一种无需手工设计反应坐标或先验机理知识的原子模拟动力学框架，能够直接处理非理想化、演化的环境，并保留动力学合理性，填补了原子尺度模拟与实际合成/加工时间尺度之间的鸿沟。
papers.method_zh: E(3)等变深度强化学习框架。将O₂分子视为智能体（agent），在Si/a-SiO₂环境中执行连续刚体平移和旋转动作；采用基于回合（episode）的目标函数，奖励验证过的O₂解离事件，并偏好低有效激活势垒；通过势垒感知的奖励函数保持动力学合理性。

papers.title: An agitated oscillator chain
papers.abstract: We study how the stationary dynamics of an oscillator chain is modified when coupled to a bath of run-and-tumble particles. First, assuming time-scale separation, we derive the induced Langevin chain dynamics with explicit expressions for the streaming term, friction coefficient, and noise amplitude. At high persistence of the run-and-tumble particle bath, the linear friction turns negative, creating an instability. Second, we find that this anti-damping is arrested at long times due to nonlinear effects, reminiscent of a Rayleigh oscillator. We conclude that a passive harmonic chain can be transformed by its coupling to active matter into a self-sustained fluctuating medium with many-body Rayleigh-like dynamics. That transfer of activity results in pulsations of the displacements, spatial oscillations, and the emergence of persistence in velocities along the chain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive（推导）、Langevin chain dynamics（朗之万链动力学）、theoretical framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：耦合了“run-and-tumble particles”（跑停粒子）浴的谐振子链（oscillator chain）的稳态动力学，属于活性物质驱动的非平衡统计物理系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 被动谐振子链通过与活性粒子浴耦合，可转变为具有多体瑞利振荡器类动力学的自持涨落介质，表现为位移脉动、空间振荡以及链上速度持续性的涌现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：被动谐振子链通过与活性粒子浴耦合，可转变为具有多体瑞利振荡器类动力学的自持涨落介质，表现为位移脉动、空间振荡以及链上速度持续性的涌现。；创新点：揭示了被动谐振子链通过耦合活性浴实现从被动到自持振荡行为的转变，并指出该活性转移导致链上出现多体瑞利类动力学，摘要未突出说明与已有活性物质耦合链模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用时间尺度分离假设，推导了诱导的朗之万链动力学，给出了流项、摩擦系数和噪声振幅的显式表达式；通过分析高持久性下线性摩擦变负导致的失稳，以及非线性效应在长时间尺度上对反阻尼的抑制，类比瑞利振荡器进行理论分析。

papers.title: Rapid Atmospheric Vapor Deposition of H:In2O3 Transparent Conducting Oxide Thin Films
papers.abstract: Transparent conducting oxides (TCOs) are essential for the optoelectronics industry, but there is a critical gap in cost-effective methods to rapidly deposit low sheet resistance, high transmittance films without damaging delicate materials, including emerging soft semiconductors like metal-halide perovskites. In this work, atmospheric pressure chemical vapor deposition (AP-CVD) is used to synthesise H:In2O3 films with 7.20+/-0.01 Ohm/sq sheet resistance (0.50+/-0.06 mOhm.cm resistivity) and transmittance up to 89% in the near-infrared (NIR), surpassing commercial sputter-deposited indium tin oxide. The growth rate is 40x higher than atomic layer deposition (ALD), and the AP-CVD films are fully processed under atmospheric conditions at only 140 C. Comparison of secondary ion mass spectrometry and time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis with changes in carrier concentration indicate that H dopants are introduced from the water oxidant. There is an increase in mobility form 40+/-10 cm2/Vs to 160+/-30 cm2/Vs when changing from O2 to H2O as the oxidant, which is attributed to H dopants passivating oxygen vacancies that act as carrier scattering centers. This work establishes AP-CVD as a promising method for manufacturing high figure-of-merit TCOs in a rapid, scalable and cost-effective manner, using mild growth conditions compatible with thermally-sensitive materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验合成（AP-CVD）、表征（SIMS、TOF-ERDA）和性能测试（电阻率、透光率、迁移率）。；研究对象：氢掺杂氧化铟（H:In2O3）透明导电氧化物薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用大气压化学气相沉积（AP-CVD）在140°C低温下快速制备的H:In2O3薄膜，其近红外透光率（89%）和电阻率（0.50 mOhm·cm）优于商业溅射氧化铟锡（ITO），且生长速率比原子层沉积（ALD）快40倍。氢掺杂剂来自水氧化剂，通过钝化氧空位散射中心将迁移率从40 cm²/Vs提升至160 cm²/Vs。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用大气压化学气相沉积（AP-CVD）在140°C低温下快速制备的H:In2O3薄膜，其近红外透光率（89%）和电阻率（0.50 mOhm·cm）优于商业溅射氧化铟锡（ITO），且生长速率比原子层沉积（ALD）快40倍。氢掺杂剂来自水氧化剂，通过钝化氧空位散射中心将迁移率从40 cm²/Vs提升至160 cm²/Vs。；创新点：首次在仅140°C的大气条件下，利用AP-CVD实现兼具低方阻（7.20 Ohm/sq）、高近红外透光率（89%）和超高生长速率的H:In2O3薄膜沉积，且工艺与热敏感材料（如金属卤化物钙钛矿）兼容，解决了低成本快速制备高性能TCO的瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 大气压化学气相沉积（AP-CVD）合成薄膜；二次离子质谱（SIMS）和飞行时间弹性反冲探测分析（TOF-ERDA）表征氢掺杂来源与浓度；通过载流子浓度变化关联分析掺杂机制；对比O2和H2O作为氧化剂时的迁移率变化。

papers.title: Staggering domino-like blast front motion in a one-dimensional cold gas
papers.abstract: One-dimensional alternating particle systems are widely used to study interconnections between the hydrodynamics of blast waves in a gas-like medium and the Newtonian dynamics of its corpuscular constituents. We study the model in which point particles with masses $m,μ, m,μ,\dots, (m\geqμ)$ are distributed on the positive half-line $\mathbb{R}_{+}$. Their dynamics are initiated by giving a positive velocity to the leftmost particle; in its course, the particles undergo elastic collisions. For this model with $m/μ=2$, it has previously been established that the dynamics that start from random initial positions are consistent with predictions based on Euler's hydrodynamic equation. In particular, they have the following properties: (i) the position of the rightmost particle (shock front) evolves as $t^δ$ with $δ<1$; (ii) recoiled particles behind the front enter the negative half-axis; (iii) particles with locations $x\leq0$ move ballistically and eventually take over the total energy of the system. In this paper, we present numerical and analytical results for the dynamics of this model with nonrandom (typically equidistant) initial positions and various values of $m/μ$. For $m/μ=2$ and equidistant initial positions, our results qualitatively agree with those just mentioned. At the same time, we found an infinite family of numbers $\{\mathcal{M}_k\}$ such that, for $m/μ=\mathcal{M}_k$, the hydrodynamic behavior mentioned changes drastically to the following. At each moment, only a single triplet $m,μ, m$ is in motion, whereas all other particles are at rest. As a result, the shock front moves ballistically with an average velocity equal to the initial one. Such a `staggering domino-like' picture is obtained as an exact solution, which yields, in particular, explicit formulas for $\mathcal{M}_k$ and the particle velocities and positions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值分析）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“numerical and analytical results”、“exact solution”、“explicit formulas”。；研究对象：一维冷气体中激波阵面的动力学行为，具体为质量交替排列（m, μ, m, μ, …）的点粒子系统在弹性碰撞下的运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于质量比 m/μ 等于特定无穷序列 {ℳₖ} 时，系统不再呈现流体力学行为（如亚弹道传播），而是出现“交错多米诺”式运动：仅有一个三元组（m, μ, m）在运动，其余粒子静止，激波阵面以初始速度弹道传播。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于质量比 m/μ 等于特定无穷序列 {ℳₖ} 时，系统不再呈现流体力学行为（如亚弹道传播），而是出现“交错多米诺”式运动：仅有一个三元组（m, μ, m）在运动，其余粒子静止，激波阵面以初始速度弹道传播。；创新点：发现并精确刻画了一类非随机初始位置下（通常等间距）的“交错多米诺”运动模式，该模式完全不同于已知的流体力学行为，并给出了对应的质量比序列 ℳₖ 的显式表达式。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟相结合。通过精确求解得到粒子速度与位置的显式公式，并针对不同质量比（包括 m/μ=2 及 ℳₖ 序列）进行数值分析。

papers.title: Thermal conductivity of seifertite and pyrite-type SiO$_2$: A comparative study
papers.abstract: Thermal conductivity is a fundamental material property that plays a crucial role in understanding the dynamics and evolution of planetary interiors. Despite its importance, the thermal conductivity of seifertite and pyrite-type SiO$_2$ remains unknown. Here, we calculate the lattice thermal conductivities of seifertite and pyrite-type SiO$_2$ using the Green-Kubo method based on molecular dynamics (MD) simulations driven by two machine learning potentials (MLPs) constructed from the SCAN and PBEsol exchange-correlation functionals, with $\textit{ab initio}$-level accuracy. To demonstrate our methodology, we also compute thermal conductivities using the phonon quasiparticle approach for comparison. Overall, the Green-Kubo method predicts up to 119 % higher thermal conductivity with a temperature dependence close to $T^{-1}$, as it fully captures diffusion-like phonons at high temperatures that are missed by the phonon quasiparticle approach. The 19 % reduction in thermal conductivity across the phase transition from seifertite to the pyrite-type phase suggests the potential formation of a thermally insulating layer in the mantle of super-Earths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Green-Kubo方法、分子动力学模拟、机器学习势。；研究对象：Seifertite（赛弗特石）和pyrite-type（黄铁矿型）SiO₂的晶格热导率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Green-Kubo方法预测的热导率比声子准粒子方法高出最多119%，且温度依赖性接近T⁻¹；从seifertite到pyrite-type相变导致热导率降低19%，暗示超级地球地幔中可能形成热绝缘层。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Green-Kubo方法预测的热导率比声子准粒子方法高出最多119%，且温度依赖性接近T⁻¹；从seifertite到pyrite-type相变导致热导率降低19%，暗示超级地球地幔中可能形成热绝缘层。；创新点：首次计算了seifertite和pyrite-type SiO₂的未知热导率，并揭示了高温下扩散型声子对热导率的显著贡献（被声子准粒子方法遗漏）。
papers.method_zh: 基于两种机器学习势（由SCAN和PBEsol交换关联泛函构建）的分子动力学模拟，采用Green-Kubo方法计算晶格热导率；同时使用声子准粒子方法进行对比验证。

papers.title: Causation-guided mechanism identification and interpretable reduced-order modeling of damage-driving grain-boundary stress in creep
papers.abstract: Grain-boundary (GB) local stress is central to the initiation and evolution of long-term creep damage in polycrystalline superalloys. Owing to the high-dimensional nonlinear relationships between the GB stress response and multiple crystallographic, microstructural, and micromechanical characteristics, it remains challenging to identify the key characteristics governing GB stress and to elucidate their mechanisms of influence. Dislocation-climb-affected crystal-plasticity finite-element simulations of minimal grain clusters are combined with an integrated causation-guided machine-learning framework, in which mechanics-informed descriptors are analyzed by causation entropy to identify governing mechanisms and then distilled into a reduced-order regression form for interpretable prediction of GB normal stress. Among 18 physically motivated characteristics, the GB inclination angle, the slip transmission, the climb-related Schmid-type indicator, and the elastic-modulus mismatch are found to be dominant, revealing the coupled roles of interfacial geometry, crystallographic compatibility, creep stress relaxation, and micromechanical contrast. The identified characteristics hierarchy and functional representation remain effective under multiaxial loading and can be extended to tricrystal systems through physically interpretable nonlocal augmentation when a purely local description becomes insufficient, demonstrating strong physical consistency and robust generalizability across physical conditions. The extracted candidate functions also improve surrogate-model performance across multiple machine-learning model classes, providing supporting evidence for the physical relevance and efficiency of the identified representation. The proposed methods demonstrate strong potential for the development of interpretable machine-learning models and for the study of microscale nonlocal damage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：crystal-plasticity finite-element simulations、machine-learning framework、reduced-order regression）；研究对象：多晶高温合金中晶界局部应力及其对蠕变损伤的驱动机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在18种物理特征中，晶界倾角、滑移传递、攀移相关Schmid型指标和弹性模量失配是控制晶界法向应力的主导因素，揭示了界面几何、晶体学相容性、蠕变应力松弛和微力学对比的耦合作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在18种物理特征中，晶界倾角、滑移传递、攀移相关Schmid型指标和弹性模量失配是控制晶界法向应力的主导因素，揭示了界面几何、晶体学相容性、蠕变应力松弛和微力学对比的耦合作用。；创新点：提出了因果引导的机制识别与可解释降阶建模方法，在双晶和三晶体系中验证了物理一致性与泛化能力，并证明提取的候选函数可提升多种机器学习替代模型的性能。
papers.method_zh: 采用考虑位错攀移影响的晶体塑性有限元模拟（最小晶粒团簇），结合因果熵驱动的机器学习框架，对力学描述符进行因果分析以识别主导机制，并提炼为降阶回归模型用于可解释的晶界法向应力预测。

papers.title: Long-range magnetic ordering and structural phase transition in disordered high-entropy spinel chromites
papers.abstract: High-entropy spinel oxides provide an excellent platform for investigating entropy-stabilized correlated systems with strong configurational disorder. In this work, we systematically study the temperature evolution of the structural and magnetic properties of Cr-based high-entropy spinels with compositions $(Mn_{0.2}Co_{0.2}Ni_{0.2}Cu_{0.2}Zn_{0.2})Cr_2O_4$ and $(Mg_{0.2}Co_{0.2}Ni_{0.2}Cu_{0.2}Zn_{0.2})Cr_2O_4$. Our results reveal that both systems crystallize in cubic structure with space group \textit{$Fd\overline{3}m$} at room temperature. Each system undergoes antiferromagnetic ordering below the Néel temperatures $ T_N$ = 49 K and 35 K, respectively. Neutron diffraction measurements confirm the emergence of long-range magnetic order with spiral spin arrangement. Both systems exhibit a structural phase transition from cubic \textit{$Fd\overline{3}m$} to orthorhombic \textit{Fddd} symmetry at approximately 55 K and 85 K, respectively. Notably, despite the significant chemical disorder at the A site, both systems undergo transitions analogous to those observed in low entropy spinel systems. This behavior suggests that high configurational entropy may promote global structural stabilization despite local chemical disorder, thereby preserving long-range orderings and the characteristic symmetry-breaking transitions of the pristine spinel systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“neutron diffraction measurements”（中子衍射测量）等实验手段，并系统研究了结构相变和磁有序的温度演化。；研究对象：两种Cr基高熵尖晶石氧化物：(Mn₀.₂Co₀.₂Ni₀.₂Cu₀.₂Zn₀.₂)Cr₂O₄ 和 (Mg₀.₂Co₀.₂Ni₀.₂Cu₀.₂Zn₀.₂)Cr₂O₄，具体研究其结构相变和长程磁有序行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管A位存在显著化学无序，两种高熵尖晶石体系仍分别表现出与低熵尖晶石类似的反铁磁有序（奈尔温度分别为49 K和35 K）和从立方Fd3̄m到正交Fddd的结构相变（相变温度分别约为55 K和85 K），表明高构型熵可能促进全局结构稳定，从而保留长程有序和对称性破缺相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管A位存在显著化学无序，两种高熵尖晶石体系仍分别表现出与低熵尖晶石类似的反铁磁有序（奈尔温度分别为49 K和35 K）和从立方Fd3̄m到正交Fddd的结构相变（相变温度分别约为55 K和85 K），表明高构型熵可能促进全局结构稳定，从而保留长程有序和对称性破缺相变。；创新点：揭示了在强构型无序的高熵尖晶石中，长程磁有序和结构相变仍能像低熵体系一样发生，表明高熵效应并非必然破坏长程有序，反而可能通过全局结构稳定化来维持本征的对称性破缺转变。摘要未突出说明与具体理论模型的对比。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用中子衍射（neutron diffraction）确认长程磁有序的螺旋自旋排列，并结合系统的变温结构及磁性测量（摘要中未明确具体磁测量技术，但提及“systematically study the temperature evolution of structural and magnetic properties”）。

papers.title: Machine learning potential as a guide for eutectic in ultra-refractory multicomponent ceramics
papers.abstract: The experimental determination of eutectic points is a long-established and widely used technique, but it is generally only practical for systems with relatively low melting points. Many modern, promising materials, however, are ultra-refractory, with melting points exceeding 3000 K. For these systems, conventional melting experiments become prohibitively expensive and technically challenging. Advanced AI modeling can serve as a powerful precursor to guide successful experimentation in such cases. This work proposes a novel criterion for determining the eutectic point concentration in ultra-refractory alloys. The approach is verified using the Ti-B-C system - the most thoroughly studied three-component refractory system to date. The core of the algorithm is a machine-learning interatomic potential, based on a neural network, which achieves accuracy comparable to ab initio methods. Crucially, the algorithm operates effectively in the liquid phase, eliminating the need for information about the solid alloy's crystalline structure to estimate eutectic points.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“machine learning potential”、“neural network”、“algorithm”、“ab initio methods”。；研究对象：超难熔多组元陶瓷（ultra-refractory multicomponent ceramics）的共晶点（eutectic point）浓度确定，具体以Ti-B-C三元体系作为验证对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于机器学习原子间势（machine-learning interatomic potential）的新判据，可在无需固态晶体结构信息的情况下，仅通过液相模拟准确预测超难熔合金的共晶点浓度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于机器学习原子间势（machine-learning interatomic potential）的新判据，可在无需固态晶体结构信息的情况下，仅通过液相模拟准确预测超难熔合金的共晶点浓度。；创新点：提出了一种针对超难熔体系（熔点>3000 K）共晶点浓度确定的新判据，避免了传统实验在极高温度下的技术困难，且算法无需固态晶体结构信息，仅依赖液相模拟即可工作。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于神经网络的机器学习原子间势（machine-learning interatomic potential）构建算法，该势函数精度可与第一性原理（ab initio）方法相当，并在液相中运行以估计共晶点。

papers.title: Charge Transfer from Perovskite Quantum Dots to Multifunctional Ligands with Tethered Molecular Species
papers.abstract: Perovskite quantum dots (pQDs) are promising materials for optoelectronic and photocatalytic applications due to their unique optical properties. To enhance charge carrier extraction or injection donor/acceptor molecules can be tethered to the pQD. These molecules must strongly bind to the ionic surfaces of pQDs without compromising colloidal stability. These we achieve by using multifunctional ligands containing a quaternary ammonium binding group for strong pQDs surface attachment, a long tail group for colloidal stability, and a functional group near the pQD surface. Such pQDs with ferrocene-functionalized ligands show fast photoexcited hole transfer with near-unity efficiency. Density functional theory calculations reveal how ferrocene's molecular structure reorganizes following hole transfer, affecting its charge separation efficiency. This approach can also be extended to in photoexcited electron and energy transfer processes with pQDs. Therefore, this strategy offers a blueprint for creating efficient QD-molecular hybrids for applications like photocatalysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。关键词：实验合成与表征（photoexcited hole transfer, near-unity efficiency）、密度泛函理论计算（Density functional theory calculations）。；研究对象：钙钛矿量子点（pQDs）与多功能配体（含二茂铁功能基团）形成的杂化体系，具体研究光激发下电荷从量子点向配体分子的转移过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过含季铵盐结合基团、长尾稳定基团和近表面功能基团的多功能配体，实现了对钙钛矿量子点表面的强结合与胶体稳定，并展示了近乎100%效率的超快光激发空穴转移。DFT计算揭示了二茂铁分子在空穴转移后的结构重组如何影响电荷分离效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过含季铵盐结合基团、长尾稳定基团和近表面功能基团的多功能配体，实现了对钙钛矿量子点表面的强结合与胶体稳定，并展示了近乎100%效率的超快光激发空穴转移。DFT计算揭示了二茂铁分子在空穴转移后的结构重组如何影响电荷分离效率。；创新点：提出了一种通用的多功能配体设计策略，通过在同一配体中集成强表面结合、胶体稳定性和近表面功能基团，实现了高效且可扩展的量子点-分子杂化体系，并可推广至电子和能量转移过程。摘要未突出说明与已有配体设计相比的具体性能提升幅度。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：合成含季铵盐结合基团、长尾基团和功能基团（如二茂铁）的多功能配体，并将其修饰到钙钛矿量子点表面，测量光激发空穴转移效率。理论上：采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算二茂铁分子在空穴转移后的结构重组及其对电荷分离效率的影响。

papers.title: Biophysical Considerations for Rational Antibody and ADC Design
papers.abstract: Antibody-based therapeutics-including antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), bispecific antibodies, and novel formats-are reshaping oncology, yet key determinants of efficacy, safety, and manufacturability frequently emerge after conjugation and formulation. We argue that computational biophysics provides an underexploited framework to address this gap by connecting molecular interactions to biological outcomes. We highlight how molecular dynamics, coarse-grained simulations, and free energy calculations reveal how conjugation site, linker chemistry, and drug-antibody ratio reshape conformational landscapes. We emphasize structural coupling between antibody, linker, and payload, with implications for antigen binding, internalization, and developability. We propose that integrating physics-based modeling into development pipelines-alongside experimental validation-can reduce empirical iteration and de-risk translation. As force fields, and hybrid physics-machine-learning methods improve, this field is poised to become a central driver of next-generation ADC design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：computational biophysics、molecular dynamics、coarse-grained simulations、free energy calculations、physics-based modeling）；研究对象：抗体药物（包括抗体-药物偶联物ADC、双特异性抗体等新型抗体形式）的分子设计，具体涉及抗体、连接子（linker）和药物载荷（payload）之间的构象耦合与相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 计算生物物理学（分子动力学、粗粒化模拟、自由能计算）能够揭示偶联位点、连接子化学性质及药物-抗体比率如何重塑抗体构象景观，从而影响抗原结合、内化及可开发性，为理性设计提供物理基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：计算生物物理学（分子动力学、粗粒化模拟、自由能计算）能够揭示偶联位点、连接子化学性质及药物-抗体比率如何重塑抗体构象景观，从而影响抗原结合、内化及可开发性，为理性设计提供物理基础。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但强调将物理建模（而非纯经验方法）整合到抗体/ADC开发管线中，以减少经验迭代并降低转化风险。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟、粗粒化模拟、自由能计算；同时提及力场（force fields）与混合物理-机器学习方法。

papers.title: In-situ correlative SEM/KPFM for semiconductor devices and 2D heterostructures
papers.abstract: Correlative nanoscale surface characterization benefits from simultaneously measuring electronic and structural properties in the same environment, a capability that is essential for modern-day materials science and semiconductor failure analysis. In-situ AFM-SEM measurements facilitated by self-sensing cantilevers offer great potential here; however, they are limited due to their inherent capacitive crosstalk. Here, we demonstrate for the first time the in-situ implementation of single-pass heterodyne Kelvin probe force microscopy inside a scanning electron microscope, using piezo-resistive cantilevers. We overcome the capacitive crosstalk prevalent in piezo-resistive cantilevers by demodulating excitation and detection to simultaneously map surface topography and contact potential difference for correlation with compositional analysis. We systematically compare different operational modes of this heterodyne technique, elucidating their spatial resolution, signal sensitivity, and signal-to-noise ratio. The integrated approach yields exceptional signal quality and reveals how electron beam scan parameters can directly influence surface potential contrast. We demonstrate this correlative analysis workflow on two-dimensional heterostructures and semiconductor circuits. This work establishes a robust and versatile correlative imaging mode for in-situ Kelvin force and topography imaging inside a scanning electron microscope for next-generation semiconductor device analysis and materials science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：in-situ implementation、demonstrate、measurements、experimental workflow。；研究对象：半导体器件与二维异质结的表面电子与结构性质，具体包括表面形貌、接触电势差及其与成分分析的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在扫描电子显微镜内实现了基于自感悬臂梁的单次扫描外差开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM），克服了压阻悬臂梁固有的电容串扰问题，并揭示了电子束扫描参数对表面电势对比度的直接影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在扫描电子显微镜内实现了基于自感悬臂梁的单次扫描外差开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM），克服了压阻悬臂梁固有的电容串扰问题，并揭示了电子束扫描参数对表面电势对比度的直接影响。；创新点：首次在扫描电子显微镜内实现单次扫描外差KPFM的原位集成，解决了压阻悬臂梁中电容串扰这一长期限制，并建立了适用于半导体器件与二维异质结的关联成像工作流程。
papers.method_zh: 采用压阻悬臂梁实现原位AFM-SEM测量，通过解调激励与检测信号，在单次扫描中同时获取表面形貌与接触电势差，并与成分分析进行关联。系统比较了外差技术的不同操作模式，评估其空间分辨率、信号灵敏度与信噪比。

papers.title: Transport signatures of valley polarization in graphene multilayers: In-plane linear magnetoconductivity vs anomalous Hall effect
papers.abstract: In two-dimensional materials where interacting Fermi pockets occur in valleys related by time-reversal symmetry, a spontaneous valley imbalance results in a novel state known as an orbital magnet. Due to the breaking of time-reversal symmetry, this state can be probed in transport experiments by the violation of Onsager relations, most often done through the anomalous Hall effect (AHE). Here we propose that odd-in-field, in-plane linear magnetoconductivity (LMC) is an alternative probe of valley polarization which can occur even when the AHE vanishes. In multilayer structures, the effect originates from in-plane orbital moments and Berry curvatures enabled by interlayer tunneling and dominates over the spin response. After a classification of many recently studied multilayers, we focus on two valley polarized examples: twisted bilayer graphene, where LMC is finite but the AHE vanishes unless additional symmetry breaking from the substrate is present, and rhombohedral graphene multilayers, where LMC and AHE both track valley polarization because they have the same symmetry. Using self-consistent Hartree-Fock and semiclassical transport calculations, we present detailed predictions of LMR for these two examples and analyze the implications for recent experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“self-consistent Hartree-Fock”和“semiclassical transport calculations”等理论计算方法。；研究对象：石墨烯多层体系（如扭曲双层石墨烯、菱面体石墨烯多层）中由自发谷极化导致的轨道磁体态，以及其输运特性（面内线性磁导率与反常霍尔效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出面内线性磁导率（LMC）可作为探测谷极化的替代探针，即使在反常霍尔效应（AHE）为零的情况下也能工作。在多层结构中，该效应源于层间隧穿产生的面内轨道矩和贝里曲率，并主导自旋响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出面内线性磁导率（LMC）可作为探测谷极化的替代探针，即使在反常霍尔效应（AHE）为零的情况下也能工作。在多层结构中，该效应源于层间隧穿产生的面内轨道矩和贝里曲率，并主导自旋响应。；创新点：首次提出在多层石墨烯体系中，奇次场依赖的面内线性磁导率（LMC）可以作为探测谷极化的新手段，并指出其与反常霍尔效应（AHE）在对称性要求上的差异（例如在扭曲双层石墨烯中，LMC存在而AHE可能因对称性而消失）。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽哈特里-福克（self-consistent Hartree-Fock）方法进行电子结构计算，并结合半经典输运理论（semiclassical transport calculations）计算磁导率。

papers.title: Spherically symmetric approaches in the theoretical study of low-dimensional magnets
papers.abstract: The main ideas and some of the most important results of the spherically symmetric self-consistent approach and a number of related theoretical algorithms are presented. These methods make it possible to study low-dimensional Heisenberg-type spin models, including frustrated ones, with careful consideration of the theoretic (Mermin-Wagner and Marshall) theorems, as well as the site spin constraint. Thus, the difficulties that may arise in the traditional analysis of low-dimensional magnetic systems are avoided. The approach can also be applied to the spin-pseudospin model, and is also embedded in more complex constructions when considering spin models with free carriers, such as the basic and three-band Hubbard models, t-J and s-d models, and the Kondo lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical study、self-consistent approach、theoretical algorithms。；研究对象：低维磁性系统，包括受挫海森堡型自旋模型、自旋-赝自旋模型，以及含自由载流子的自旋模型（如Hubbard模型、t-J模型、s-d模型、Kondo晶格等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 球对称自洽方法及相关理论算法能够严格考虑Mermin-Wagner定理、Marshall定理以及局域自旋约束，从而有效避免传统分析低维磁系统时遇到的困难。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：球对称自洽方法及相关理论算法能够严格考虑Mermin-Wagner定理、Marshall定理以及局域自旋约束，从而有效避免传统分析低维磁系统时遇到的困难。；创新点：通过同时满足理论定理（Mermin-Wagner、Marshall）和自旋约束条件，克服了传统方法在低维磁性系统分析中的固有困难，并具有扩展到多种关联电子模型的通用性。摘要未突出说明与已有方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 球对称自洽方法（spherically symmetric self-consistent approach）及一系列相关理论算法。摘要未明确说明具体数值技术（如是否涉及DMRG、QMC等），但强调该方法可嵌入更复杂的理论框架（如多带Hubbard模型、Kondo晶格等）。

papers.title: Fuzzy band structure of quantum dots by Bloch Orbital Expansion, unconventional insights into geometry-electronic structure relations
papers.abstract: The extension of ab-initio methods like density functional theory (DFT) to quantum dot (QD) geometries has enabled researchers to explore relationships between QD surface termination and electronic structure. However, fully utilizing the data from DFT requires novel classification methods for QD orbitals. Here, we identify relationships between QD geometry and electronic structure by transforming real-space QD orbitals into momentum-space using Bloch orbital expansion (BOE), yielding a fuzzy QD band structure. Comparing with bulk band structures, we show that truncated, unpassivated facets in III-V and II-VI QDs produce mid-gap orbitals derived from bulk surface orbitals; an identification challenging in real space. QDs with reconstructed facets, however, feature delocalized orbitals formed by superposition of bulk Bloch orbitals. Moreover, we prepare for the first time atomistic core/shell QD models and by the BOE expansion we can clearly identify the core/shell band alignment not possible in real space. These findings emphasize BOE as a vital tool for connecting computational and experimental insights in nanocrystal research.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：ab-initio methods、density functional theory (DFT)、Bloch orbital expansion (BOE)。；研究对象：量子点（quantum dots, QDs），具体包括III-V族和II-VI族量子点，以及首次制备的原子级核/壳量子点模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过布洛赫轨道展开（BOE）将实空间量子点轨道变换到动量空间，得到模糊的量子点能带结构，从而揭示量子点几何结构与电子结构之间的非常规关系，例如截断未钝化晶面产生体相表面衍生轨道，重构晶面产生布洛赫轨道叠加形成的离域轨道，以及核/壳能带对齐的清晰识别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过布洛赫轨道展开（BOE）将实空间量子点轨道变换到动量空间，得到模糊的量子点能带结构，从而揭示量子点几何结构与电子结构之间的非常规关系，例如截断未钝化晶面产生体相表面衍生轨道，重构晶面产生布洛赫轨道叠加形成的离域轨道，以及核/壳能带对齐的清晰识别。；创新点：首次将布洛赫轨道展开（BOE）应用于量子点体系，实现了实空间难以完成的轨道分类（如识别中隙轨道来源、核/壳能带对齐），并首次制备了原子级核/壳量子点模型。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）进行第一性原理计算，并引入布洛赫轨道展开（BOE）方法将实空间量子点轨道投影到动量空间，获得模糊能带结构，再与体相能带结构进行对比分析。

papers.title: A practical Laser-Heated Diamond Anvil Cell synthesis technique and recovery workflow for metastable MnSb2 and YbZn2 phases
papers.abstract: The creation and exploration of new materials under extreme pressure-temperature conditions has become increasingly reliant on laser-heated diamond anvil cell (LHDAC) techniques, which provide direct access to previously unexplored regions of multinary phase diagrams. Whereas numerous high-pressure phases have been identified in situ, systematic recovery and post-synthesis physical property characterization of these materials remain significant challenges. In this work, we present the development of an integrated LHDAC synthesis and demonstrate a practical LHDAC-based synthesis workflow that enables stabilization and recovery of metastable intermetallic phases for subsequent structural and transport studies. Using this approach, we successfully achieved LHDAC synthesis of high-pressure MnSb2 and YbZn2 phases under moderate pressures. Synchrotron X-ray diffraction and spatial mapping confirm dominant formation of the targeted phases, whereas laboratory-based refinement quantifies phase fractions despite intrinsic microstrain and minor secondary phases. High-pressure transport measurements on recovered samples reveal tunable by pressure electronic instabilities in both systems. In MnSb2, pressure suppresses two high-temperature magnetic ordering anomalies, observed in transport, by 5 GPa and for higher pressures induces a new low-temperature feature that increases with further pressure increase. In hexagonal high-pressure YbZn2, an electronic reconstruction emerges at ~11 GPa, characterized by semiconducting-like behavior from ~ 30 K to 300 K and a broad low-temperature coherence crossover near 30 K. Our results establish LHDAC synthesis not only as a structural discovery tool, but also as an experimental platform for investigating correlated quantum states stabilized far from equilibrium thermodynamic conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：Laser-Heated Diamond Anvil Cell (LHDAC) synthesis、Synchrotron X-ray diffraction、High-pressure transport measurements。；研究对象：高压亚稳态金属间化合物MnSb₂和YbZn₂的合成、回收及物理性质表征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了集成化的LHDAC合成与回收工作流程，成功合成了高压相MnSb₂和YbZn₂，并发现压力可调控两者的电子不稳定性：MnSb₂中压力抑制高温磁有序异常并诱导新的低温特征；YbZn₂中在约11 GPa出现电子重构，表现为类半导体行为和低温相干交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了集成化的LHDAC合成与回收工作流程，成功合成了高压相MnSb₂和YbZn₂，并发现压力可调控两者的电子不稳定性：MnSb₂中压力抑制高温磁有序异常并诱导新的低温特征；YbZn₂中在约11 GPa出现电子重构，表现为类半导体行为和低温相干交叉。；创新点：将LHDAC技术从单纯的结构发现工具拓展为可回收亚稳态材料并进行后续输运性质研究的实验平台，解决了高压相系统回收与物性表征的难题。
papers.method_zh: 采用激光加热金刚石对顶砧（LHDAC）技术进行高压合成；使用同步辐射X射线衍射和空间映射确认目标相的形成；通过实验室X射线衍射精修定量相分数；对回收样品进行高压输运测量。

papers.title: Interfacial Reconstructions and Engineering in III-V@II-VI Core-Shell Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: In core/shell quantum dots (QDs), the interface between semiconductors of different chemical character largely determines their optoelectronic properties. In III-V/II-VI systems, this boundary involves pronounced chemical and electronic discontinuities that can generate trap states even under complete surface passivation. Using density functional theory on atomistic models of InAs/CdSe QDs, we systematically reconstruct atomic arrangements at the surface and interface to evaluate how local coordination and interfacial dipoles influence the electronic structure. Abrupt interfaces induce charge imbalance and band-gap collapse, whereas introducing an alloyed interlayer that mixes core and shell atoms and vacancies restores energetic alignment and yields delocalized band-edge states, consistent with experimental findings. We also introduce a charge-flow analysis that quantifies charge redistribution across the QD, providing a framework for realistic modeling of interlayer formation and predictive design of defect-free interfaces in core@shell architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“density functional theory (DFT)”（密度泛函理论）进行原子模型计算，并提出了“charge-flow analysis”（电荷流分析）这一分析框架。；研究对象：III-V@II-VI 核壳量子点（Core-Shell Quantum Dots），具体为 InAs/CdSe 量子点体系。研究聚焦于核与壳之间界面的原子重构及其对电子结构的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 InAs/CdSe 核壳量子点中，突变的（abrupt）界面会导致电荷失衡和带隙坍塌；而引入由核、壳原子和空位混合形成的合金化中间层，可以恢复能级对齐，产生离域的带边态，从而消除界面缺陷态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 InAs/CdSe 核壳量子点中，突变的（abrupt）界面会导致电荷失衡和带隙坍塌；而引入由核、壳原子和空位混合形成的合金化中间层，可以恢复能级对齐，产生离域的带边态，从而消除界面缺陷态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但主要新意在于：1）系统性地研究了不同界面重构（突变 vs. 合金化）对电子结构的影响；2）提出了“电荷流分析”这一新的分析工具，为核壳结构中界面层的形成机制和缺陷界面的预测性设计提供了理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，对 InAs/CdSe 量子点的原子模型进行表面和界面的系统重构。同时，引入了一种“电荷流分析”（charge-flow analysis）方法，用于量化量子点内部的电荷重新分布。

papers.title: Benchmarking empirical and machine-learned interatomic potentials using phase diagram predictions for Lead
papers.abstract: We compare the predicted phase behaviour of lead (Pb) using three different interatomic potential models, including an embedded atom method (EAM), a modified embedded atom method (MEAM), and a neural network-based machine-learned model in the form of an ephemeral data-derived potential (EDDP). Using nested sampling and replica-exchange nested sampling simulations, we computed thermodynamic and structural properties at pressures up to 60 GPa, mapping both melting behaviour and solid-phase stability. Both the EAM and MEAM models predict the face-centred cubic (FCC) phase to remain stable up to approximately 60 GPa. In contrast, the EDDP model captures the experimentally-observed FCC-to-hexagonal close-packed (HCP) transition at around 15 GPa. These results highlight the importance of training data and model flexibility in accurately describing high-pressure phase behaviour, and demonstrate the effectiveness of nested sampling as a robust framework for exploring phase stability in materials. Particularly, the combination of nested sampling with modern machine-learned interatomic potentials - delivering near ab initio accuracy at tractable cost - opens the door to truly predictive and exhaustive exploration. EDDPs trained on diverse, out-of-equilibrium configurations appear particularly well suited to this task, offering a robust and transferable framework for unbiased phase discovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：interatomic potential models、nested sampling、simulations、phase diagram predictions。；研究对象：铅（Pb）在高压下的相行为，包括熔化行为和固相稳定性，特别是面心立方（FCC）与六方密堆积（HCP）之间的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统嵌入原子法（EAM）和改进嵌入原子法（MEAM）势函数均预测铅的FCC相在高达约60 GPa时仍稳定，而基于神经网络的机器学习势函数（EDDP）成功捕捉到实验上观测到的FCC到HCP相变（约15 GPa），表明训练数据和模型灵活性对准确描述高压相行为至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统嵌入原子法（EAM）和改进嵌入原子法（MEAM）势函数均预测铅的FCC相在高达约60 GPa时仍稳定，而基于神经网络的机器学习势函数（EDDP）成功捕捉到实验上观测到的FCC到HCP相变（约15 GPa），表明训练数据和模型灵活性对准确描述高压相行为至关重要。；创新点：将嵌套采样这一稳健的相空间探索框架与现代机器学习势函数（EDDP）相结合，实现了接近从头算精度且计算成本可控的相稳定性预测；特别地，基于多样化非平衡构型训练的EDDP展现出良好的鲁棒性和可迁移性，为无偏相发现提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 使用嵌套采样（nested sampling）和副本交换嵌套采样（replica-exchange nested sampling）模拟，结合三种原子间势模型：EAM、MEAM以及基于神经网络的瞬态数据衍生势（EDDP），计算了铅在60 GPa压力下的热力学和结构性质。

papers.title: Charge-sensitive vibrational modes in BEDT-TTF salts: Signatures of charge ordering and site charge
papers.abstract: BEDT-TTF-based organic conductors host a number of ground states, tuned by electron repulsion from Mott and charge ordered insulators to superconductors. Knowing charge distribution on the molecular sites in the insulating state of these materials is a key to understanding the origin of these ground states. We survey and discuss the C=C stretching modes in BEDT-TTF based molecular conductors. These molecular vibrations are extremely crucial in characterization of charge-ordered insulators, and are recently linked to superconductivity in some compounds. Focusing on the known examples of BEDT-TTF$^{+0.5}$ salts, we analyse the reliability of the C=C stretching modes for the determination of charge ordering and absolute site charge. Considering the charge-ordered states, a prominent shift in frequency of 141 cm$^{-1}$ per elementary charge $e$ for $ν_{27}(b_{1u})$ and 98 cm$^{-1}$$e$ for $ν_2$($a_g$) can be clearly realised, however, the distribution resulting from different compounds span over 20 cm$^{-1}$. For nominal BEDT-TTF$^{+0.5}$ compounds, the distribution of the resonance also extends around 20 cm$^{-1}$, yielding an unexpected large uncertainty of $Δρ~\approx~(~\pm~0.045)e$, which is presumably due to the influence of small differences in the structure. This highlights the limitations of charge-frequency relations to detect small deviations in absolute charge values on molecular lattice sites, and emphasises on the use of the relations to estimate charge-ordering, rather than absolute site charge.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：survey and discuss、analyse the reliability、known examples、distribution of the resonance）；研究对象：基于BEDT-TTF的有机导体中的C=C伸缩振动模式，特别是电荷有序绝缘体和名义BEDT-TTF⁺⁰·⁵盐中的分子振动与电荷分布关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: C=C伸缩振动频率随电荷变化存在明确线性关系（ν₂₇(b₁ᵤ)为141 cm⁻¹/e，ν₂(a_g)为98 cm⁻¹/e），但不同化合物间频率分布展宽约20 cm⁻¹，导致绝对电荷值的不确定性高达Δρ≈(±0.045)e，表明该关系更适合判断电荷有序性而非精确测定绝对位点电荷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：C=C伸缩振动频率随电荷变化存在明确线性关系（ν₂₇(b₁ᵤ)为141 cm⁻¹/e，ν₂(a_g)为98 cm⁻¹/e），但不同化合物间频率分布展宽约20 cm⁻¹，导致绝对电荷值的不确定性高达Δρ≈(±0.045)e，表明该关系更适合判断电荷有序性而非精确测定绝对位点电荷。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 系统调研并分析已知BEDT-TTF⁺⁰·⁵盐的红外/拉曼光谱数据，聚焦C=C伸缩振动模式（ν₂₇和ν₂）的频率-电荷关联，通过比较不同化合物数据评估其可靠性。

papers.title: Large-$N$ scaling of Tan's contact for the harmonically trapped Tonks--Girardeau gas at finite temperature
papers.abstract: We derive the canonical-ensemble scaling of Tan's contact for $N$ harmonically trapped Tonks--Girardeau bosons at finite temperature in the large-$N$ limit. The leading scaling coefficient reproduces the local-density-approximation result and is obtained from a contour-integral representation of the canonical partition function followed by a saddle-point reduction to a phase-space integral with a self-consistent scaled chemical potential. The subleading coefficient is the central new object of this work: it admits an explicit representation in terms of universal phase-space integrals of the Fermi factor, has closed-form Sommerfeld and virial limits, and is identified with the canonical-versus-grand-canonical ensemble difference at fixed mean particle number. In the high-temperature Boltzmann regime the ratio of subleading to leading coefficients collapses to a universal value, traceable to the Poissonian particle-number statistics of the dilute grand-canonical gas. We construct Padé approximants for both scaling functions that interpolate uniformly between the low-temperature Sommerfeld and high-temperature virial regimes; for the subleading coefficient we report a form that is uniformly accurate on our working range of temperatures and asymptotically correct beyond. The scaling law is verified against canonical contour-integration data across the full temperature range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive（推导）、scaling（标度）、contour-integral representation（围道积分表示）、saddle-point reduction（鞍点约化）。；研究对象：有限温度下简谐势阱中Tonks–Girardeau（TG）玻色子气体的Tan接触（Tan's contact），重点关注大粒子数N的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了有限温度下简谐势阱中N个Tonks–Girardeau玻色子Tan接触的正则系综标度律，其中次领头标度系数是全新结果，可表示为费米因子的普适相空间积分，并等同于固定平均粒子数下正则系综与巨正则系综的差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了有限温度下简谐势阱中N个Tonks–Girardeau玻色子Tan接触的正则系综标度律，其中次领头标度系数是全新结果，可表示为费米因子的普适相空间积分，并等同于固定平均粒子数下正则系综与巨正则系综的差异。；创新点：首次给出有限温度下TG气体Tan接触的次领头标度系数，并证明其与正则-巨正则系综差异的等价性；发现高温玻尔兹曼区下次领头与领头系数之比趋于普适值，该值可追溯至稀薄巨正则气体的泊松粒子数统计。
papers.method_zh: 采用正则系综的围道积分表示配分函数，通过鞍点约化将其化为具有自洽标度化学势的相空间积分；利用Sommerfeld展开和virial展开得到闭合形式的解析极限；构建Padé近似函数在低温和高温区间之间均匀插值。

papers.title: Orbital Angular Momentum Textures and Currents in a Discrete Helix: Equilibrium and Linear Response
papers.abstract: Recently, nonequilibrium orbital angular momentum in low-dimensional systems has attracted renewed attention. Here we introduce a minimal three-orbital tight-binding model for a single helical chain and show that chirality alone generates a momentum-dependent orbital-angular-momentum texture through Slater--Koster hybridization in the local basis $(p_r,p_φ,p_z)$, without requiring atomic spin--orbit coupling. In the single-helix geometry, the radial orbital texture vanishes identically, while the azimuthal and longitudinal components remain finite and arise from the odd-in-momentum $(p_z,p_r)$ and $(p_r,p_φ)$ sectors. As a result, the equilibrium average orbital texture vanishes by parity, although persistent-like orbital angular momentum currents may still exist and imply chirality-dependent end magnetization in a finite helix. Under an applied longitudinal electric field, the system develops a finite orbital Edelstein response, whereas the projected longitudinal orbital-current conductivity vanishes in the linear regime by parity. When spin degrees of freedom are included, the orbital texture acts as a source of spin polarization through orbital-to-spin transduction. The resulting spin response is controlled by orbital overlap scales much larger than the bare relativistic spin--orbit scale, making it a stronger candidate for spin injection than the conventional spin Edelstein mechanism. These results identify chirality as the minimal microscopic ingredient for generating orbital angular momentum response in one-dimensional systems and support an orbital route to spin selectivity in chiral conductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：tight-binding model（紧束缚模型）、linear response（线性响应）、理论分析。；研究对象：单螺旋链（single helical chain）中的轨道角动量（Orbital Angular Momentum, OAM）纹理与电流，以及在外电场下的轨道Edelstein效应和自旋极化响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅凭手性（chirality）即可在无原子自旋-轨道耦合的情况下，通过Slater-Koster杂化在局域基矢$(p_r,p_φ,p_z)$中产生动量依赖的轨道角动量纹理；该纹理在平衡态下平均为零，但可产生类持续轨道角动量电流，并在有限螺旋中导致依赖于手性的末端磁化；在外电场下，系统呈现有限的轨道Edelstein响应，而纵向轨道电流电导率在线性区为零；轨道纹理可通过轨道-自旋转导产生自旋极化，其自旋响应由远大于裸相对论自旋-轨道耦合尺度的轨道重叠尺度控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅凭手性（chirality）即可在无原子自旋-轨道耦合的情况下，通过Slater-Koster杂化在局域基矢$(p_r,p_φ,p_z)$中产生动量依赖的轨道角动量纹理；该纹理在平衡态下平均为零，但可产生类持续轨道角动量电流，并在有限螺旋中导致依赖于手性的末端磁化；在外电场下，系统呈现有限的轨道Edelstein响应，而纵向轨道电流电导率在线性区为零；轨道纹理可通过轨道-自旋转导产生自旋极化，其自旋响应由远大于裸相对论自旋-轨道耦合尺度的轨道重叠尺度控制。；创新点：首次指出在无自旋-轨道耦合的一维螺旋体系中，仅凭手性即可产生轨道角动量纹理和响应，并揭示了轨道角动量作为自旋选择性的微观起源，比传统自旋Edelstein机制更高效。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个最小三轨道紧束缚模型（three-orbital tight-binding model），在局域柱坐标基矢$(p_r,p_φ,p_z)$下分析轨道角动量纹理；采用平衡态统计和线性响应理论（linear response theory）计算轨道角动量电流、轨道Edelstein效应及自旋极化响应。

papers.title: Lieb-Schultz-Mattis constraints for hyperbolic lattices
papers.abstract: The Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) theorem and its higher-dimensional extensions forbid the existence of a unique, symmetric, and gapped ground state at fractional fillings in quantum many-body systems with a conserved particle number (or spin angular momentum) and the conventional translation symmetry of Euclidean lattices. In this work, we propose a generalization of the LSM theorem to quantum many-body systems on hyperbolic lattices, i.e., regular tessellations of two-dimensional negatively curved space. By leveraging concepts from hyperbolic band theory in a many-body setting, we adapt Oshikawa's flux-threading argument to periodic hyperbolic lattices with a non-Euclidean (Fuchsian) translation symmetry and compute a lower-bound to the ground-state degeneracy as a function of filling and lattice geometry. We explore the consequences of LSM constraints for gapped phases of hyperbolic quantum matter and suggest frustrated spin models on hyperbolic analogs of the square and triangular lattices as promising platforms for realizing symmetric spin liquids in hyperbolic space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“提出推广”“适应论证”“计算下界”等理论推导和概念扩展的关键词。；研究对象：双曲晶格上的量子多体系统，即二维负曲率空间中的规则镶嵌结构，以及其上的Lieb-Schultz-Mattis（LSM）约束。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将LSM定理从欧几里得晶格推广到双曲晶格，证明在具有非欧几里得（Fuchsian）平移对称性的周期双曲晶格中，分数填充下同样禁止存在唯一、对称、有能隙的基态，并给出了基态简并度的下界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将LSM定理从欧几里得晶格推广到双曲晶格，证明在具有非欧几里得（Fuchsian）平移对称性的周期双曲晶格中，分数填充下同样禁止存在唯一、对称、有能隙的基态，并给出了基态简并度的下界。；创新点：首次将LSM定理推广到双曲空间中的晶格系统，为非欧几里得几何中的量子物质有能隙相提供了新的约束条件，并提出了双曲类比正方和三角晶格上的阻挫自旋模型作为实现对称自旋液体的候选平台。
papers.method_zh: 利用多体框架下的双曲能带理论概念，将Oshikawa的通量穿针论证（flux-threading argument）适配到具有Fuchsian平移对称性的周期双曲晶格上，通过填充因子和晶格几何计算基态简并度的下界。

papers.title: Tunable Crossed Andreev Reflection in Bipolar Magnetic Semiconductors
papers.abstract: Crossed Andreev reflection (CAR) is a nonlocal quantum transport phenomenon that arises at the interface between a superconductor and two spatially separated metals. In this process, an electron incident from one metal combines with another electron originating from the other metal to form a Cooper pair in the superconductor. As a consequence, a hole is emitted into the second metal, establishing a nonlocal electron-hole conversion process. In contrast to local Andreev reflection -- where electron-to-hole conversion occurs within the same region -- CAR intrinsically links two spatially separated carriers, giving rise to nonlocal correlations and quantum entanglement. In bipolar magnetic semiconductors (BMSs), the conduction and valence bands possess opposite spin polarizations. We propose to achieve tunable control of CAR by independently adjusting the chemical potentials of the two regions. By engineering the alignment of spin-polarized bands in the two BMS leads, CAR can be selectively enhanced or suppressed. This tunability enables precise manipulation of nonlocal transport, and correlated electron dynamics, offering promising prospects for spintronic and superconducting device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose（提出）、engineering（设计）、tunability（可调性），未提及实验或计算细节。；研究对象：交叉安德烈夫反射（CAR）在双极磁性半导体（BMS）中的非局域量子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过独立调节双极磁性半导体两个区域的化学势，可以实现对交叉安德烈夫反射的选择性增强或抑制，从而精确操控非局域输运和关联电子动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过独立调节双极磁性半导体两个区域的化学势，可以实现对交叉安德烈夫反射的选择性增强或抑制，从而精确操控非局域输运和关联电子动力学。；创新点：首次提出利用双极磁性半导体的自旋极化能带结构，通过独立调节两个区域的化学势来实现对交叉安德烈夫反射的可调控制，为自旋电子学和超导器件应用提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于双极磁性半导体中导带和价带具有相反自旋极化的特性，通过调控两个BMS电极中自旋极化能带的相对排列来实现对CAR的调控。

papers.title: Bak--Tang--Wiesenfeld model for various topologies and ranges of interaction
papers.abstract: In this paper, the Bak--Tang--Wiesenfeld model for various substrate topologies and a variety of neighborhoods is reconsidered. With computer simulation, we study the distribution of avalanche sizes. Using the Z-score we confirm that independently of the substrate topology and the range of neighborhood, the exponent that governs the power law of the probability distribution of the size of avalanches is the same and approximately equal 1.208(39). However, this requires a smartly chosen number of deposited grains in relation to the linear size of the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：computer simulation、distribution of avalanche sizes、Z-score）；研究对象：Bak–Tang–Wiesenfeld（BTW）沙堆模型在不同基底拓扑结构和不同相互作用范围下的雪崩行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无论基底拓扑和邻域范围如何，雪崩尺寸的概率分布均遵循相同的幂律，指数约为1.208(39)，但这一结果依赖于沉积颗粒数与系统线性尺寸之间的恰当比例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无论基底拓扑和邻域范围如何，雪崩尺寸的概率分布均遵循相同的幂律，指数约为1.208(39)，但这一结果依赖于沉积颗粒数与系统线性尺寸之间的恰当比例。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 计算机模拟，通过Z-score统计检验确认幂律指数的一致性。

papers.title: The Directed Abelian Sandpile Model on Cylinders
papers.abstract: We study the abelian sandpile model in two dimensions on a directed cylindrical lattice with periodic transverse boundary conditions in the transverse direction and dissipation at one boundary. Recurrent configurations form a finite abelian group, and repeated grain addition at a specific site generates deterministic dynamics on this group. Using Dhar's formulation, the sandpile group is identified with the co-kernel of the reduced directed Laplacian. We show that the group structure admits an exact reduction to a transverse problem, allowing complete determination of its cyclic decomposition. Our results establish a direct connection between the algebraic structure of the sandpile group and the periodicity of the driven dynamics, establishing the manner in which the underlying algebraic structure governs both deterministic and stochastic evolution in directed sandpile.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“We show”“Our results establish”等理论推导表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：二维有向圆柱晶格上的阿贝尔沙堆模型（directed abelian sandpile model），具有横向周期性边界条件及一端耗散边界。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该沙堆模型的群结构可精确约化为横向问题，从而完全确定其循环分解；沙堆群的代数结构与驱动动力学的周期性之间存在直接联系，代数结构同时支配确定性演化与随机演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该沙堆模型的群结构可精确约化为横向问题，从而完全确定其循环分解；沙堆群的代数结构与驱动动力学的周期性之间存在直接联系，代数结构同时支配确定性演化与随机演化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Dhar的沙堆群形式化方法，将沙堆群等同于约化有向拉普拉斯算子的余核（co-kernel），通过代数约化将二维问题降维为横向问题。

papers.title: Actin cross-linking organizes basal body patterning through anomalous diffusion transitions
papers.abstract: Subcellular protein complexes and organelles exhibit diverse dynamic behaviors that reflect the mechanical constraints and organization of the intracellular environment. Although some structures follow classical Brownian motion, many display anomalous dynamics. The transitions between these regimes are increasingly recognized as critical for subcellular organization, yet how they influence pattern formation remains unclear. Here, we investigate the spatial arrangement of cilia on the apical surface of multiciliated cells (MCCs) in developing Xenopus laevis embryos, where coordinated ciliary beating depends on the precise organization of hundreds of centriole-derived basal bodies (BBs). Using quantitative confocal, high-resolution and high-speed TIRF imaging together with theoretical modeling, we show that BB trajectories undergo time-resolved transitions between diffusive and anomalous motion, with distinct regimes that correlate with apical surface expansion. During the early stages, actin remodeling facilitates the dispersal of BBs by providing a permissive, low-confinement environment. As development progresses, the actin network becomes increasingly cross-linked that constrains BB movement and promotes uniform spacing across the apical domain. Disruption of $α$-actinin-1, a major actin cross-linking protein, impairs the integrity of the apical actin meshwork, weakens BB confinement, and disrupts regular spatial patterning, ultimately compromising the arrangement of BBs required for proper cilia alignment. Together, we show that progressive apical actin cross-linking coordinates BB positioning and regulates their dynamic state, guiding the shift from diffusive to confined motion. This transition in dynamics enables the emergence of a uniform BB pattern, which in turn ensures the aligned deployment of motile cilia necessary for effective directional fluid flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（混合类型，包含理论建模）。判断依据：定量共聚焦、高分辨率及高速TIRF成像、理论建模。；研究对象：多纤毛细胞（MCCs）顶端表面中心粒衍生基体（BBs）的空间排列及其动力学，具体涉及非洲爪蟾胚胎发育过程中纤毛的定位与模式形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 肌动蛋白交联通过调控基体从扩散运动向受限运动的异常扩散转变，驱动基体在细胞顶端表面形成均匀的空间排列，从而确保运动纤毛的正确对齐和定向流体流动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：肌动蛋白交联通过调控基体从扩散运动向受限运动的异常扩散转变，驱动基体在细胞顶端表面形成均匀的空间排列，从而确保运动纤毛的正确对齐和定向流体流动。；创新点：揭示了肌动蛋白交联蛋白α-辅肌动蛋白-1通过逐步增强顶端肌动蛋白网络交联，引导基体动力学从扩散态向受限态转变，从而调控亚细胞模式形成的新机制。摘要未突出说明与已有理论模型的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 定量共聚焦显微镜、高分辨率及高速全内反射荧光（TIRF）成像、理论建模（分析扩散与异常运动的时间分辨转变）。

papers.title: Active Model B$^-$ from Mass-Conserving Reaction-Diffusion Systems
papers.abstract: We show that the late-time dynamics of a minimal three-component mass-conserving reaction--diffusion system reduce to a scalar active field theory, Active Model B$^-$ (AMB$^-$), in which a density-dependent interfacial coefficient $κ(φ)$ turns negative at high density. This drives a finite-wavelength instability and stabilises microphase-separated patterns, in contrast to the unbounded coarsening of two-component mass-conserving systems. Unlike Active Model B$^+$, AMB$^-$ retains a chemical potential that remains a state function, inherited from the underlying conservation law, but admits no equation of state for the pressure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show that（理论推导）、reduce to a scalar active field theory（构建有效场论）、Active Model B⁻（理论模型）。；研究对象：质量守恒反应-扩散系统中的微相分离现象，具体为一种最小三组分质量守恒反应-扩散系统的晚期动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三组分质量守恒反应-扩散系统的晚期动力学可约化为标量活性场论——Active Model B⁻（AMB⁻），其中密度依赖的界面系数κ(φ)在高密度下变为负值，驱动有限波长不稳定性并稳定微相分离图案，与双组分质量守恒系统的无界粗化行为形成对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三组分质量守恒反应-扩散系统的晚期动力学可约化为标量活性场论——Active Model B⁻（AMB⁻），其中密度依赖的界面系数κ(φ)在高密度下变为负值，驱动有限波长不稳定性并稳定微相分离图案，与双组分质量守恒系统的无界粗化行为形成对比。；创新点：发现了一种新的活性场论模型AMB⁻，其化学势仍保持为状态函数（继承自底层守恒律），但压力不存在状态方程，这与已知的Active Model B⁺形成关键区别。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与模型约化：从三组分质量守恒反应-扩散方程出发，通过绝热消去和梯度展开，将其约化为标量活性场论AMB⁻，并分析其界面系数符号变化导致的相分离行为。

papers.title: Solving Classical and Quantum Spin Glasses with Deep Boltzmann Quantum States
papers.abstract: Variational neural network models have achieved remarkable success in solving ground-state problems of quantum many-body systems. However, addressing classical and quantum spin glasses remains challenging, as disorder and energy frustration give rise to an exponentially large number of local energy minima separated by high-energy barriers, hindering the efficiency of conventional Metropolis-based Monte Carlo methods. To bridge this gap, we introduce Deep Boltzmann Quantum States, a class of neural quantum states inspired by deep Boltzmann machines that inherit efficient block Gibbs sampling. We also propose two key advances in the training algorithm. Firstly, we combine natural-gradient updates with state-of-the-art stochastic optimizers. Secondly, we gradually tune the hardness of the problem Hamiltonian by interpolating from an easy to a hard regime, without the need to closely approximate the instantaneous adiabatic state at intermediate times. We match the exact solution or the best available estimate for several instances of classical and quantum Ising spin-glass models with infinite-range interactions and hundreds of spins. We also solve instances of the NP-hard Job Shop Scheduling Problem exceeding the current limitations of quantum annealing hardware. To summarize, deep neural architectures with efficient global update rules and trained within an annealing-like scheme, provide a powerful framework for solving real-world hard combinatorial optimization and for investigating disordered quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：variational neural network models、training algorithm、solving ground-state problems、computational framework。；研究对象：经典与量子自旋玻璃（classical and quantum spin glasses），具体包括无限长程相互作用的伊辛自旋玻璃模型（Ising spin-glass models with infinite-range interactions），以及NP难的作业车间调度问题（Job Shop Scheduling Problem）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种名为“深度玻尔兹曼量子态”（Deep Boltzmann Quantum States）的神经量子态，结合自然梯度更新与从易到难的哈密顿量插值训练策略，能够精确求解数百个自旋的经典与量子自旋玻璃基态，并解决超出当前量子退火硬件能力的NP难组合优化问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种名为“深度玻尔兹曼量子态”（Deep Boltzmann Quantum States）的神经量子态，结合自然梯度更新与从易到难的哈密顿量插值训练策略，能够精确求解数百个自旋的经典与量子自旋玻璃基态，并解决超出当前量子退火硬件能力的NP难组合优化问题。；创新点：将深度玻尔兹曼机架构与类退火训练方案相结合，利用高效的全局更新规则，为求解真实世界硬组合优化问题和研究无序量子多体系统提供了新框架。摘要未突出说明与已有神经量子态方法在具体模型上的性能对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用深度玻尔兹曼机（deep Boltzmann machines）启发的神经量子态架构，继承高效的块吉布斯采样（block Gibbs sampling）；训练算法结合自然梯度更新（natural-gradient updates）与最先进的随机优化器，并通过从易到难插值问题哈密顿量（interpolating from an easy to a hard regime）来逐步调节求解难度，无需精确逼近中间时刻的瞬时绝热态。

papers.title: Cycle affinity and winding localize eigenvalues of Markov generators
papers.abstract: The complex eigenvalues of Markov generators govern oscillatory properties of relaxation, autocorrelation, and linear response. Here we show that these eigenvalues are localized by nonequilibrium cycles of the generator, thus revealing a fundamental tradeoff between thermodynamic driving, oscillation, and decay of eigenmodes. Specifically, we prove that each complex eigenvalue is confined to a region determined by the cycle affinity and the eigenvector ``winding number'' of some nonequilibrium cycle. In unicyclic systems, we also demonstrate that the winding number coincides with the ordered eigenvalue index, yielding new thermodynamic bounds on the slowest and fastest relaxation modes. In multicyclic systems, our approach unifies and extends several previous inequalities and proves the Uhl--Seifert ellipse conjecture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“prove”、“theorem”、“bounds”、“conjecture”，属于数学物理理论推导。；研究对象：马尔可夫生成元（Markov generators）的复本征值谱，具体研究非平衡循环（nonequilibrium cycles）如何影响这些本征值的局域化，以及热力学驱动力（thermodynamic driving）与振荡、衰减模式之间的基本权衡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了马尔可夫生成元的每个复本征值都被限制在一个由循环亲和力（cycle affinity）和本征矢“绕数”（winding number）共同决定的区域内，揭示了非平衡循环对复本征值谱的局域化作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了马尔可夫生成元的每个复本征值都被限制在一个由循环亲和力（cycle affinity）和本征矢“绕数”（winding number）共同决定的区域内，揭示了非平衡循环对复本征值谱的局域化作用。；创新点：首次建立了马尔可夫生成元复本征值谱的几何局域化条件，将热力学驱动力（循环亲和力）与谱的振荡/衰减特性通过绕数直接关联，并解决了Uhl-Seifert椭圆猜想这一开放问题。
papers.method_zh: 采用严格的数学证明方法，包括：利用循环亲和力与绕数定义本征值约束区域；在单环系统（unicyclic systems）中建立绕数与有序本征值指标的关系；在多环系统（multicyclic systems）中统一并推广了多个先前的不等式，并证明了Uhl-Seifert椭圆猜想。

papers.title: Stable magnetic nanodomains engineered via Ga+-ion irradiation for deterministic sequential switching
papers.abstract: Precise control of magnetic domain formation at the nanoscale remains constrained by stochastic defect-mediated and unstable pinning, limiting scalability and reproducibility in spintronic architectures. Here we demonstrate that spatially engineered anisotropy gradients provide a deterministic alternative. Using focused Ga+-ion irradiation, we pattern magnetic energy landscapes containing nanoscale "anisotropy wells" that confine magnetic domain walls and enable bidirectional sequential switching without reliance on difficult-to-control material disorder. An analytical framework describing domain-wall energetics in graded anisotropy profiles yields predictive design rules for depinning and stability, which are supported by micromagnetic simulations and experiments. We realize programmable multi-domain configurations in continuous ferromagnetic films and demonstrate robust, reproducible switching of 750 nm regions, while first results for 100 nm are shown, approaching the theoretical limit set by the domain-wall width. By replacing unstable pinning with engineered energy landscapes, this anisotropy landscape establishes a scalable materials strategy for deterministic magnetic-state programming and opens a pathway toward dense, energy-efficient spintronic and reconfigurable magnetic nanodevices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论+模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“micromagnetic simulations and experiments”以及“analytical framework”。；研究对象：通过Ga+离子辐照在连续铁磁薄膜中人工构建的纳米尺度“各向异性势阱”及其对磁畴壁的钉扎与可控翻转行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过空间工程化的各向异性梯度（而非依赖材料本征缺陷）可以实现纳米磁畴的确定性、可重复的双向顺序翻转，并成功在750 nm区域实现稳定编程，100 nm区域展示初步结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过空间工程化的各向异性梯度（而非依赖材料本征缺陷）可以实现纳米磁畴的确定性、可重复的双向顺序翻转，并成功在750 nm区域实现稳定编程，100 nm区域展示初步结果。；创新点：用人工设计的各向异性能量景观替代传统依赖随机缺陷或不可控钉扎的磁畴调控方式，实现了可预测、可扩展的确定性磁态编程，为自旋电子学器件提供了可规模化材料策略。
papers.method_zh: 聚焦Ga+离子辐照技术（用于图案化各向异性能量景观）、微磁学模拟、解析理论框架（描述梯度各向异性剖面中畴壁能量与退钉扎条件）以及实验验证。

papers.title: Critical quench dynamics of Wegner's $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge model: a geometric perspective
papers.abstract: Wegner's $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge model is the earliest formulation of pure lattice gauge theory and predicts the topological nature of the confinement-deconfinement transition. In three dimensions ($D=3$), the equilibrium critical behavior of the model is understood in terms of geometrically defined objects, namely loop excitations and Fortuin-Kasteleyn (FK) clusters. This work investigates the critical quench dynamics of this model from a geometric perspective, following quenches from both a high-temperature percolation phase and the zero-temperature ground state. Using time-dependent finite-size scaling analysis, we find that the critical non-equilibrium relaxation of the percolation order parameter is governed by a dynamical exponent $z_{\rm p} \simeq 2.6$, consistent with that associated with the energy density, $z_{\rm c}$. Importantly, the value of $z_{\rm p}$ is robust with respect to the initial quench condition and the choice of geometrical objects. Furthermore, we provide a detailed characterization of the kinetics of different geometrical objects during the evolution from the percolation phase. Notably, we observe that the quench dynamics obeys dynamic scaling in terms of a growing lengthscale, $ξ_{\rm p}(t) \sim t^{1/z_{\rm p}}$, despite the absence of a local order parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：geometric perspective、time-dependent finite-size scaling analysis、dynamic scaling。；研究对象：Wegner的$\mathbb{Z}_2$规范模型在三维（$D=3$）中的临界淬火动力学，特别是从几何视角研究禁闭-退禁闭相变中的非平衡弛豫行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 临界非平衡弛豫由动力学指数$z_{\rm p} \simeq 2.6$支配，该指数与能量密度对应的动力学指数$z_{\rm c}$一致，且对初始淬火条件和几何对象的选择具有鲁棒性；尽管缺乏局域序参量，淬火动力学仍遵循以增长长度尺度$\xi_{\rm p}(t) \sim t^{1/z_{\rm p}}$为特征的动态标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：临界非平衡弛豫由动力学指数$z_{\rm p} \simeq 2.6$支配，该指数与能量密度对应的动力学指数$z_{\rm c}$一致，且对初始淬火条件和几何对象的选择具有鲁棒性；尽管缺乏局域序参量，淬火动力学仍遵循以增长长度尺度$\xi_{\rm p}(t) \sim t^{1/z_{\rm p}}$为特征的动态标度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用时间依赖的有限尺寸标度分析（time-dependent finite-size scaling analysis），从高温渗流相和零温基态两种初始条件进行淬火，并基于几何对象（环激发和Fortuin-Kasteleyn团簇）分析动力学。

papers.title: Effective increase of a superconducting critical temperature in a high-entropy electron mixture
papers.abstract: We show theoretically that a superconducting critical temperature can be effectively increased in a high-entropy mixture of electrons belonging to conduction and valence bands. In order to employ the entropy of mixing into the superconducting phase dynamics, we suggest to use a metallic trap that removes quasiparticle excitations from the superconductor. This makes the concentration of Cooper pairs a dynamic variable of the entropy of mixing, and thus affects the Ginzburg-Landau functional of the superconductor effectively reducing the first expansion coefficient or, in other words, increasing the critical temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show theoretically、Ginzburg-Landau functional。；研究对象：高熵电子混合物中的超导临界温度提升现象，具体涉及导带和价带电子混合形成的超导体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在高熵电子混合物中引入金属陷阱移除准粒子激发，使库珀对浓度成为混合熵的动态变量，从而有效降低金兹堡-朗道泛函的第一展开系数，即提高超导临界温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在高熵电子混合物中引入金属陷阱移除准粒子激发，使库珀对浓度成为混合熵的动态变量，从而有效降低金兹堡-朗道泛函的第一展开系数，即提高超导临界温度。；创新点：提出将混合熵引入超导相动力学，通过动态调控库珀对浓度来有效提升超导临界温度，而非依赖传统材料组分或压力等静态手段。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于金兹堡-朗道（Ginzburg-Landau）理论框架，引入混合熵对超导相动力学的影响，并建议使用金属陷阱作为调控手段。

papers.title: Thermodynamic signatures of a field-induced ordered intermediate phase in Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$
papers.abstract: The honeycomb cobaltate Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$ has recently been proposed as a candidate material for hosting field-induced quantum spin liquid (QSL) behavior. Here, we present a comprehensive thermodynamic study of its low-temperature, high-field phase diagram using magnetization, specific heat, and magnetocaloric-effect measurements down to 1 K. In zero field, we observe a weak residual moment that provides further insight into the nature of the magnetic ground state. For in-plane magnetic fields ($B \parallel a^*$), we identify three field-induced transitions at $B_{c1} \simeq 6$ T, $B_{c2} \simeq 7.8$ T, and $B_{c3} \simeq 10.4$ T. The magnetic Grüneisen parameter and specific heat reveal clear thermodynamic signatures of these successive phase transitions enclosing two intermediate phases. Contrary to expectations for a field-induced QSL, the phase between $B_{c2}$ and $B_{c3}$ lacks enhanced magnetic entropy but instead shows behavior consistent with a distinct ordered state. Above $B_{c3}$, the absence of additional anomalies indicates a crossover to a conventional spin-polarized regime. Our results place stringent thermodynamic constraints on the proposed QSL scenario in Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$, calling for further microscopic investigations to establish the precise nature of the field-induced phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用磁化率、比热和磁卡效应测量”等实验手段。；研究对象：蜂窝状钴氧化物 Na₂Co₂TeO₆ 在磁场诱导下的低温相图，特别是其可能存在的量子自旋液体（QSL）行为及中间有序相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在面内磁场下，Na₂Co₂TeO₆ 在约 6 T、7.8 T 和 10.4 T 处出现三个场致相变，形成两个中间相。其中 Bc2 至 Bc3 之间的相并非预期的场致量子自旋液体，而是一个具有明确有序特征的相；高于 Bc3 后体系进入常规的自旋极化态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在面内磁场下，Na₂Co₂TeO₆ 在约 6 T、7.8 T 和 10.4 T 处出现三个场致相变，形成两个中间相。其中 Bc2 至 Bc3 之间的相并非预期的场致量子自旋液体，而是一个具有明确有序特征的相；高于 Bc3 后体系进入常规的自旋极化态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过低至 1 K 的磁化率、比热和磁卡效应测量，系统研究低温高磁场下的热力学性质，并利用磁格吕奈森参数分析相变特征。

papers.title: Layer-dependent Landé $g$-factors of electrons, holes, and excitons in two-dimensional Ruddlesden-Popper lead halide perovskites
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional Ruddlesden-Popper lead halide perovskites provide a valuable platform for tailoring charge and spin properties through quantum confinement and reduced symmetry. While the electron and hole Landé $g$-factors in bulk lead halide perovskites exhibit a universal dependence on the band gap energy, their evolution in two-dimensional perovskites has remained largely unexplored. Here, the Zeeman splittings of electrons and holes in (PEA)$_2$MA$_{n-1}$Pb$_n$I$_{3n+1}$ perovskites with the number of inorganic layers ovarying in the range $n=1,...,8$ are measured by means of the spin-flip Raman scattering and time-resolved Kerr rotation magneto-optical techniques. A systematic evolution of the electron and hole $g$-factors with decreasing layer thickness, which deviates from the universal bulk behavior and reveals confinement-driven trends similar to those observed in perovskite nanocrystals, is found. The experimental results are in good qualitative agreement with empirical tight-binding calculations.
