The exciton $g$-factors are evaluated from the Zeeman splittings of the exciton resonances in reflectivity measured in pulsed magnetic fields up to 55~T. These results provide comprehensive insight into the spin properties of two-dimensional lead halide perovskites and establish them as a tunable platform for engineering spin-dependent phenomena in quantum-confined semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“measured by means of the spin-flip Raman scattering and time-resolved Kerr rotation magneto-optical techniques”，以及“experimental results are in good qualitative agreement with empirical tight-binding calculations”。；研究对象：二维Ruddlesden-Popper铅卤钙钛矿（(PEA)₂MAₙ₋₁PbₙI₃ₙ₊₁，无机层数n=1至8）中电子、空穴和激子的Landé g因子及其随层厚的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现电子和空穴的g因子随层厚减小呈现系统性演化，偏离了块体铅卤钙钛矿中g因子与带隙能量的普适关系，展现出类似钙钛矿纳米晶中的量子限域驱动趋势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现电子和空穴的g因子随层厚减小呈现系统性演化，偏离了块体铅卤钙钛矿中g因子与带隙能量的普适关系，展现出类似钙钛矿纳米晶中的量子限域驱动趋势。；创新点：首次系统揭示了二维Ruddlesden-Popper铅卤钙钛矿中电子、空穴和激子g因子随层厚（量子限域程度）的演化规律，并指出其偏离块体材料的普适行为，为在量子限域半导体中工程化自旋相关现象提供了可调谐平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用自旋翻转拉曼散射和时间分辨Kerr旋转磁光技术测量电子和空穴的塞曼分裂；利用高达55 T的脉冲磁场测量反射光谱中激子共振的塞曼分裂以评估激子g因子。理论上采用经验紧束缚模型进行计算并与实验结果进行定性对比。

papers.title: Markov State Model for the forced unfolding of a small peptide
papers.abstract: In typical single-molecule force spectroscopy experiments the mechanical unfolding of molecular complexes or biomolecules is studied applying a force ramp to one end of the system while the other end is kept fixed in space. The computational counterpart of this type of experiments can routinely be performed using molecular dynamics simulations with atomistic resolution. However, due to the large difference in time scales often coarse graining procedures are applied in the simulations. Most of the applied techniques do not allow to follow the atomistic details of the relevant conformational transitions due to the structural simplifications used to speed up the simulations. Here, we apply an earlier developed dynamic coarse graining technique based on Markov state modeling to a model peptidic system that does not unfold in a simple two-state manner. Using the donor-acceptor distances of the helical hydrogen bonds as collective variables and performing a dimension reduction technique allows us to construct a Markov model of the unfolding process that correctly represents the microscopic behavior of the system. The chosen example shows that the method can be used to mimick the mechanical unfolding process of systems for which the end-to-end distance does not provide a sufficient order parameter and that do not unfold in a simple cooperative manner.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Markov state modeling、molecular dynamics simulations、dynamic coarse graining technique。；研究对象：一个小肽（model peptidic system）在单分子力谱实验中的机械去折叠过程，特别是其去折叠行为并非简单的两态过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过基于马尔可夫状态模型的动态粗粒化方法，可以正确模拟该小肽的机械去折叠微观行为，即使其端到端距离不是充分的序参量，且去折叠并非简单协同过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过基于马尔可夫状态模型的动态粗粒化方法，可以正确模拟该小肽的机械去折叠微观行为，即使其端到端距离不是充分的序参量，且去折叠并非简单协同过程。；创新点：该方法能够处理端到端距离不足以描述去折叠过程、且去折叠行为非简单协同的系统，从而在粗粒化模拟中保留原子尺度的构象转变细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于马尔可夫状态模型的动态粗粒化技术，以螺旋氢键的供体-受体距离作为集体变量，并结合降维技术构建去折叠过程的马尔可夫模型。

papers.title: Equidistant resonance jumps in superconducting coplanar resonators driven by Abrikosov vortices
papers.abstract: Superconducting coplanar resonators are key building blocks of cryogenic microwave circuits, yet their performance in perpendicular magnetic fields is ultimately limited by Abrikosov vortices. In this work we investigate the dependence of the transmission parameter $S_{21}$ of niobium quarter-wave coplanar resonators on perpendicular magnetic fields up to 40 Oe and at temperatures between 18 mK and 5 K. Beyond the reversible Meissner regime, the entire resonance peak exhibits abrupt, staircase-like jumps as a function of magnetic field. Upon reversal of the field sweep, these jumps form an almost equidistant series with spacing 1.7-1.8 Oe, which, in agreement with theoretical estimates, we interpret as signatures of multiple-vortex entry and exit events. Additionally, we observe the non-proportional responses of the resonant frequency and the internal quality factor that indicate a complex contribution of vortex and antivortex configurations. We believe that our results will stimulate further studies of large vortex-antivortex systems, explicitly accounting for their discrete nature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验测量（“investigate the dependence of the transmission parameter $S_{21}$”）、实验条件（磁场最高40 Oe，温度18 mK至5 K）以及观测到的现象（“staircase-like jumps”）。；研究对象：超导共面谐振器（niobium quarter-wave coplanar resonators）在垂直磁场中由Abrikosov涡旋驱动的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在可逆Meissner区之外，谐振峰的透射参数$S_{21}$随磁场出现阶梯状跳变；磁场回扫时，这些跳变形成间距约1.7-1.8 Oe的准等距序列，被解释为多涡旋进入和退出事件的标志。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在可逆Meissner区之外，谐振峰的透射参数$S_{21}$随磁场出现阶梯状跳变；磁场回扫时，这些跳变形成间距约1.7-1.8 Oe的准等距序列，被解释为多涡旋进入和退出事件的标志。；创新点：首次在超导共面谐振器中观测到由Abrikosov涡旋驱动的准等距共振跳变，并揭示了涡旋与反涡旋构型对谐振频率和内品质因子的非比例响应，强调了离散涡旋-反涡旋系统的复杂贡献。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了铌四分之一波长共面谐振器的传输参数$S_{21}$随垂直磁场（0-40 Oe）和温度（18 mK至5 K）的变化关系，并结合理论估计对跳变间距进行了解释。

papers.title: Short-time critical dynamics in the classical cubic dimer model
papers.abstract: The classical dimer model on the cubic lattice hosts a columnar ordered phase and a disordered Coulomb phase, separated by a continuous phase transition that lies beyond the conventional Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson paradigm. While its equilibrium critical properties have been extensively studied, the nonequilibrium critical dynamics of this model--particularly in the short-time regime--remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the short-time critical dynamics near the transition using large-scale Monte Carlo simulations. By quenching the system from both ordered and disordered initial states with vanishing initial correlation length, we analyze the scaling behaviors of the order parameter and its time correlation function in the short-time stage. From these scaling behaviors, we accurately determine the critical temperature $T_c = 0.672(1)$ and the static critical exponent $β/ν= 0.581(5)$ according to the scaling theory of the short-time dynamics. These results are in excellent agreement with previous equilibrium studies. Moreover, we extract the dynamic critical exponent $z = 1.92(1)$ and, notably, find a negative critical initial slip exponent $θ= -1.052(5)$. This unusual negative value contrasts sharply with the positive $θ$ typically observed in conventional critical dynamics. We attribute this anomalous behavior to the combined effects of the emergent SO(5) symmetry at criticality and the local U(1) gauge constraint (Gauss law), which enforces a conserved diffusive dynamics and enhances fluctuations in the short-time regime. Our results provide the first comprehensive characterization of nonequilibrium short-time criticality in the three-dimensional dimer model, shedding new light on the universal dynamical features of phase transitions beyond the Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Monte Carlo simulations、large-scale、scaling analysis）；研究对象：三维立方晶格上的经典二聚体模型（classical dimer model on the cubic lattice），具体研究其从柱状有序相到无序库仑相的连续相变附近的非平衡短时临界动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 精确确定了临界温度 \(T_c = 0.672(1)\) 和静态临界指数 \(\beta/\nu = 0.581(5)\)，并首次提取出动力学临界指数 \(z = 1.92(1)\) 以及一个反常的负临界初始滑移指数 \(\theta = -1.052(5)\)，该负值归因于临界点涌现的SO(5)对称性和局域U(1)规范约束（高斯定律）的共同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：精确确定了临界温度 \(T_c = 0.672(1)\) 和静态临界指数 \(\beta/\nu = 0.581(5)\)，并首次提取出动力学临界指数 \(z = 1.92(1)\) 以及一个反常的负临界初始滑移指数 \(\theta = -1.052(5)\)，该负值归因于临界点涌现的SO(5)对称性和局域U(1)规范约束（高斯定律）的共同作用。；创新点：首次系统表征了三维二聚体模型中的非平衡短时临界性，发现了与常规临界动力学中正\(\theta\)截然不同的负初始滑移指数，揭示了超越朗道-金兹堡-威尔逊范式的相变中新的普适动力学特征。

papers.title: Observation of flat-bottom U-shaped energy gap in high-Tc nickelate (La,Pr)3Ni2O7 thin films
papers.abstract: The discovery of high transition temperature (high-Tc) superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper (R-P) bilayer nickelates under high pressure has stimulated extensive work to understand the underlying mechanism and search for superconductors with higher Tc. The recent realization of superconductivity in R-P bilayer nickelate thin films with onset Tc above 40 K at ambient-pressure enables the use of a wide array of powerful experimental tools to investigate the unconventional high-Tc superconductivity in bilayer nickelates. Here, using ultra-low temperature scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy (STM/S) and electrical transport study, we report the first successful observation of an energy-symmetric, flat-bottom U-shaped gap with zero residual density of states around the Fermi level in the high-Tc nickelate (La,Pr)3Ni2O7 thin film grown on SrLaAlO4 substrate. Before and after STM/S studies, transport measurements on the same sample reveal consistent superconducting behaviors showing zero resistance, with an onset Tc above 40 K and zero resistance Tc above 20 K. The tunneling spectra exhibit highly unconventional temperature evolution, characterized by a rapid filling of the U-shaped energy gap to a V-shaped gap as the temperature increases. Furthermore, the U-shaped energy gap is reduced under a c-axis magnetic field of 14 T. The energy-symmetric U-shaped gap, taken together with its dependence on magnetic field and temperature, is consistent with the behavior of a superconducting gap, suggesting a nodeless gap function at ultra-low temperatures. Our findings shed new lights on the nature of high-Tc superconductivity and provide an encouraging and thought-provoking hint for a local superconductivity with Tc above liquid nitrogen boiling temperature in nickelate superconductors at ambient or zero pressure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy (STM/S)、electrical transport study、ultra-low temperature。；研究对象：高压Ruddlesden-Popper (R-P) 双层镍酸盐(La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜中的高温超导能隙。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在常压超导转变起始温度（onset Tc）高于40 K的(La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜中，首次观测到费米能级附近能量对称、平底U形且零剩余态密度的超导能隙，该能隙在温度升高时迅速填充为V形，并在14 T c轴磁场下被抑制，表明在极低温下存在无节点能隙函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在常压超导转变起始温度（onset Tc）高于40 K的(La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜中，首次观测到费米能级附近能量对称、平底U形且零剩余态密度的超导能隙，该能隙在温度升高时迅速填充为V形，并在14 T c轴磁场下被抑制，表明在极低温下存在无节点能隙函数。；创新点：首次在常压R-P双层镍酸盐薄膜中直接观测到U形超导能隙及其随温度和磁场的演化行为，为理解该体系的高温超导机制提供了关键谱学证据，并暗示可能存在液氮沸点以上的局域超导性。
papers.method_zh: 超低温扫描隧道显微镜/谱（STM/S）和电输运测量。

papers.title: A Finite-State Gibbs Construction from a Recognition Cost
papers.abstract: On a finite outcome space, the canonical Gibbs distribution is usually obtained by maximizing Shannon entropy at fixed mean of an externally supplied energy functional. This paper studies the finite-state consequences of a ratio-cost construction instead: after adopting the normalized d'Alembert degree-two closure called the Recognition Composition Law (RCL), with unit log-curvature calibration at the reference ratio, the continuous nontrivial positive branch is $J(x)=\tfrac12(x+x^{-1})-1=\cosh(\log x)-1$. Given the induced cost vector $X_ω=J(r_ω)$, multinomial counting and convex duality recover the finite-state Gibbs weights and the identity $F_{\mathrm{R}}(q)-F_{\mathrm{R}}(p)=T_{\mathrm{R}}\,D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q\Vert p)$; the entropy-maximization steps are classical once the cost is fixed. New technical content includes a non-asymptotic Stirling bound and soft-shell constrained-type theorems for real-valued costs. A three-state example compares the Gibbs law to squared-log, affinity-as-energy, and Tsallis alternatives at the same cost vector and mean-cost constraint, with sample-size power calculations at fixed RCL ground truth. The framework is conditional on axioms (A1)--(A3) and restricted to finite outcome spaces with strictly positive weights; it does not derive the composition law from a more primitive principle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Gibbs分布、熵最大化、凸对偶、非渐近Stirling界。；研究对象：有限状态空间上的统计物理系统，具体研究基于比值代价（ratio-cost）构造的Gibbs分布，而非传统能量泛函。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用归一化的d’Alembert二次闭包（称为识别组合律RCL）并设定参考比值的单位对数曲率校准后，连续非平凡正分支为 \( J(x)=\tfrac12(x+x^{-1})-1=\cosh(\log x)-1 \)。由此诱导的代价向量 \( X_\omega=J(r_\omega) \) 通过多项计数和凸对偶可恢复有限状态Gibbs权重，并满足恒等式 \( F_{\mathrm{R}}(q)-F_{\mathrm{R}}(p)=T_{\mathrm{R}}\,D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q\Vert p) \)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用归一化的d’Alembert二次闭包（称为识别组合律RCL）并设定参考比值的单位对数曲率校准后，连续非平凡正分支为 \( J(x)=\tfrac12(x+x^{-1})-1=\cosh(\log x)-1 \)。由此诱导的代价向量 \( X_\omega=J(r_\omega) \) 通过多项计数和凸对偶可恢复有限状态Gibbs权重，并满足恒等式 \( F_{\mathrm{R}}(q)-F_{\mathrm{R}}(p)=T_{\mathrm{R}}\,D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q\Vert p) \)。；创新点：提出了一种基于比值代价（而非传统能量泛函）的有限状态Gibbs分布构造框架，并给出了非渐近Stirling界和实值代价的软壳约束型定理。摘要未突出说明与已有Gibbs构造方法的更广泛对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：采用RCL构造比值代价，结合多项计数、凸对偶、非渐近Stirling界以及实值代价的软壳约束型定理；并与平方对数、亲和性能量、Tsallis等替代方案进行三态示例比较。

papers.title: Topological property of graphene with triangular array of nanoholes
papers.abstract: The nontrivial band topology for graphene with regular arrays of nanoholes with $C_{6v}$ symmetry is investigated theoretically. For the case of $3\sqrt{3} \times 3\sqrt{3}$ triangular array of nanoholes, we find an energy gap at $Γ$ point around the Fermi level associated with a band inversion which induces change in parity indices, whereas deep below the Fermi level there are a bunch of valence bands characterized as obstructed atomic limit (OAL) which also accommodate imbalance in parity indices. This band structure renders the gap at the Fermi level topologically trivial and carrying no edge states, while the nontrivial band topology of the OAL manifests in two flat bands in the ribbon structure associated with localized electronic states at ribbon edges. The present results exhibit rich topological behaviors in graphene derivatives waiting for explorations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“theoretically investigated”、“band inversion”、“parity indices”、“ribbon structure”。；研究对象：具有C₆v对称性、三角排列纳米孔的石墨烯体系，具体研究了3√3 × 3√3三角排列纳米孔的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在费米能级附近的Γ点处存在能隙，但该能隙是拓扑平庸的，不携带边缘态；而费米能级以下的一组价带具有受阻原子极限（OAL）特征，其非平庸拓扑性质在纳米带结构中表现为两个平带，对应局域在带边缘的电子态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在费米能级附近的Γ点处存在能隙，但该能隙是拓扑平庸的，不携带边缘态；而费米能级以下的一组价带具有受阻原子极限（OAL）特征，其非平庸拓扑性质在纳米带结构中表现为两个平带，对应局域在带边缘的电子态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析能带拓扑性质，包括计算宇称指标、分析能带反转、以及构建纳米带结构研究边缘态。

papers.title: Non-Relativistic Spin-Orbit Interaction in Triplet Superconductors: Edelstein Effect and Spin Pumping by Electric Fields
papers.abstract: Non-relativistic momentum-dependent spin splitting, as observed in collinear altermagnets and non-collinear $p$-wave magnets, provides exciting avenues for controlling spin dynamics. Here, we reveal a distinct form of non-relativistic ``spin-orbit coupling" in triplet superconductors by demonstrating that the triplet order parameter induces a wave-vector-dependent spin texture of Bogoliubov quasiparticles, thereby entangling their orbital and spin motions. Even in the absence of relativistic spin-orbit coupling, this intertwining of spin and orbital motion allows an electric field to generate spin polarization in a $p$-wave superconductor -- that is, an Edelstein effect. Building on this mechanism, we propose an efficient scheme for the nonlinear generation of a DC spin current via electric near fields, driven by AC spin polarization and electron velocity. This general principle offers a powerful route for generating and manipulating spin currents in unconventional superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrating”、“propose”、“offers a powerful route”等理论推导和方案提出的表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：三态超导体（triplet superconductors）中的非相对论性自旋-轨道耦合效应，具体涉及p波超导体中的Edelstein效应和电场驱动的自旋泵浦。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三态超导体中，即使没有相对论性自旋-轨道耦合，三态序参量本身即可诱导Bogoliubov准粒子的波矢依赖自旋织构，从而产生类似自旋-轨道耦合的效应，使电场能够产生自旋极化（Edelstein效应），并进一步通过交流自旋极化和电子速度实现直流自旋电流的非线性产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三态超导体中，即使没有相对论性自旋-轨道耦合，三态序参量本身即可诱导Bogoliubov准粒子的波矢依赖自旋织构，从而产生类似自旋-轨道耦合的效应，使电场能够产生自旋极化（Edelstein效应），并进一步通过交流自旋极化和电子速度实现直流自旋电流的非线性产生。；创新点：揭示了三态超导体中一种全新的非相对论性“自旋-轨道耦合”机制，该机制不依赖于传统相对论性自旋-轨道耦合，而是源于三态序参量本身对自旋和轨道运动的纠缠，并基于此提出了利用近场电场高效产生直流自旋电流的方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于三态超导体的序参量对称性推导准粒子自旋织构，并利用电场与自旋-轨道纠缠的耦合机制提出自旋电流产生方案。

papers.title: Local distortions as a source of piezoelectric/stiffness decoupling in B-doped AlScN
papers.abstract: We present a first-principles analysis of the wurtzite pseudo-ternary (Al,Sc,B)N to elucidate the structural origin of a decoupling between stiffness $C_{33}$ and piezoelectric response $e_{33}$ upon boron incorporation, using DFT-relaxed 100-atom special quasirandom structures across a broad composition range. Pair distribution function analysis reveals interstitial threefold-coordinated boron atoms that have displaced from the tetrahedral cation site. Direct structural analysis establishes their preferential orientation along the $c$-axis and identifies a scandium-activated creation mechanism. The vertical coordination asymmetry of each cation is quantified through a site-specific axial asymmetry ratio (AAR), showing that boron incorporation progressively symmetrizes the Sc environment. Correlation with Born effective charges demonstrates that this symmetrization is the mechanism behind the piezoelectric enhancement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles analysis”、“DFT-relaxed”、“special quasirandom structures”。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是wurtzite结构伪三元(Al,Sc,B)N体系，物理现象是硼掺杂导致的刚度C33与压电响应e33之间的解耦机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硼原子掺入后形成偏离四面体阳离子位的三配位间隙原子，并优先沿c轴取向；同时硼的引入使Sc周围环境逐渐对称化，这种对称化通过影响Born有效电荷成为压电增强的微观机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硼原子掺入后形成偏离四面体阳离子位的三配位间隙原子，并优先沿c轴取向；同时硼的引入使Sc周围环境逐渐对称化，这种对称化通过影响Born有效电荷成为压电增强的微观机制。；创新点：首次通过直接结构分析揭示了硼在(Al,Sc,B)N中形成三配位间隙缺陷及其沿c轴择优取向，并定量建立了Sc环境对称化与压电增强之间的关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，对宽组分范围内的100原子特殊准随机结构（SQS）进行结构弛豫，并结合对分布函数（PDF）分析和轴向不对称比（AAR）定量表征。

papers.title: p-Wave Orbital Angular Momentum Texture in a Chiral Crystal
papers.abstract: The spin and orbital angular momentum (SAM and OAM) are conceptually analogous, yet their roles in condensed matter systems have not been often treated on equal footing. While SAM has been extensively explored, OAM has long been regarded as quenched in crystalline environments and thus largely overlooked. Recent experimental and theoretical advances, however, have demonstrated that OAM can drive a variety of novel electronic phenomena, highlighting the importance of probing OAM textures in the electronic band structure. Here, we investigate the momentum-space OAM texture of (TaSe4)2I, a one-dimensional chiral crystal. Using circular-dichroism angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (CD-ARPES), we uncover a p-wave OAM texture accompanied by OAM dipole structures. This orbital p-wave texture is intimately connected to, and thus controllable by the chirality of the host lattice. Complementary spin-resolved ARPES measurements and first-principles calculations reveal that the OAM polarization overwhelmingly dominates the low-energy electronic properties of (TaSe4)2I, far exceeding the SAM polarization. These observations represent the experimental verification of a new type of OAM texture in crystalline materials. Most importantly, these findings underscore a promising material platform for spinless orbitronics applications and lay the foundation for realizing multipolar OAM textures-orbital counterparts of the spin texture in unconventional magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以第一性原理计算）。判断依据：关键词包括“circular-dichroism angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (CD-ARPES)”、“spin-resolved ARPES measurements”、“first-principles calculations”。；研究对象：一维手性晶体(TaSe4)2I中的动量空间轨道角动量（OAM）织构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在(TaSe4)2I中发现了p波轨道角动量织构及伴随的OAM偶极结构，且该织构与晶体的手性紧密相关并受其调控。OAM极化在低能电子性质中占据绝对主导地位，远超自旋角动量（SAM）极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在(TaSe4)2I中发现了p波轨道角动量织构及伴随的OAM偶极结构，且该织构与晶体的手性紧密相关并受其调控。OAM极化在低能电子性质中占据绝对主导地位，远超自旋角动量（SAM）极化。；创新点：实验验证了晶体材料中一种新型的OAM织构（p波OAM织构），并揭示了OAM极化在低能电子态中远超SAM极化的主导作用，为无自旋轨道电子学（spinless orbitronics）提供了有前景的材料平台。
papers.method_zh: 圆二色性角分辨光电子能谱（CD-ARPES）探测动量空间OAM织构；自旋分辨ARPES测量自旋极化；第一性原理计算进行理论验证。

papers.title: Quantum Geometry-Driven Nonlinear Spin Currents in Floquet Non-Hermitian Altermagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnets are rapidly emerging as a highly promising platform for spintronics, yet dynamically controlling their spin responses remains a fundamental challenge. In this work, we demonstrate that introducing periodic optical driving and non-Hermiticity provides a powerful route to achieve tunable control over these systems. We derive a general analytical expression for nonlinear spin currents in non-Hermitian phases with a spectral line gap, revealing that the intrinsic response cleanly separates into quantum metric, Berry curvature, and Berry connection dipole contributions. Applying this formalism to a Floquet non-Hermitian $d$-wave altermagnet, we uncover that the nonlinear spin conductivity is overwhelmingly dominated by the bare quantum metric. Furthermore, we show that the optical field's polarization can actively tune -- and even strictly reverse -- the direction of both longitudinal and transverse spin currents. Our work establishes a quantum geometric framework for the optical manipulation of nonlinear spin transport in advanced magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive a general analytical expression、applying this formalism、our work establishes a quantum geometric framework。；研究对象：Floquet非厄米d波交变磁体（altermagnet）中的非线性自旋电流，以及周期性光驱动和非厄米性对自旋响应的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性自旋电导率主要由裸量子度量（bare quantum metric）主导，且光场的偏振方向可以有效调控甚至严格反转纵向和横向自旋电流的方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性自旋电导率主要由裸量子度量（bare quantum metric）主导，且光场的偏振方向可以有效调控甚至严格反转纵向和横向自旋电流的方向。；创新点：建立了用于光学操控先进磁性材料中非线性自旋输运的量子几何框架，揭示了量子度量在非线性自旋电流中的主导作用，并展示了通过光偏振动态调控自旋电流方向的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 推导了具有谱线能隙的非厄米相中非线性自旋电流的一般解析表达式，并将该形式应用于Floquet非厄米d波交变磁体模型，分析了量子度量、贝里曲率和贝里连接偶极子对响应的贡献。

papers.title: Entropy Production from Spin--Vibrational Coupling in Endohedral-Fullerene Qubits Encapsulated in Suspended Carbon Nanotubes
papers.abstract: Hybrid carbon nanotube-fullerene architectures provide a controllable platform for studying irreversibility and information flow in structured quantum environments. We analyze entropy generation in a system where paramagnetic endohedral fullerenes, such as N@C$_{60}$ and P@C$_{60}$, are encapsulated inside a suspended carbon nanotube (CNT) resonator, with selected multi-level fullerene spin states forming an effective qubit coupled to quantized CNT flexural modes. Building on prior work on fullerene-filled CNTs, spin-phonon control in suspended nanotubes, and phase-space propagators for damped driven oscillators, we develop a hybrid open-system model combining driven quantum Brownian motion of the CNT with an effective Jaynes-Cummings spin-vibrational interaction. The resonator dynamics are represented by a Wigner function whose evolution is written analytically in terms of the initial Wigner distribution and a Gaussian propagator. This phase-space description separates drive-induced displacement, diffusion, and damping, and connects these processes directly to entropy flow. The coupled spin-mechanical dynamics are embedded in a Lindblad master equation including mechanical damping, spin relaxation, pure dephasing, and thermally activated excitation. Within this framework we derive the entropy balance, identify entropy flux and non-negative entropy production, and examine how spin-vibrational hybridization redistributes irreversibility between coherent exchange and dissipative channels. We show that magnetic-gradient-enhanced spin-phonon coupling, resonant driving, and moderate thermal occupation produce crossovers between oscillator-dominated and spin-dominated entropy-production regimes. The framework provides a basis for using CNT-PEF hybrids as nanoscale platforms to study nonequilibrium quantum thermodynamics, decoherence, and information loss in vibrational environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：hybrid open-system model、Lindblad master equation、phase-space propagators、entropy balance。；研究对象：内嵌富勒烯（如N@C₆₀和P@C₆₀）封装在悬浮碳纳米管谐振器中的混合体系，具体研究自旋-振动耦合导致的熵产生与不可逆性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-振动杂化会在相干交换通道与耗散通道之间重新分配不可逆性；通过磁梯度增强的自旋-声子耦合、共振驱动和中等热占据，可实现从振荡器主导到自旋主导的熵产生机制之间的交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-振动杂化会在相干交换通道与耗散通道之间重新分配不可逆性；通过磁梯度增强的自旋-声子耦合、共振驱动和中等热占据，可实现从振荡器主导到自旋主导的熵产生机制之间的交叉。；创新点：将碳纳米管-内嵌富勒烯杂化体系作为可控平台，系统分析结构化量子环境中自旋-振动耦合导致的熵产生与信息流，并建立从相空间传播子到Lindblad主方程的完整理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 混合开放系统模型：将驱动量子布朗运动（碳纳米管谐振器）与有效Jaynes-Cummings自旋-振动相互作用相结合；采用Wigner函数相空间描述（含高斯传播子解析演化）；嵌入机械阻尼、自旋弛豫、纯退相和热激活激发的Lindblad主方程；推导熵平衡方程并计算熵流与熵产生。

papers.title: Itinerant antiferromagnetism in the antagonistic pair compound Y$_4$Co$_3$Ag
papers.abstract: Low dimensional crystallographic motifs have long been associated with desirable physical properties. The confinement of electrons to low dimensions is thought to enhance quantum fluctuations and may promote correlated phenomena. Here, using the antagonistic pair concept, we add Y to the immiscible Co-Ag pair to discover Y$_4$Co$_3$Ag. This compound adopts a monoclinic $I$2/$m$ structure consisting of Y channels that are filled by one-dimensional zigzag and hexagonal Co chains, which extend along the crystallographic $b$-axis with no nearest neighbor contacts between Co and Ag atoms. Transport, magnetic, and specific heat measurements reveal that Y$_4$Co$_3$Ag orders antiferromagnetically at $T_N=14.9$ K with an effective magnetic moment $μ_{\text{eff}}$ = 1.4 $μ_{\text{B}}$/Co. Specific heat measurements show only a small entropy loss on the order of $0.1\,R\ln2$ associated with magnetic order, and magnetization isotherms, in DC fields up to 70 kOe at 1.8 K and in pulsed fields up to 600 kOe at 500 mK, indicate a small ordered moment of less than 0.2 $μ_B$/Co. Taken together, our results imply the presence of small, itinerant moments and strong fluctuations in Y$_4$Co$_3$Ag, suggesting that Y$_4$Co$_3$Ag may be a promising candidate material to investigate itinerant magnetic interactions in a quasi-one dimensional system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：transport, magnetic, specific heat measurements（输运、磁化、比热测量）。；研究对象：新型化合物Y₄Co₃Ag，一种由互不相溶的Co-Ag对通过添加Y元素合成的准一维反铁磁材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Y₄Co₃Ag在TN=14.9 K处发生反铁磁有序，但有效磁矩（1.4 μB/Co）与有序磁矩（<0.2 μB/Co）差异显著，且磁有序熵损失很小（约0.1 R ln2），表明该体系存在小且巡游的磁矩以及强烈的量子涨落，是研究准一维系统中巡游磁相互作用的候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Y₄Co₃Ag在TN=14.9 K处发生反铁磁有序，但有效磁矩（1.4 μB/Co）与有序磁矩（<0.2 μB/Co）差异显著，且磁有序熵损失很小（约0.1 R ln2），表明该体系存在小且巡游的磁矩以及强烈的量子涨落，是研究准一维系统中巡游磁相互作用的候选材料。；创新点：利用“拮抗对”策略成功合成了Co-Ag这一原本互不相溶的金属对化合物，并发现其准一维Co链结构导致巡游反铁磁性与强涨落共存。
papers.method_zh: 单晶合成（基于“拮抗对”概念）；输运、磁化（直流场最高70 kOe，脉冲场最高600 kOe）和比热测量。

papers.title: Multifractal and Ergodic Properties of Conductance Fluctuations under Strong Disorder
papers.abstract: Understanding the stochastic properties of conductance fluctuations in disordered mesoscopic systems is fundamental to quantum transport. In this work, we investigate the multifractal and ergodic properties of the fictitious time series of conductance in two-dimensional tight-binding models under varying Anderson disorder. Using standard multifractal analysis, we show that conductance fluctuations exhibit a transition from non-ergodic to ergodic behavior as the disorder strength increases, as evidenced by the decay of the conductance correlation function. Remarkably, multifractality persists in both regimes; however, it becomes insensitive to shuffling in the strong-disorder (ergodic) regime, suggesting that distributional effects dominate temporal organization. On the contrary, in the weakly disordered (non-ergodic) regime, long-range correlations play a significant role. These findings are robust against changes in lead geometry (asymmetric vs. symmetric). Our results provide new insights into the interplay between ergodicity, multifractality, and rare events in disordered quantum transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：multifractal analysis、tight-binding models、fictitious time series。；研究对象：二维紧束缚模型在安德森无序下的电导涨落，具体研究其多重分形性和遍历性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着无序强度增加，电导涨落从非遍历行为转变为遍历行为；多重分形性在两个区域均存在，但在强无序（遍历）区域对序列打乱不敏感，表明分布效应主导时间组织，而在弱无序（非遍历）区域长程关联起重要作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着无序强度增加，电导涨落从非遍历行为转变为遍历行为；多重分形性在两个区域均存在，但在强无序（遍历）区域对序列打乱不敏感，表明分布效应主导时间组织，而在弱无序（非遍历）区域长程关联起重要作用。；创新点：揭示了电导涨落中遍历性与多重分形性之间的相互作用，并区分了强无序下分布效应与弱无序下长程关联的不同主导机制。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 使用标准多重分形分析（multifractal analysis）对二维紧束缚模型在可变安德森无序下的电导虚构时间序列进行分析，并通过电导关联函数的衰减判断遍历性转变，同时考察了铅几何结构（非对称 vs. 对称）的影响。

papers.title: Strong universality class in disordered systems
papers.abstract: Disordered systems are very rich laboratories for exploring complex systems. In particular, disordered magnetic systems have been extremely important in the last five decades for understanding a wide range of phenomena. In this work, we use the Edwards-Anderson Hamiltonian to obtain the thermodynamic properties of disordered magnetic systems. In this way, we conduct a systematic investigation of magnetization, correlation functions, order parameter, and fractal dimensions, in function of disorder. In this context, the autocorrelation function for order--parameter fluctuations, introduced by Fisher ( Journal of Mathematical Physics 5, 944322 (1964)), provides an important mathematical framework for understanding the second-order phase transition at equilibrium. However, his analysis is restricted to a Euclidean space of dimension $d$, and an exponent $η$ is introduced to correct the spatial behavior of the correlation function at $T=T_c$. In recent work, Lima et al ( Phys. Rev. E 110, L062107 (2024)) demonstrated that at $T_c$ a fractal analysis is necessary for a complete description of the correlation function. We use Monte Carlo simulations to validate analytical results and to show how disorder alters critical exponents , giving rise to different universality classes. On the other hand, there is a subgroup of critical exponents and fractal dimensions that are invariant with disorder. This subgroup heralds a strong universality class.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算）。判断依据：使用Edwards-Anderson哈密顿量进行理论分析，并通过Monte Carlo模拟验证解析结果。；研究对象：无序磁性系统，具体基于Edwards-Anderson哈密顿量研究其热力学性质，包括磁化、关联函数、序参量及分形维数随无序度的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现存在一组临界指数和分形维数对无序不敏感，即不随无序度改变，这标志着一种“强普适类”的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现存在一组临界指数和分形维数对无序不敏感，即不随无序度改变，这标志着一种“强普适类”的存在。；创新点：揭示了在无序系统中，尽管部分临界指数会随无序度变化，但存在一个子集（包括某些分形维数）对无序具有不变性，从而定义了新的“强普适类”。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架采用Fisher提出的序参量涨落自关联函数，结合Lima等人近期发展的临界点分形分析方法；计算手段为Monte Carlo模拟，用于验证解析结果并展示无序如何改变临界指数。

papers.title: Radio-frequency reflectometry in silicon carbide large-area transistors
papers.abstract: Radio-frequency (RF) reflectometry is widely used for high-bandwidth readout of semiconductor quantum devices at cryogenic temperatures, but its application has mainly been limited to nanoscale structures with relatively small capacitances. Here, we investigate RF readout in a different regime by applying gate-based reflectometry to a large-area silicon carbide transistor with parasitic capacitances orders of magnitude larger than those of typical quantum devices, conditions normally expected to hinder RF readout. We observe a gate-dependent RF response which degrades and eventually vanishes as temperature is lowered, although MOSFET operation in DC transport is maintained down to deep cryogenic temperatures. We attribute this behaviour to impedance changes introduced by carrier freeze-out in the transistor drift region, and propose a modified circuit configuration designed to restore sensitivity under these conditions. These results establish how parasitic pathways and device geometry can limit RF readout, providing insight into the design of scalable cryogenic-CMOS quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“我们应用了栅极基反射测量法”、“我们观察到”、“我们提出”等实验操作和观测结果。；研究对象：大面积碳化硅（SiC）晶体管，以及其中射频反射测量（RF reflectometry）的物理机制。具体研究了在低温下，寄生电容远大于典型量子器件的体系中，射频读出信号的特性及其退化原因。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大面积SiC晶体管中，射频反射测量信号在低温下会退化并最终消失，尽管器件的直流MOSFET输运特性在深低温下依然保持。该现象归因于晶体管漂移区中载流子冻析效应导致的阻抗变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大面积SiC晶体管中，射频反射测量信号在低温下会退化并最终消失，尽管器件的直流MOSFET输运特性在深低温下依然保持。该现象归因于晶体管漂移区中载流子冻析效应导致的阻抗变化。；创新点：将射频反射测量技术从通常应用的纳米级、小电容量子器件，拓展到具有超大寄生电容的大面积晶体管这一“不同”的体系，并揭示了在该体系中限制射频读出的关键物理机制（载流子冻析导致的阻抗变化），为可扩展的低温CMOS量子系统设计提供了新见解。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用了基于栅极的反射测量法（gate-based reflectometry），对大面积SiC晶体管进行射频读出。通过测量不同温度下的射频响应，并结合直流输运特性，分析了信号退化的原因。提出了修改电路配置以恢复灵敏度的方案。

papers.title: Reversible nanoscale patterning of WTe$_2$ with a scanning tunneling microscope
papers.abstract: Manipulating the lattice structure of ferroelectric quantum materials enables their use in low-power electronic devices, including field-effect transistors. WTe$_2$ is a Weyl-semimetal candidate and ferroelectric, both properties arising from the reduced crystal symmetry of its T$_\mathrm{d}$ ground state. The T$_\mathrm{d}$ crystal phase results from a Peierls distortion of the 1T parent structure and an interlayer shift. While experiments in WTe$_2$ have established ferroelectric switching and transient control of the predicted topological phase via ultrafast excitations, persistent electronic changes on the nanometer scale remain elusive. Here, we demonstrate that current pulses applied via scanning tunneling microscopy can both write and erase persistent nanometer-scale patterns on the surface of WTe$_2$. These patterns consist of apparent picometer in-plane and out-of-plane atomic displacements, accompanied by changes to the local density of states. The out-of-plane displacements further modulate the Peierls-like distortion present in WTe$_2$, while the in-plane displacements are indicative of ferroelectric switching. The induced patterns can be repositioned and erased, suggesting a nanoscale handle on the ferroelectric properties of WTe$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了使用扫描隧道显微镜（scanning tunneling microscopy）施加电流脉冲（current pulses）进行实验操作和观测。；研究对象：WTe₂（二碲化钨）的表面。具体而言，研究其铁电性（ferroelectric）和由Peierls畸变导致的T_d相晶体结构，以及如何通过纳米尺度图案化来调控这些性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过扫描隧道显微镜施加电流脉冲，可以在WTe₂表面可逆地写入和擦除纳米尺度的图案。这些图案由皮米量级的原子位移（面内和面外）以及局域态密度的变化构成，其中面内位移指示了铁电开关，面外位移则调制了Peierls畸变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过扫描隧道显微镜施加电流脉冲，可以在WTe₂表面可逆地写入和擦除纳米尺度的图案。这些图案由皮米量级的原子位移（面内和面外）以及局域态密度的变化构成，其中面内位移指示了铁电开关，面外位移则调制了Peierls畸变。；创新点：该工作首次实现了在WTe₂中通过STM进行持久、可逆的纳米尺度图案化，并证明这种图案化可以调控其铁电性和Peierls畸变。此前，WTe₂的铁电开关和瞬态拓扑相控制已有报道，但持久性的纳米尺度电子态变化尚未实现。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）。具体操作是：通过STM针尖施加电流脉冲（current pulses），在WTe₂表面写入和擦除图案，并利用STM同时观测由此引起的原子位移（皮米级）和局域态密度（LDOS）变化。

papers.title: Chemical Origins of Non-Bonded Interactions Within and Between Solids
papers.abstract: Non-bonded interactions govern structure, stability, and function across a wide range of solid-state materials, yet their chemical origins are often difficult to resolve from total energies alone. Here we generalize absolutely localized molecular orbital energy decomposition analysis to quantify and interpret non-bonded interactions within and between solids at the density functional theory level. Across molecular crystals, moiré heterobilayers, and layered perovskite heterostructures, this framework separates lattice-formation energies, interlayer binding energies, and band-structure changes into chemically intuitive contributions from frozen interactions, polarization, and charge transfer. The analysis reveals how dispersion controls polymorph stability in pharmaceutical crystals, how local stacking modulates interlayer coupling in MoS2/WSe2, and how alkali-cation substitution switches the quantum-well character of layered perovskite heterostructures. By connecting emergent solid-state properties to microscopic interaction mechanisms, this framework provides a chemically transparent basis for understanding and designing complex materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“generalize absolutely localized molecular orbital energy decomposition analysis”、“density functional theory level”、“quantify and interpret”。；研究对象：固体材料中的非键相互作用，具体包括分子晶体、莫尔异质双层（如MoS₂/WSe₂）以及层状钙钛矿异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作通过能量分解分析揭示了非键相互作用的化学起源：分散力控制药物晶体的多晶型稳定性、局域堆叠方式调控MoS₂/WSe₂的层间耦合、碱金属阳离子替换可切换层状钙钛矿异质结构的量子阱特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作通过能量分解分析揭示了非键相互作用的化学起源：分散力控制药物晶体的多晶型稳定性、局域堆叠方式调控MoS₂/WSe₂的层间耦合、碱金属阳离子替换可切换层状钙钛矿异质结构的量子阱特性。；创新点：将原本用于分子体系的绝对局域分子轨道能量分解分析推广到周期性固体体系，实现了对固体内部及固体间非键相互作用的定量、化学直观的解析。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的绝对局域分子轨道能量分解分析（ALMO-EDA），将晶格形成能、层间结合能和能带结构变化分解为冻结相互作用、极化和电荷转移等化学直观的贡献。

papers.title: Disorder-driven symmetry suppression by van der Waals planar defects in a magnetic topological insulator
papers.abstract: Magnetic topological insulators offer a platform to control electronic topology through magnetic order, yet reliable routes to tune their properties remain limited. Here, we show that ion irradiation allows to modify the magnetic and the topological properties of the van der Waals magnetic topological insulator MnBi$_2$Te$_4$. Using inert ion beams, intrinsic defects are introduced via collision cascades without chemical doping. We identify two distinct regimes. At low fluence, cation antisite disorder leads to a near-complete redistribution of Bi over cation sites while preserving long-range crystallographic order, accompanied by a transition from $p$-type to $n$-type transport. At high fluence, cation-anion intermixing drives the formation of a previously unreported layer-disordered phase characterized by a high density of van der Waals-specific planar defects, including swapped bilayers. Despite significant structural disorder, the system retains partial periodic order up to high displacement levels. Magnetometry and X-ray spectroscopy show that the Mn high-spin state and antiferromagnetic interactions persist, while magnetic anisotropy is strongly reduced. At the same time, the anomalous Hall response is suppressed by over an order of magnitude, far exceeding the change in magnetization, indicating a direct modification of Berry curvature. These results establish ion irradiation as a means to tune topology through defect engineering and reveal a disorder-driven approach to control symmetry and electronic structure in van der Waals magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：ion irradiation、magnetometry、X-ray spectroscopy、transport measurements。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯磁性拓扑绝缘体MnBi₂Te₄，具体研究离子辐照引入的缺陷对其磁性和拓扑性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 离子辐照可在MnBi₂Te₄中通过碰撞级联引入本征缺陷，在低通量下导致阳离子反位无序并实现p型到n型输运转变；高通量下形成一种此前未报道的层无序相，显著抑制反常霍尔响应（超过一个数量级），直接改变贝里曲率，而磁化强度变化较小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：离子辐照可在MnBi₂Te₄中通过碰撞级联引入本征缺陷，在低通量下导致阳离子反位无序并实现p型到n型输运转变；高通量下形成一种此前未报道的层无序相，显著抑制反常霍尔响应（超过一个数量级），直接改变贝里曲率，而磁化强度变化较小。；创新点：首次展示离子辐照作为一种通过缺陷工程调控拓扑性质的手段，并发现一种由范德瓦尔斯平面缺陷（如交换双层）驱动的新型层无序相，实现了对对称性和电子结构的无序驱动调控。
papers.method_zh: 使用惰性离子束进行辐照（无化学掺杂），结合磁强计、X射线光谱、输运测量等手段表征结构、磁性和拓扑性质变化。

papers.title: Zitterbewegung velocity in semiclassical electron dynamics
papers.abstract: Zitterbewegung plays a major role in electron dynamics in solids, yet is not captured in conventional semiclassical treatments. Here, starting from the quantum Liouville equation, I identify a new Zitterbewegung velocity, which involves the symmetric and antisymmetric components of the quantum geometric tensor oscillating out of phase. The Zitterbewegung velocity resolves the position-shift paradox, recovering the field-induced shift in an electron's position by integrating the semiclassical equations, and is directly related to the famous minimum conductivity of massless Dirac fermions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“starting from the quantum Liouville equation”、“identify a new Zitterbewegung velocity”、“semiclassical equations”。；研究对象：固体中电子的Zitterbewegung（颤动）动力学，特别是其在半经典电子运动中的速度项。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种新的Zitterbewegung速度，该速度由量子几何张量的对称和反对称分量以相位差振荡产生，能够解决位置偏移悖论，并与无质量狄拉克费米子的最小电导率直接相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种新的Zitterbewegung速度，该速度由量子几何张量的对称和反对称分量以相位差振荡产生，能够解决位置偏移悖论，并与无质量狄拉克费米子的最小电导率直接相关。；创新点：首次在半经典电子动力学框架中识别出由量子几何张量分量振荡产生的Zitterbewegung速度，并以此解决了传统半经典理论中无法解释的位置偏移悖论。
papers.method_zh: 从量子刘维尔方程出发，通过理论推导识别出新的Zitterbewegung速度，并利用半经典运动方程进行积分分析，以解释场致位置偏移。

papers.title: Stochastic Safety Limits and Scale-Dependent Power Fluctuations in Nuclear Reactors: A Critical Scaling Approach
papers.abstract: Applying boundary functionals of random risk processes to various physical problems makes it possible to determine many important characteristics of these problems. For example, a special case of boundary functionals is the time to first reach a level, which is widely and successfully applied to a variety of problems. We consider the application of boundary functionals to solving nuclear safety problems. In situations such as reactor startup, as well as for certain types of reactors, neutron behavior changes. Neutron clustering begins to play an important role, and the distributions characterizing neutron behavior change. The normal Gaussian distribution is replaced by stable limiting, distributions to which the sums of random variables converge. Boundary functionals allow us to accurately calculate the statistics of random events, determine the behavior of reactor power peaks, the probabilities of catastrophic power surges, and other quantities important for reactor safety, providing a mathematical bridge between the abstract theory of directed percolation and engineering calculations of protection parameters. This article examines the first-passage time to reach a certain level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“应用边界泛函”、“数学桥梁”、“抽象理论”等术语，未提及任何实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：核反应堆中的中子行为与功率波动。具体物理现象包括：反应堆启动等工况下的中子成团现象、功率峰值行为、灾难性功率激增的概率，以及有向渗流理论与工程安全参数之间的数学联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将随机风险过程的边界泛函（特别是首次达到某水平的时间）应用于核安全分析，可以精确计算非高斯分布（稳定极限分布）下的中子随机事件统计量，从而为反应堆功率波动和安全性评估提供数学框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将随机风险过程的边界泛函（特别是首次达到某水平的时间）应用于核安全分析，可以精确计算非高斯分布（稳定极限分布）下的中子随机事件统计量，从而为反应堆功率波动和安全性评估提供数学框架。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于将“有向渗流”的抽象理论与核反应堆工程中的“保护参数”计算通过边界泛函这一数学工具联系起来，并专门处理了中子行为偏离高斯分布（即出现稳定分布）的复杂情况。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为随机过程与边界泛函理论。具体使用了“首次通过时间”（first-passage time）这一特殊边界泛函，并基于随机变量和收敛于稳定极限分布（而非正态高斯分布）的假设进行推导。

papers.title: Unveiling Magnetic Frustration via the Elastocaloric Effect
papers.abstract: Motivated by experimental progress in pressure and strain tuning of quantum materials, we examine the thermodynamic response of frustrated magnets to uniaxial strain. Specifically, we study Ising and Heisenberg models on spatially anisotropic triangular (and, for the Ising model, also kagome) lattices. We determine the entropy as a function of temperature and strain, and use it to compute the elastic Grüneisen ratio $η$. The Ising models can be strain-tuned into and out of classical spin-liquid phases, and we show that $η$ can become arbitrarily large at low temperature $T$ near the point of maximal frustration, a universal hallmark of an extensive ground-state entropy. In contrast, the spin-$1/2$ Heisenberg model is moderately frustrated and displays multiple $T=0$ phase transitions. These transitions dominate $η$ at low $T$ while the intermediate-$T$ behavior is similar to that of the Ising model. We discuss the extent to which the elastic Grüneisen ratio can be used to deduce the phase diagram, and we connect our results to recent experiments on triangular-lattice magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：examine、determine、compute、study（理论计算与分析）。；研究对象：受挫磁体（frustrated magnets）在单轴应变下的热力学响应，具体包括各向异性三角晶格上的Ising模型和Heisenberg模型，以及Kagome晶格上的Ising模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在经典自旋液体相附近，弹性Grüneisen比率η在低温下可变得任意大，这是基态具有广泛熵的普适标志；而自旋-1/2 Heisenberg模型在低温下受多个零温相变主导，中温行为则与Ising模型类似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在经典自旋液体相附近，弹性Grüneisen比率η在低温下可变得任意大，这是基态具有广泛熵的普适标志；而自旋-1/2 Heisenberg模型在低温下受多个零温相变主导，中温行为则与Ising模型类似。；创新点：首次系统研究了弹性Grüneisen比率在受挫磁体中的行为，揭示了其作为探测经典自旋液体相和基态熵标志的潜力，并将结果与三角晶格磁体的近期实验联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算熵作为温度和应变的函数，进而计算弹性Grüneisen比率η，对Ising和Heisenberg模型进行理论分析。

papers.title: Optimized Three-Dimensional Photovoltaic Structures with LLM guided Tree Search
papers.abstract: We present a case study for how AI coding systems can be used to generate novel scientific hypotheses. We combine a generic coding agent (Google's AntiGravity) with an LLM-driven tree search algorithm (Empirical Research Assistance / ERA) to autonomously generate high-efficiency three-dimensional photovoltaic (3DPV) structures that overcome losses limiting flat solar panels at mid-latitudes. These structures operate by presenting favorable angles to the sun throughout the day, and for illustrative purposes we focus on optimizing performance for a single solar day. Our workflow begins by using AntiGravity to reproduce calculations \cite{bernardi2012solar} showing that 3DPV can have energy densities much higher than stationary flat PV panels. We use these initial designs as the starting point for large scale tree search, where we seek improved solutions and score them for their diurnal yield. The initial tree search leads to nominally more efficient solutions, yet they are caused by algorithmic reward hacking, arising from non-physical design features such as structurally levitating disconnected tiers and exploitations of the discretizations in the optics solver. To counteract this, we develop a workflow where the coding agent iteratively patches the physics engine with constraints to eliminate reward hacking. With reward-hacking eliminated, ERA discovers a series of designs with various constraints and improved performance, including optimal designs with different fixed collector areas, optimizing zenith tracking and avoiding self shadowing. Combining coding agents with tree search (ERA) provides a powerful platform for scientific discovery, for problems whose solutions can be empirically evaluated with a score function.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用AI编码系统、树搜索算法、光学求解器进行数值模拟和优化，未涉及实验制备或测量。；研究对象：三维光伏（3DPV）结构，具体为通过优化几何形状以克服中纬度地区平板太阳能电池能量损失的光伏系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结合AI编码代理与LLM驱动的树搜索算法，可以自主生成高效的三维光伏结构，其日间能量密度显著高于固定平板光伏；但需通过迭代约束消除算法奖励黑客（reward hacking）导致的非物理设计（如悬浮断开层级、利用光学求解器离散化漏洞）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结合AI编码代理与LLM驱动的树搜索算法，可以自主生成高效的三维光伏结构，其日间能量密度显著高于固定平板光伏；但需通过迭代约束消除算法奖励黑客（reward hacking）导致的非物理设计（如悬浮断开层级、利用光学求解器离散化漏洞）。；创新点：首次将通用AI编码系统与LLM驱动的树搜索结合，用于自主生成科学假设并优化光伏结构，同时系统性地解决了算法奖励黑客问题，展示了AI在实证可评分问题中的科学发现能力。
papers.method_zh: 使用Google AntiGravity通用编码代理复现文献中的三维光伏计算，并以此为基础启动大规模树搜索（ERA算法），通过评分函数（日间能量产率）评估候选设计；针对奖励黑客问题，采用编码代理迭代修补物理引擎（添加约束条件）以消除非物理特征。

papers.title: Beyond Maxwell-Boltzmann: Transport in Quasiequilibrium Plasmas
papers.abstract: Space plasmas are generally characterized by non-Maxwellian distributions with suprathermal populations, as routinely revealed by in situ observations. Such departures from standard Maxwellian distributions can be understood as signatures of quasiequilibrium states, in which the distribution of the medium can be expressed as a continuous superposition of Maxwellian distributions, namely through superstatistics. Here, we construct macroscopic relations linking fluxes to their associated driving forces in such plasmas, where superstatistical effects enter the picture through the transport coefficients. After comparing the resulting superstatistical distributions with observed electron distributions in the solar wind, we turn to the kinetic response of quasiequilibrium plasmas and derive the corresponding transport coefficients, including the electric and thermal conductivities, the mobility, and the diffusion coefficient. We further extend the analysis to viscous plasmas and compute the shear and bulk viscosity coefficients. Overall, quasiequilibrium effects are found to systematically enhance the transport coefficients relative to their Maxwellian values. We quantify this enhancement for the three main universality classes of superstatistics, which are the most commonly encountered in experimental and observational situations, and interpret it as a consequence of the increased population of energetic particles in the non-Maxwellian tails.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct macroscopic relations、derive transport coefficients、extend the analysis。；研究对象：准平衡等离子体（quasiequilibrium plasmas）中的输运现象，特别是非麦克斯韦分布（含超热粒子）对输运系数的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准平衡效应（超统计分布）会系统性地增强等离子体的输运系数（电导率、热导率、迁移率、扩散系数、剪切和体粘滞系数），其增强程度可通过超统计的三种主要普适类进行量化，并归因于非麦克斯韦尾中高能粒子数量的增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准平衡效应（超统计分布）会系统性地增强等离子体的输运系数（电导率、热导率、迁移率、扩散系数、剪切和体粘滞系数），其增强程度可通过超统计的三种主要普适类进行量化，并归因于非麦克斯韦尾中高能粒子数量的增加。；创新点：将超统计方法系统应用于等离子体输运系数的推导，并定量比较了三种主要超统计普适类对输运增强的贡献。摘要未突出说明与以往输运理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于超统计（superstatistics）理论框架，将非麦克斯韦分布表示为麦克斯韦分布的连续叠加，通过构建通量与驱动力之间的宏观关系，推导出准平衡等离子体中的输运系数（电导率、热导率、迁移率、扩散系数、剪切和体粘滞系数），并与太阳风观测到的电子分布进行对比验证。

papers.title: A reason why we do not observe Schrödinger's cats
papers.abstract: A reason is discussed (may be not the only one) for why we do not see any superposition of macroscopic states in the real world. Under the general assumption that quantum macrostates are statistical ensembles of microstates, it is shown that any superposition of macrostates is reduced in a very short time by the unitary dynamics of the ordinary Schrödinger equation, deducing the Born rule without having to postulate it. In more detail, the macroscopic and microscopic degrees of freedom are decoupled in the Schrödinger equation, yielding an effective stochastic equation for the macroscopic variables, with the ensemble average of the microscopic amplitudes that acts as a self-generated internal white noise. The stochastic equation is shown to be a reducing Itô equation if some general causality conditions are met, predicting a very quick collapse of any macroscopic superposition upon formation, with probabilities which satisfy the Born rule. In the context of the von Neumann measurement scheme, the relevance of the result is discussed as a simple dynamical solution of the measurement problem.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：讨论、推导、有效随机方程、Itô方程、动力学解。；研究对象：宏观量子叠加态的坍缩问题，即“薛定谔猫”悖论，以及量子测量问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在宏观态是微观态统计系综的普遍假设下，普通薛定谔方程本身的幺正动力学可以在极短时间内使宏观叠加态坍缩，并自然导出玻恩规则，无需额外假设。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在宏观态是微观态统计系综的普遍假设下，普通薛定谔方程本身的幺正动力学可以在极短时间内使宏观叠加态坍缩，并自然导出玻恩规则，无需额外假设。；创新点：提出宏观叠加态的坍缩并非由外部测量或波函数坍缩假设引起，而是由量子动力学自身在宏观-微观耦合下产生的内禀白噪声驱动，从而为测量问题提供了一种简单的动力学解决方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。通过将宏观与微观自由度在薛定谔方程中解耦，得到宏观变量的有效随机方程，其中微观振幅的系综平均充当自生内部白噪声；在满足一般因果性条件时，该随机方程被证明是约化型Itô方程。

papers.title: Extensive mixed-state entanglement in kinetically constrained superradiance
papers.abstract: Dicke superradiance by an ensemble of quantum emitters produces a collective burst of radiation, but no entanglement in the mixed state of the emitters. We show that adding a local kinetic constraint between the emitters generates extensive mixed-state entanglement, while otherwise preserving all key features of Dicke superradiance. Specifically, for any local Boolean constraint, we analytically derive a lower bound for the emission rate which implies a peak intensity $\propto N^2$ and a peak time $\propto (\log N)/N$ with number of spins $N$. This effect enables the superradiantly accelerated preparation of entangled dark states. Hereby, Hilbert-space fragmentation of the Dicke ladder leads to an exponentially branching decay tree that generates a hierarchy of dark states. Importantly, these disconnected manifolds include exponentially many long-range entangled singlet dark states. The explored kinetic constraints and superradiant dynamics can be realized in neutral-atom arrays coupled to an optical cavity, and we suggest a simple and accessible witness to detect the predicted mixed-state entanglement in such experiments. Moreover, we show that entanglement generation is robust against atomic decay and collective dephasing, and should be observable under recently reported experimental conditions. Our results, thereby, offer a general framework and experimentally viable approach for the dissipative engineering of entangled dark states enhanced by superradiance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytically derive、lower bound、suggest a witness、general framework）；研究对象：受动力学约束的Dicke超辐射体系，具体为耦合到光学腔的中性原子阵列中的量子发射体混合态纠缠。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Dicke超辐射体系中引入局域动力学约束（如布尔约束）后，发射体的混合态会产生广泛的纠缠，同时保持超辐射的关键特征（峰值强度∝N²、峰值时间∝(log N)/N），并可通过超辐射加速制备纠缠暗态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Dicke超辐射体系中引入局域动力学约束（如布尔约束）后，发射体的混合态会产生广泛的纠缠，同时保持超辐射的关键特征（峰值强度∝N²、峰值时间∝(log N)/N），并可通过超辐射加速制备纠缠暗态。；创新点：首次证明在动力学约束下，Dicke超辐射的混合态可产生广泛纠缠，并揭示希尔伯特空间碎片化导致指数级长程纠缠单重态暗态的分层结构；同时提出可在当前实验条件下观测的纠缠见证方案。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导（对任意局域布尔约束给出发射率下界）、希尔伯特空间碎片化分析（Dicke梯度的指数分支衰变树）、纠缠见证方案设计。

papers.title: Boundary anomalous dimensions from BCFT: $φ^{3}$ theories with a boundary and higher-derivative generalizations
papers.abstract: We consider the bulk $φ^3$ deformation of the free boundary conformal field theory in the $ε$ expansion. We determine the leading corrections to the scaling dimensions of boundary fundamental operators and some boundary operator expansion coefficients. Our procedure combines the conformal multiplet recombination with the boundary crossing symmetry. The results cover both the single field case and the multi-field case with $S_{N+1}$ global symmetry, which are associated with the Yang-Lee model and the $(N+1)$-state Potts model respectively. These semi-infinite models describe branched polymers, percolation, and spanning forest at a surface. We generalize these results to some higher derivative theories. In addition, we study the $φ^{2n+1}$ theories with $n>1$, but only obtain some boundary operator expansion coefficients.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：BCFT、ε展开、共形多重态重组、边界交叉对称性。；研究对象：边界共形场论（BCFT）中的φ³变形理论及其高导数推广，具体涉及单场情况（Yang-Lee模型）和多场S_{N+1}全局对称情况（(N+1)-态Potts模型），这些半无限模型描述表面处的支化聚合物、逾渗和生成森林。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 确定了边界基本算符标度维数以及部分边界算符展开系数在ε展开下的领头阶修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：确定了边界基本算符标度维数以及部分边界算符展开系数在ε展开下的领头阶修正。；创新点：将边界共形场论方法系统应用于φ³型变形（包括高导数推广和φ^{2n+1}理论），并覆盖了单场与多场对称性情形，但摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用共形多重态重组与边界交叉对称性相结合的方法，在ε展开框架下对自由边界共形场论进行φ³变形微扰计算。

papers.title: Born-rule statistical dynamical quantum phase transitions under measurement
papers.abstract: Dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) occur at times when a quantum state exhibits a nonanalytic change in its return probability. This can be viewed as the probability of collapsing the evolved state to the initial state by quantum measurement. However, the initial wave function usually has exponentially small amplitude in the late time evolved state. Here we perform statistical characterization for all the possible post-measurement states distributed according to the Born's rule, by sampling a one-dimensional quantum Ising chain after a quantum quench dynamics. The statistical ensemble can also be viewed as a mixed state when the time evolved state is subjected to maximally dephasing noise in a certain basis. We map the distribution to a statistical model and characterize its effective "energy" spectrum, and introduce the average dynamical free energy, establishing a framework for the statistical DQPTs. We show the recovering of DQPT under high-moment average and a delocalized level distribution following critical times. Through analytic continuation into the complex time plane, we demonstrate the vanishing of Yang-Lee-Fisher zeros and the emergent level crossing near critical times. Finally, we propose a measurement-based quantum computation protocol to simulate the unitary evolution via single-qubit measurements on a two-dimensional cluster state. Our results provide a way for experimentally investigating statistical DQPTs in quantum devices, shedding light on the structured circuit sampling with insights from DQPT and generalizing the understanding of mixed state due to decoherence beyond equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算与量子计算协议设计）。判断依据：摘要中提及“统计表征”“映射到统计模型”“解析延拓”等理论方法，以及“提出基于测量的量子计算协议”。；研究对象：一维量子伊辛链在量子淬火动力学后的测量诱导统计动力学量子相变（statistical DQPTs），以及与之相关的混合态与退相干效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过按玻恩规则采样后测量态，引入平均动力学自由能，建立了统计DQPT的理论框架；发现高动量平均下DQPT的恢复，以及临界时间后能级分布的退局域化；通过复时间平面解析延拓，展示了杨-李-费雪零点的消失和临界时间附近的能级交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过按玻恩规则采样后测量态，引入平均动力学自由能，建立了统计DQPT的理论框架；发现高动量平均下DQPT的恢复，以及临界时间后能级分布的退局域化；通过复时间平面解析延拓，展示了杨-李-费雪零点的消失和临界时间附近的能级交叉。；创新点：将DQPT从单一后测量态推广到所有可能后测量态的统计分布，建立了统计DQPT框架；揭示了退相干（最大退相位噪声）下混合态与统计DQPT的联系；提出了利用测量基量子计算模拟该过程的实验方案。
papers.method_zh: 对一维量子伊辛链进行量子淬火动力学模拟，按玻恩规则采样所有可能的后测量态；将分布映射到统计模型并表征其有效“能量”谱；引入平均动力学自由能；使用解析延拓到复时间平面分析杨-李-费雪零点；提出基于二维团态上单量子比特测量的量子计算协议来模拟幺正演化。

papers.title: Variational Autoregressive Networks with probability priors
papers.abstract: Monte Carlo methods are essential across diverse scientific fields, yet their efficiency is frequently hampered by critical slowing down-a sharp increase in autocorrelation times near phase transitions. Although deep learning approaches, such as neural-network-based samplers, have been proposed to alleviate this issue, they face another serious problem: the difficulty of training the models. This difficulty partially stems from the overly general nature of original machine-learning architectures, which often ignore underlying physical symmetries and force networks to relearn them from scratch. In this paper, we demonstrate that incorporating physical priors into the model significantly enhances performance. Building upon existing strategies that integrate spin-spin interactions, we propose a framework that utilizes a prior probability distribution as a starting point for training. Our results for the Ising model, as well as for the Edwards-Anderson spin glass model, suggest that moving away from `blank slate' models in favor of physics-informed priors reduces the training burden and facilitates the simulation of larger system sizes in discrete spin models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Monte Carlo methods、deep learning、neural-network-based samplers、Ising model、Edwards-Anderson spin glass model。；研究对象：离散自旋模型，具体包括伊辛模型（Ising model）和爱德华兹-安德森自旋玻璃模型（Edwards-Anderson spin glass model），以及这些模型在相变附近的蒙特卡洛模拟问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将物理先验（特别是先验概率分布）引入变分自回归网络模型，可以显著降低训练难度，并使得更大系统尺寸的离散自旋模型模拟成为可能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将物理先验（特别是先验概率分布）引入变分自回归网络模型，可以显著降低训练难度，并使得更大系统尺寸的离散自旋模型模拟成为可能。；创新点：在已有整合自旋-自旋相互作用策略的基础上，进一步提出利用先验概率分布作为训练起点，从而减少对“空白状态”模型的依赖，降低训练负担。摘要未突出说明与纯无先验模型相比的具体性能提升幅度。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分自回归网络（Variational Autoregressive Networks）作为神经网络采样器，并在模型中引入基于物理先验的概率分布作为训练起点，而非从零开始训练。模型在伊辛模型和爱德华兹-安德森自旋玻璃模型上进行测试。

papers.title: Beyond Commutativity: Redesigning Trotter Decomposition via Local Symmetry
papers.abstract: The product formula, commonly known as Trotter decomposition, is a central tool for digital quantum simulation, whose performance depends critically on how the Hamiltonian is partitioned into tractable blocks. Standard decompositions typically rely on direct commutativity among Hamiltonian terms in a chosen operator representation, which can lead to large residual errors and deep circuits for complex, practically relevant many-body quantum systems. We address this fundamental bottleneck by introducing a new decomposition principle that goes beyond commutativity, grouping Hamiltonian terms into local three-site clusters according to the underlying SU(2) symmetry of the local dynamics. We show that three-site generators fall into at most four SU(2)-symmetry classes, each admitting an effective two-qubit SU(4) representation with exact and efficient implementations. By reducing the number of clusters, this decomposition principle substantially suppresses commutator-induced errors and circuit overhead while preserving underlying physical structures that commutativity-based decompositions may violate. We demonstrate the proposed method on several physically relevant spin-lattice models, where the reduced cluster structure can even realise the second-order product formula without doubling the circuit depth, as would be required by conventional decompositions. Numerical simulations of a Kagome Heisenberg model with triangular spin-chirality interactions show that the proposed method reduces both state infidelity and average spin-chirality bias by more than three orders of magnitude compared with conventional decompositions, while using substantially fewer gates. These results establish local symmetry as a flexible and practical design principle for product-formula simulation, opening a route to more accurate and hardware-efficient simulations of broader classes of many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：product formula、Trotter decomposition、SU(2) symmetry、numerical simulations）；研究对象：数字量子模拟中的多体量子系统，具体以具有三角自旋手性相互作用的Kagome海森堡模型为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于局域SU(2)对称性的Trotter分解新原理，将哈密顿量项分组为局域三格点簇，可大幅抑制对易子引起的误差和电路深度，在Kagome海森堡模型中使态保真度和平均自旋手性偏差降低三个数量级以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于局域SU(2)对称性的Trotter分解新原理，将哈密顿量项分组为局域三格点簇，可大幅抑制对易子引起的误差和电路深度，在Kagome海森堡模型中使态保真度和平均自旋手性偏差降低三个数量级以上。；创新点：突破传统基于对易性的分解原则，首次利用局域对称性（而非直接对易性）来重新设计Trotter分解，从而在减少簇数量的同时保持物理结构，甚至可在不增加电路深度的情况下实现二阶乘积公式。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（基于SU(2)对称性分类三格点生成元，将其映射为有效两比特SU(4)表示），并结合数值模拟（对Kagome海森堡模型进行数字量子模拟性能对比）。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Networks: Harnessing Non-Equilibrium Steady States for Computation
papers.abstract: We introduce thermodynamic networks, a general framework for autonomous, physics-based computation using non-equilibrium steady states. These networks are modeled as a collection of finite-size reservoirs that exchange conserved quantities--such as electric charge or molecular number--while relaxing to a non-equilibrium steady state, which encodes the solution of a computational problem. We identify Negative Differential Conductance (NDC) as the critical physical property governing the computational expressivity of the thermodynamic network. While networks lacking NDC are restricted to computing monotonic functions, the presence of NDC enables universal function approximation. For the training of the network, we use protocols that take advantage of the natural tendency of the system to equilibrate. We illustrate the versatility of our approach via two different platforms: quantum dot networks and enzymatic reaction networks. Both systems can be engineered to have NDC, enabling high performance in standard benchmarks, including sine function approximation and MNIST digit classification. Overall, our work establishes a rigorous link between non-equilibrium steady states and computational expressivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：general framework、modeled as、theoretical framework。；研究对象：非平衡稳态下的计算系统，具体为“热力学网络”（thermodynamic networks），由有限尺寸的库（reservoirs）构成，交换守恒量（如电荷或分子数）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 负微分电导（NDC）是决定热力学网络计算表达能力的关键物理性质：缺乏NDC的网络只能计算单调函数，而具有NDC的网络能够实现通用函数逼近。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：负微分电导（NDC）是决定热力学网络计算表达能力的关键物理性质：缺乏NDC的网络只能计算单调函数，而具有NDC的网络能够实现通用函数逼近。；创新点：建立了非平衡稳态与计算表达能力之间的严格理论联系，并识别出负微分电导（NDC）作为实现通用计算的关键物理机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将计算问题编码为非平衡稳态；训练协议利用系统自然趋向平衡的特性；通过两种平台（量子点网络和酶反应网络）进行原理验证，并采用标准基准测试（正弦函数逼近和MNIST手写数字分类）评估性能。

papers.title: Quantum mechanics for classical transport equations
papers.abstract: Classical transport equations with probabilistic initial conditions can be viewed as quantum systems. In a discrete version they are probabilistic automata. The time-local probabilistic information is encoded in a classical wave function. Its unitary evolution obeys a Schrödinger equation. Statistical observables are represented by operators which do not commute with the ones associated to classical observables. Examples are functions of the quantum energy or the quantum angular momentum. They are important conserved quantities. We construct a complex functional integral for the quantum system which describes the probabilistic classical transport equation. The characteristic features of quantum mechanics, as the superposition of wave functions, interference, the importance of phases, non-commuting operators or a unitary time evolution, are realized by probabilistic classical transport equations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“量子系统”、“薛定谔方程”、“酉演化”、“复泛函积分”等理论框架关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：经典输运方程（具有概率性初始条件）与量子力学之间的对应关系。具体体系为离散版本的经典输运方程（概率自动机）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典输运方程在概率性初始条件下可被视作量子系统，其时间局域概率信息由经典波函数编码，并遵循薛定谔方程进行酉演化。量子力学中的特征（如波函数叠加、干涉、相位重要性、非对易算符、酉时间演化）均可由经典输运方程实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典输运方程在概率性初始条件下可被视作量子系统，其时间局域概率信息由经典波函数编码，并遵循薛定谔方程进行酉演化。量子力学中的特征（如波函数叠加、干涉、相位重要性、非对易算符、酉时间演化）均可由经典输运方程实现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与构造。具体包括：将经典输运方程离散化为概率自动机，引入经典波函数描述概率信息，建立其酉演化与薛定谔方程的对应关系；构造描述该量子系统的复泛函积分；分析统计可观测量（如量子能量、量子角动量）对应的非对易算符。

papers.title: Anomalous Transport from Effective Field Theory
papers.abstract: A systematic study of chiral effects is presented using an Effective Field Theory framework. By integrating out a massive Dirac fermion at finite temperature in presence of vector and axial background fields, the currents and their anomalies are computed from the path-integral. Chiral effects previously considered separately naturally arise in a unified computation, including new mass corrections. The link between each anomalous transport effect and the anomalies is clearly established, beyond the identification of their coefficients. In particular, we can appreciate how these effects are sourced by the anomalous nature of the theory even in configurations where the anomaly itself vanishes. The consistent and covariant anomalies are both encapsulated in master formulae for the currents which result from a careful treatment of the regularisation. It is finally found that, at finite temperature, the physical currents cannot be inferred simply from the Chern-Simons terms whose divergence reproduce the chiral anomalies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Effective Field Theory framework”、“path-integral”、“regularisation”等理论方法关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：手征效应（chiral effects）及其在有限温度、矢量与轴矢背景场下的反常输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过有效场论框架统一计算了多种手征输运效应，并揭示了每个反常输运效应与量子反常之间的明确联系，包括在反常本身为零的构型中这些效应仍由反常性质驱动。此外，有限温度下的物理电流不能简单从Chern-Simons项推导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过有效场论框架统一计算了多种手征输运效应，并揭示了每个反常输运效应与量子反常之间的明确联系，包括在反常本身为零的构型中这些效应仍由反常性质驱动。此外，有限温度下的物理电流不能简单从Chern-Simons项推导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 有效场论（Effective Field Theory）框架，通过路径积分在有限温度下积掉一个带有矢量与轴矢背景场的重狄拉克费米子，并采用正则化方法处理一致反常与协变反常。

papers.title: Optimized near-field optical response via adaptive tip illumination
papers.abstract: The performance of tip-enhanced optical microscopy is often limited by inefficient coupling of the excitation field to the plasmonic tip apex, as well as by thermal drift and optical aberrations. Here, we demonstrate that adaptive wavefront shaping based on Zernike mode provides a practical approach to achieving robust near-field optimisation at the tip apex. Using a sequential feedback algorithm, initially using the near-field signal, we narrow the illumination point-spread function and suppress sidelobes. This demonstrates that Zernike-mode control can be used for both aberration correction and field engineering. In tip-enhanced Raman measurements of a Janus MoSSe monolayer, conventional near-field optimisation increases the signal intensity by around 1.4 fold. A second optimisation step based directly on the Raman-band intensity yields a further 5 to 15 fold enhancement, depending on the specific tips used. These results establish a systematic, optics-based strategy for optimising tip fields, providing a transferable framework for improving tip-enhanced and related near-field spectroscopies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验过程（“使用顺序反馈算法”、“在Janus MoSSe单层的针尖增强拉曼测量中”），并给出了具体的实验数据（信号增强倍数）。；研究对象：针尖增强光学显微镜/光谱学（tip-enhanced optical microscopy/spectroscopy）中的近场光学响应优化，具体以Janus MoSSe单层为测试样品。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过基于Zernike模式的自适应波前整形技术，可以有效地优化针尖尖端的近场信号，实现点扩散函数的收窄和旁瓣的抑制。在针尖增强拉曼测量中，该方法能带来显著的信号增强（最高可达15倍）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过基于Zernike模式的自适应波前整形技术，可以有效地优化针尖尖端的近场信号，实现点扩散函数的收窄和旁瓣的抑制。在针尖增强拉曼测量中，该方法能带来显著的信号增强（最高可达15倍）。；创新点：提出并实验验证了一种基于Zernike模式的自适应波前整形策略，用于系统性地优化针尖场。该方法不仅能校正像差，还能进行场工程（field engineering），为改善针尖增强及相关近场光谱学提供了一种可转移的光学策略。摘要未明确说明与以往自适应光学方法的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法。具体包括：基于Zernike模式的自适应波前整形技术，结合顺序反馈算法。优化过程分两步：第一步基于近场信号（near-field signal）进行优化，第二步直接基于拉曼谱带强度（Raman-band intensity）进行优化。测量手段为针尖增强拉曼光谱（TERS）。

papers.title: Symmetry breaking and high-dimensional chaos in sparse random networks of exact firing rate models
papers.abstract: Exact firing rate models, also known as next-generation neural mass models (NG-NMMs), provide a rigorous description of the dynamics of neural populations. While in its simplest form a single population only displays fixed-point activity, multi-population models may display a range of different behaviors. In this work, we study the dynamics of all-excitatory or all-inhibitory NG-NMMs coupled through sparse random networks with row-normalized network topology. Linear stability analysis of the homogeneous states of the system, representing asynchronous neural activity, provides a dispersion relation linking the emergence of spatiotemporal dynamics to the spectra of the connectivity matrix. Using bounds from random matrix theory, we identify the parameter regions where instabilities occur. In undirected networks, only inhibitory systems produce heterogeneous stationary patterns, corresponding to a winner-takes-all mechanism. In directed networks, exotic rhythmic states with high frequencies emerge in both, excitatory and inhibitory systems. Numerical simulations reveal that these hectic oscillatory states correspond to high-dimensional chaos with extensive properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：linear stability analysis, random matrix theory, numerical simulations）；研究对象：稀疏随机网络中的精确发放率模型（exact firing rate models，亦称下一代神经质量模型NG-NMMs），具体为全兴奋性或全抑制性耦合网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无向网络中，仅抑制性系统能产生异质稳态斑图（胜者全得机制）；在有向网络中，兴奋性和抑制性系统均能产生高频节律态，且这些节律态对应具有广延性质的高维混沌。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无向网络中，仅抑制性系统能产生异质稳态斑图（胜者全得机制）；在有向网络中，兴奋性和抑制性系统均能产生高频节律态，且这些节律态对应具有广延性质的高维混沌。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 线性稳定性分析（推导色散关系，关联时空动力学与连接矩阵谱）、随机矩阵理论（界定失稳参数区域）、数值模拟（验证节律态的高维混沌性质）。

papers.title: Event-based spatiotemporal networks for modelling emergent phenomena in complex systems
papers.abstract: Complex systems display emergent phenomena that vary significantly across spatial and temporal scales. These variations originate from fine-grained system processes, yet arriving at macroscopic dynamics from micro-level data -- particularly when large, high-resolution datasets are available -- remains a persistent challenge. Here we develop event-based spatiotemporal networks, a computational modelling framework that encodes system processes as discrete events anchored in space and time. Event-based spatiotemporal networks offer a unified, flexible and efficient approach to generate emergent behaviour in complex systems across space and time from these events. We demonstrate the effectiveness of event-based spatiotemporal networks through two illustrative real-world applications. First, following a local outbreak of a novel respiratory pathogen in the Netherlands, spatiotemporal networks enable fine-grained tracking of transmission routes and infection patterns through space and time. Second, we use spatiotemporal networks to model propagation of delays in a public transportation system (S-bahn) around Zürich, Switzerland. We also discuss broader uses of event-based spatiotemporal networks in fields like developmental biology and community ecology, where focusing on events rather than static system states can improve data analysis, simulation, and collection strategies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：computational modelling framework、encoding system processes、generate emergent behaviour。；研究对象：复杂系统中的涌现现象，具体包括呼吸道病原体传播（荷兰）和公共交通系统延误传播（瑞士苏黎世S-bahn）两个实际案例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出基于事件的时空网络框架，能够从离散事件出发统一、灵活且高效地生成复杂系统在空间和时间上的涌现行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出基于事件的时空网络框架，能够从离散事件出发统一、灵活且高效地生成复杂系统在空间和时间上的涌现行为。；创新点：将系统过程建模为离散事件而非静态系统状态，提供了一种统一且高效的框架来从微观数据生成宏观涌现动力学，并适用于发育生物学和群落生态学等领域。
papers.method_zh: 事件驱动的时空网络建模框架（event-based spatiotemporal networks），将系统过程编码为锚定在空间和时间中的离散事件，并通过两个真实世界应用（病原体传播追踪、公共交通延误传播）验证其有效性。

papers.title: Dynamical aspects of steady-state subradiance: Detailed balance and its breakdown
papers.abstract: The dynamics of dissipative many-body quantum systems sometimes admit an emergent classical description in terms of a Markov chain even though the corresponding state space contains highly entangled states. In particular, a bad-cavity laser is a paradigm system whose dynamics can be formulated as a Markov chain in a two-dimensional state space spanned by collective angular momentum states. In this article, we investigate the connection between a dissipative phase transition that occurs in the subradiant regime of this system in the large atom number limit, and the properties of the underlying Markov chain. In one of the phases, the Markov chain approaches the detailed-balance condition with increasing atom number $N$ and hence becomes effectively time-reversible. This is caused by a collective atomic emission process that effectively reduces the Markov chain to one dimension. In the other phase, we find the emergence of time-asymmetric probability currents in the two-dimensional state space that signals a breakdown of detailed balance. This is accompanied by a macroscopic internal entropy production rate in the Markov chain that scales extensively with the atom number $N$. An observable consequence of the probability currents is a self-pulsing of the cavity light output in this phase, which can be detected as an anti-correlation dip in the intensity correlation function.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Markov chain、detailed-balance condition、entropy production rate、theoretical framework。；研究对象：耗散多体量子系统中的亚辐射稳态，具体以坏腔激光器（bad-cavity laser）为范例，研究其集体角动量态空间中的马尔可夫链动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在原子数很大的极限下，亚辐射体系中的耗散相变导致马尔可夫链在某一相中趋近细致平衡（时间可逆），而在另一相中细致平衡被破坏，出现时间不对称的概率流和宏观内熵产生率，并伴随腔光输出的自脉动现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在原子数很大的极限下，亚辐射体系中的耗散相变导致马尔可夫链在某一相中趋近细致平衡（时间可逆），而在另一相中细致平衡被破坏，出现时间不对称的概率流和宏观内熵产生率，并伴随腔光输出的自脉动现象。；创新点：揭示了亚辐射体系中耗散相变与马尔可夫链细致平衡性质之间的内在联系，并指出细致平衡的破坏会导致可观测的自脉动和熵产生率随原子数N的广延增长。
papers.method_zh: 基于集体角动量态构建二维状态空间的马尔可夫链模型，分析细致平衡条件、概率流、熵产生率，并通过强度关联函数中的反关联谷预测可观测效应。

papers.title: Nonlocal Optical Response and Surface Susceptibilities: A Systematic Derivation via Spatial Moment Expansion
papers.abstract: We present a systematic theory connecting the nonlocal response kernel of a homogeneous medium to its effective surface susceptibilities for an arbitrary curved interface. Starting from the most general tensorial nonlocal constitutive relation and combining a spatial moment expansion with a distributional thin-layer limit, we show that the full complexity of the interfacial response condenses, at leading order, into a single scalar: the surface susceptibility $χ^s$, equal for the tangential and normal components of the electric field. These quantities provide a constructive generalization of the Feibelman $d$-parameters to interfaces of arbitrary curvature, and the curvature corrections, proportional to the geometric invariants $H$ (mean curvature) and $K$ (Gaussian curvature), are derived explicitly. The formalism is illustrated on a comprehensive set of analytically tractable cases (planar, spherical, cylindrical, and ellipsoidal interfaces) for several kernel choices (Gaussian, Yukawa, tensorial Lorentz). Generalized Maxwell boundary conditions are established and compared with the classical Fresnel results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：systematic theory、derivation、spatial moment expansion、distributional thin-layer limit。；研究对象：均匀介质中任意弯曲界面处的非局域光学响应，以及有效表面磁化率（surface susceptibilities）的推导。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过空间矩展开与分布薄层极限，证明非局域响应核在主导阶可凝聚为一个标量表面磁化率 χ^s，该标量对电场切向和法向分量相等，并给出了曲率修正（正比于平均曲率 H 和高斯曲率 K）的显式表达式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过空间矩展开与分布薄层极限，证明非局域响应核在主导阶可凝聚为一个标量表面磁化率 χ^s，该标量对电场切向和法向分量相等，并给出了曲率修正（正比于平均曲率 H 和高斯曲率 K）的显式表达式。；创新点：将 Feibelman d-参数推广至任意弯曲界面，并显式推导出曲率修正项（与平均曲率 H 和高斯曲率 K 成正比）。摘要未突出说明与已有非局域光学理论（如 Feibelman 参数）的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：从最一般的张量非局域本构关系出发，结合空间矩展开（spatial moment expansion）与分布薄层极限（distributional thin-layer limit），推导出任意弯曲界面的表面磁化率，并建立广义麦克斯韦边界条件。在平面、球面、柱面和椭球面等解析可解情形下，对高斯、汤川、张量洛伦兹等核函数进行了示例说明。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Invariants of Coupled Channels: A Many-Channel Tolman-Ehrenfest Effect
papers.abstract: When multiple thermodynamic channels are coupled, single-channel equilibrium conditions fail. Extending the Tolman--Ehrenfest effect to the entropy manifold, we derive the unique $n$-channel invariant $ζ_i T_i = C$, where $ζ_i$ is the holonomy of the Ruppeiner connection. For the granular volume--stress ensemble, Rowe's dilatancy ratio and energy restriction emerge as geometric consequences of the off-diagonal curvature $g_{Vσ}$, and the 60-year puzzle of state-dependent $K_μ$ is resolved: the correction $ζ_V$ reaches $O(1)$ near jamming. The prediction $ζ_Vχ=\mathrm{const}$ across a shear band is experimentally testable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“extending the Tolman–Ehrenfest effect”“derive the unique n-channel invariant”“geometric consequences”等理论推导和几何框架术语，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：多热力学通道耦合系统中的平衡条件，具体以颗粒物质的体积-应力系综（granular volume–stress ensemble）为例，涉及剪切带（shear band）中的状态依赖性摩擦系数 \(K_\mu\) 和剪胀比（dilatancy ratio）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多通道耦合系统中，单通道平衡条件失效，存在唯一的 \(n\) 通道不变量 \(\zeta_i T_i = C\)，其中 \(\zeta_i\) 是 Ruppeiner 联络的和乐（holonomy）。在颗粒物质中，该几何框架自然导出 Rowe 剪胀比和能量限制，并解决了状态依赖性 \(K_\mu\) 的60年难题：修正项 \(\zeta_V\) 在接近堵塞（jamming）时达到 \(O(1)\) 量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多通道耦合系统中，单通道平衡条件失效，存在唯一的 \(n\) 通道不变量 \(\zeta_i T_i = C\)，其中 \(\zeta_i\) 是 Ruppeiner 联络的和乐（holonomy）。在颗粒物质中，该几何框架自然导出 Rowe 剪胀比和能量限制，并解决了状态依赖性 \(K_\mu\) 的60年难题：修正项 \(\zeta_V\) 在接近堵塞（jamming）时达到 \(O(1)\) 量级。；创新点：将 Tolman–Ehrenfest 效应从单通道推广到多通道熵流形，并建立几何不变量；首次将颗粒物质的剪胀比和能量限制解释为 Ruppeiner 几何中非对角曲率的直接后果，从而统一解释状态依赖性 \(K_\mu\) 的长期谜题。
papers.method_zh: 采用几何热力学方法，将 Tolman–Ehrenfest 效应推广到熵流形（entropy manifold），利用 Ruppeiner 联络（Ruppeiner connection）的曲率（off-diagonal curvature \(g_{V\sigma}\)）分析多通道耦合的平衡条件。

papers.title: Reweighting free energy profiles between universal machine learning interatomic potentials for fast consensus building
papers.abstract: Free energy profiles serve as a fundamental bridge between microscopic atomic fluctuations and macroscopic thermodynamic observables. Estimating the free energy profile along a reaction coordinate, referred to as the potential of mean force (PMF), with density functional theory (DFT) accuracy is computationally expensive. Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) drastically reduce this cost, but their accuracy is strongly determined by their training data and hence can be uncertain for a given system. In this work, we present a systematic and scalable framework for reweighting PMFs, initially sampled with a single 'source' MLIP, across a representative suite of target MLIPs. Because traditional direct exponential reweighting fails for large system sizes due to low phase-space overlap between potentials, we deploy robust analytical corrections. Applying this to a complex 601-atom system of Li$^+$ transport in a nanoconfined electrolyte, we demonstrate that a mean energy-gap approximation effectively bypasses statistical collapse, producing a highly stable PMF matching the target PMF. Using this approach, we recover high-fidelity target thermodynamics across multiple DFT reference levels (PBE+D3, PBE-sol, r$^2$SCAN,r$^2$SCAN-D4) at a fraction of the computational cost of full simulations. Furthermore, thermodynamic analysis reveals that the studied MLIPs partition into two distinct clusters driven by their training data. Our reweighting framework successfully recovers target thermodynamic properties--specifically, reaction and activation free energies--even when the phase-space overlap between potentials is critically low. Ultimately, this approach establishes a vital diagnostic protocol to achieve affordable cross-model consensus on materials chemistry properties without redundant, resource-intensive simulations.
