papers.title: Selective Octahedral Accommodation of Cr$^{3+}$ and Weak Magnetic Connectivity in the Sugilite Analogue KNa$_2$Cr$_2$Li$_3$Si$_{12}$O$_{30}$
papers.abstract: We report the synthesis of the Cr analogue of sugilite, KNa$_2$Cr$_2$Li$_3$Si$_{12}$O$_{30}$, in the milarite-type framework. Rietveld refinement of a composition-conserving antisite model gives $x = 0.0024(18)$ in KNa$_2$[Cr$_{2-x}$Li$_x$][Li$_{3-x}$Cr$_x$]Si$_{12}$O$_{30}$, corresponding to a T2-site Cr occupancy of $0.0008(6)$. X-ray MEM analysis shows no detectable Cr-like density at T2. Magnetic susceptibility indicates weak antiferromagnetic interactions with $θ_{\mathrm{W}} = -4.78(7)$ K and no ordering above 1.8 K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：synthesis（合成）、Rietveld refinement（Rietveld精修）、X-ray MEM analysis（X射线最大熵方法分析）、Magnetic susceptibility（磁化率测量）。；研究对象：铬（Cr）取代的硅镁石类似物KNa₂Cr₂Li₃Si₁₂O₃₀，属于milarite型框架结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cr³⁺离子选择性地占据八面体T2位点，且该材料中磁相互作用非常弱（仅表现为弱反铁磁耦合，θ_W = -4.78 K），在1.8 K以上未观察到磁有序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cr³⁺离子选择性地占据八面体T2位点，且该材料中磁相互作用非常弱（仅表现为弱反铁磁耦合，θ_W = -4.78 K），在1.8 K以上未观察到磁有序。；创新点：成功合成了Cr类似物硅镁石，并通过高精度结构分析（Rietveld精修结合MEM分析）定量证实了Cr³⁺在T2位点上的选择性占据（占据率极低，约0.08%），排除了显著的反位无序。摘要未突出说明与已有硅镁石类似物在磁性质上的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用固相合成方法制备样品；使用Rietveld精修对反位缺陷模型进行结构分析；利用X射线最大熵方法（X-ray MEM analysis）进行电子密度分布分析；通过磁化率测量研究磁性质。

papers.title: Matrix-noise Jacobians in stochastic-calculus inference and optimal paths
papers.abstract: Multiplicative noise makes stochastic dynamics depend on how the white-noise limit is interpreted. In multidimensional systems with matrix-valued noise amplitudes $σ(x)$, this dependence includes a local Jacobian contribution that is absent from the scalar examples most often used to build intuition. We formulate a finite-step path-likelihood framework for $θ$-discretized diffusions and show that its short-time expansion isolates the scalar $J_σ=\partial_jσ_{ik}\partial_iσ_{jk}-(\partial_iσ_{ik})(\partial_lσ_{lk})$. For a specified noise-amplitude representation $σ$, this quantity vanishes in one-dimensional, scalar-isotropic, and strictly diagonal cases, but can survive when state-dependent noise directions mix different components. We then test its consequences using paired comparisons that hold the drift, diffusion matrix, interpolation point, and Gaussian increment term fixed. In Model A, removing only the off-diagonal determinant contribution produces a shift in the fitted stochastic prescription that vanishes when $J_σ=0$. In Model B, removing the corresponding state-dependent action term changes a stable optimized transition path. These results show that a genuinely matrix-noise part of the short-time path measure can survive the scalar cancellations familiar from simpler settings and produce measurable changes in fitted stochastic prescriptions and Onsager--Machlup paths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于随机微积分中的雅可比项推导、路径似然框架构建及模型分析，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：多维系统中具有矩阵值噪声幅度的乘性噪声随机动力学，特别是其短时路径测度中的雅可比贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多维系统中，乘性噪声的短时路径测度存在一个标量雅可比项 \( J_\sigma = \partial_j\sigma_{ik}\partial_i\sigma_{jk} - (\partial_i\sigma_{ik})(\partial_l\sigma_{lk}) \)，该量在一维、标量各向同性和严格对角情况下为零，但在状态依赖的噪声方向混合不同分量时非零，并能在拟合随机演算方案和优化路径中产生可观测变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多维系统中，乘性噪声的短时路径测度存在一个标量雅可比项 \( J_\sigma = \partial_j\sigma_{ik}\partial_i\sigma_{jk} - (\partial_i\sigma_{ik})(\partial_l\sigma_{lk}) \)，该量在一维、标量各向同性和严格对角情况下为零，但在状态依赖的噪声方向混合不同分量时非零，并能在拟合随机演算方案和优化路径中产生可观测变化。；创新点：揭示了多维矩阵噪声中短时路径测度存在一个标量雅可比贡献，该贡献在标量噪声或对角噪声的简单情形中被抵消，但在矩阵噪声情形下可存活并导致可测量的物理效应。
papers.method_zh: 构建了针对 \(\theta\)-离散化扩散过程的有限步路径似然框架，并通过短时展开提取出雅可比项 \(J_\sigma\)；采用配对比较方法，固定漂移、扩散矩阵、插值点和高斯增量项，在模型A和模型B中分别检验其影响。

papers.title: Frustrated Magnetism of the $S = 1$ Trillium-Lattice Oxide Li$_2$NiGe$_3$O$_8$
papers.abstract: We report magnetization and heat-capacity measurements on the ordered-spinel oxide Li$_2$NiGe$_3$O$_8$, where Ni$^{2+}$ ions with $S = 1$ form a single three-dimensional trillium lattice. Powder x-ray diffraction confirms a cubic ordered-spinel structure with space group $P4_{1}32$ or $P4_{3}32$. The inverse susceptibility $H/M$ follows Curie--Weiss behavior above 50 K with an effective magnetic moment $μ_{\mathrm{eff}} = 3.124(4)\,μ_{\mathrm{B}}$ per Ni and a Weiss temperature $θ_{\mathrm{W}} = -0.21(1)$ K, but deviates smoothly below about 10 K. The magnetic heat capacity $C_{\mathrm{mag}}/T$ shows a broad maximum near 3 K with a wide tail to about 10 K, and the entropy recovered between 2 and 40 K is about 88% of $R \ln 3$. The broad heat-capacity maximum is compared with Monte Carlo results for the local ferromagnetic Ising model on the trillium lattice using a characteristic scale $J$ of order 7 K, while the inverse susceptibility shows only qualitative similarity to the theoretical curve. These results establish Li$_2$NiGe$_3$O$_8$ as a rare $S = 1$ single-trillium oxide with frustrated magnetic correlations. The present data provide an experimental platform for discussing the relation between Heisenberg-like and spin-ice-like regimes on the trillium lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：magnetization and heat-capacity measurements（磁化与热容测量）、powder x-ray diffraction（粉末X射线衍射）。；研究对象：S=1的三重晶格氧化物Li₂NiGe₃O₈，其中Ni²⁺离子形成三维三重晶格，研究其阻挫磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Li₂NiGe₃O₈是一种稀有的S=1单三重晶格氧化物，表现出阻挫磁关联；其磁热容在约3 K处出现宽峰，与三重晶格上局域铁磁伊辛模型的蒙特卡洛结果可比，但逆磁化率仅与理论曲线定性相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Li₂NiGe₃O₈是一种稀有的S=1单三重晶格氧化物，表现出阻挫磁关联；其磁热容在约3 K处出现宽峰，与三重晶格上局域铁磁伊辛模型的蒙特卡洛结果可比，但逆磁化率仅与理论曲线定性相似。；创新点：首次报道了S=1单三重晶格氧化物Li₂NiGe₃O₈的磁性表征，为讨论三重晶格上Heisenberg型与自旋冰型行为之间的关系提供了实验平台。
papers.method_zh: 粉末X射线衍射确定晶体结构；磁化率测量（Curie-Weiss分析）提取有效磁矩和Weiss温度；热容测量提取磁热容C_mag/T，并与蒙特卡洛模拟结果对比。

papers.title: Terahertz detection within charge density wave state
papers.abstract: Terahertz (THz) technology enables multi-Tbps satellite communications, but conventional semiconductor detectors suffer from fundamental performance degradation above 1 THz due to the Drude limit of free electrons. Here, we theoretically demonstrate that charge density wave (CDW) materials offer a paradigm-shifting solution via their collective electronic response. We show that a static bias electric field can continuously tune the THz resonant absorption frequency of CDW states from 0 to cutoff frequency, and enhance the nonlinear rectification current by more than one order of magnitude. This unprecedented electric-field tunability makes CDW materials ideal candidates for next-generation ultrafast THz detectors working at room-temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically demonstrate”和“We show that”等表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：电荷密度波（CDW）材料中的太赫兹（THz）探测机制，具体关注其集体电子响应行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加静态偏置电场，可以连续调控CDW态的THz共振吸收频率（从0到截止频率），并将非线性整流电流提升一个数量级以上，使CDW材料成为室温下下一代超快THz探测器的理想候选。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加静态偏置电场，可以连续调控CDW态的THz共振吸收频率（从0到截止频率），并将非线性整流电流提升一个数量级以上，使CDW材料成为室温下下一代超快THz探测器的理想候选。；创新点：提出利用CDW材料的集体电子响应替代传统半导体探测器，突破1 THz以上因自由电子Drude极限导致的性能退化，并首次展示电场对CDW态THz响应的连续可调性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体涉及CDW态集体电子响应的模型构建，以及静态偏置电场对共振吸收频率和非线性整流电流的调控机制推导。

papers.title: Grassmann tensor networks
papers.abstract: Developing non-perturbative methods to reveal exotic properties of strongly correlated fermionic systems remains one of the most essential tasks of theoretical physics. Tensor network methods with Grassmann algebra offer powerful numerical tools for fermionic many-body systems in the coherent-state path-integral representation. Despite their vast potential for both condensed-matter and particle-physics communities, Grassmann tensor network methods are somewhat underexploited in practical simulations. In this work, we provide a detailed, self-contained introduction to Grassmann tensor network methods, from the basics of the Grassmann tensor operations to the Grassmannization of typical tensor network algorithms. Furthermore, the resulting Grassmann tensor network methods are validated in several interesting models in both particle physics and condensed matter physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“developing non-perturbative methods”、“tensor network methods with Grassmann algebra”、“provide a detailed, self-contained introduction”，属于理论方法开发与介绍。；研究对象：强关联费米子多体系统，具体包括凝聚态物理和粒子物理中的若干模型（摘要未列出具体模型名称）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本文系统性地建立了Grassmann张量网络方法，从基本运算到典型算法实现，并在多个物理模型中验证了其有效性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本文系统性地建立了Grassmann张量网络方法，从基本运算到典型算法实现，并在多个物理模型中验证了其有效性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：本文提供了一份自包含的、从基础到算法的完整Grassmann张量网络方法介绍，并首次在多个粒子物理与凝聚态物理模型中系统验证了该方法，弥补了该方法在实际模拟中应用不足的现状。
papers.method_zh: 基于Grassmann代数的张量网络方法，具体包括：Grassmann张量运算、相干态路径积分表示、以及典型张量网络算法的“Grassmann化”（即引入Grassmann变量的推广）。

papers.title: Topological and morphological signatures of disorder in a self-assembled, soft matter sponge network
papers.abstract: Many soft matter systems exhibit ordered, polycontinuous network morphologies, such as the cubic (double) gyroid or diamond, as well as disordered network morphologies known generically as ``random sponges". While presumed to share similar local packing geometry, the structural relationship between these ordered and disordered network morphologies has remained obscure. We use slice and view scanning electron microscopy to analyze and compare multi-scale morphological features of an ordered double-gyroid morphology to the amorphous sponge morphology formed in the same block copolymer sample. We find that node valence of the minority component network of the sponge is mostly gyroidal (trivalent), with a small fraction of diamond-like (tetravalent) connections. We analyze mesoatoms -- space-filling volumes occupied by chains around each network node -- finding significant differences in shape and size between ordered and amorphous regions. Local block thickness and inter-domain curvature within mesoatomic units of the disordered sponge exhibits a surprisingly similar degree of dispersity to the ordered double-gyroid. The mean differences in local packing geometry derive from topological distinction: loops of the minority networks of the ordered double-gyroid are intercatenated, while loops of the disordered sponge are not. In this way, the sponge may be viewed as disordered variant of a single-gyroidal morphology. We exploit these topological differences to demarcate the boundary region between ordered and disordered networks and highlight modulations of the mesoatom motifs at the boundary. These observations point to new questions about potential metastability of disordered networks and their possible role as kinetic precursors to long-range ordered network morphologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用“slice and view scanning electron microscopy”进行实验观察和分析。；研究对象：软物质自组装体系中的有序与无序网络形态，具体为同一嵌段共聚物样品中形成的有序双螺旋（double-gyroid）形态与无定形海绵（amorphous sponge）形态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序海绵网络的节点价态主要为三价（类似螺旋结构），并含有少量四价（类似金刚石结构）连接；有序双螺旋与无序海绵在局部堆积几何上的差异源于拓扑区别：有序双螺旋的环是互穿的，而无序海绵的环是非互穿的，因此海绵可视为单螺旋形态的无序变体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序海绵网络的节点价态主要为三价（类似螺旋结构），并含有少量四价（类似金刚石结构）连接；有序双螺旋与无序海绵在局部堆积几何上的差异源于拓扑区别：有序双螺旋的环是互穿的，而无序海绵的环是非互穿的，因此海绵可视为单螺旋形态的无序变体。；创新点：首次通过实验对比同一材料中有序与无序网络形态的局部堆积几何，并揭示其拓扑差异（环的互穿性），提出无序海绵可能作为长程有序网络形态的动力学前驱体。
papers.method_zh: 使用切片与观察扫描电子显微镜（slice and view scanning electron microscopy）分析多尺度形态特征，并对比有序双螺旋与无序海绵的节点价态、介观原子（mesoatom）形状与尺寸、局部嵌段厚度及域间曲率等。

papers.title: Competing Effect of Biquadratic and Heisenberg Coupling on Magnetic Tunnel Junction Molecular Spintronics Devices
papers.abstract: Heisenberg exchange coupling (HC) and biquadratic exchange coupling (BQC) are known to occur in magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJ) and nanoscale spintronics structures. MTJ-based molecular spintronics devices (MTJMSD) provide a platform to study these interactions and the correlated magnetic behavior they generate. Molecular spin channels formed along the exposed MTJ edge have been shown to produce strong exchange interactions that include HC and BQC, which can drive perpendicular alignment of spin vectors in adjacent ferromagnetic electrodes. Despite their importance, the competing roles of HC and BQC in MTJMSDs remain unclear. Monte Carlo simulations using a three-dimensional Heisenberg model were performed to systematically vary BQC strength under three conditions: no molecular HC, strong parallel HC, and strong antiparallel HC. The resulting magnetic and physical properties of the MTJMSDs were analyzed. Increasing BQC strength produced minimal changes in overall magnetization when strong HC was present, indicating that HC dominates device magnetization. Temporal evolution studies showed that devices with only BQC failed to reach magnetic stability, while devices with both HC and BQC achieved stable magnetic states due to the stabilizing influence of HC. These results show that BQC plays a secondary role in magnetization dynamics and cannot overcome the stronger stabilizing effect of HC. The presence of BQC offers a plausible explanation for experimentally observed magnetic phase orientations beyond simple parallel and antiparallel states in MTJMSDs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Monte Carlo simulations”、“three-dimensional Heisenberg model”。；研究对象：基于磁性隧道结的分子自旋电子学器件（MTJMSD）中，双二次交换耦合（BQC）与海森堡交换耦合（HC）之间的竞争效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MTJMSD中，海森堡交换耦合（HC）主导器件的磁化强度和磁稳定性，而双二次交换耦合（BQC）仅起次要作用，无法克服HC的稳定化效应。BQC的存在可解释实验中观察到的超出简单平行和反平行态的磁相取向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在MTJMSD中，海森堡交换耦合（HC）主导器件的磁化强度和磁稳定性，而双二次交换耦合（BQC）仅起次要作用，无法克服HC的稳定化效应。BQC的存在可解释实验中观察到的超出简单平行和反平行态的磁相取向。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于三维海森堡模型的蒙特卡洛模拟，系统改变BQC强度，并在三种条件下进行对比：无分子HC、强平行HC、强反平行HC。

papers.title: PACSim: A Flexible Simulation Framework for Polymer-Attenuated Coulombic Self-Assembly
papers.abstract: Polymer-Attenuated Coulombic Self-Assembly (PACS) is a flexible experimental approach for generating crystals from simple colloidal building blocks. The central components are charged spherical particles coated with a polymer brush that prevents irreversible aggregation. Whether oppositely charged colloids crystallize, and which structures they form, depends on several factors, including colloid concentration, charge, and size, as well as the salt concentration of the solution. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are a powerful tool for predicting the outcomes of PACS assembly experiments and also provide particle-level insight into the assembly processes. Here, we present an open-source simulation framework, PACSim, that enables MD simulation studies of assembly by PACS across a range of experimentally relevant scenarios. PACSim is built on top of OpenMM, a flexible MD simulation framework that readily supports the implementation of different interaction potentials, as well as integration with other tools such as enhanced-sampling and machine-learning frameworks. We describe the motivation for PACSim, outline its features, report methodological advancements inspired by this framework, and provide examples of its use.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, open-source simulation framework, PACSim, OpenMM）；研究对象：聚合物衰减库仑自组装（Polymer-Attenuated Coulombic Self-Assembly, PACS）体系，即带相反电荷的聚合物刷包覆胶体球在溶液中的结晶自组装过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍了一个用于模拟PACS组装过程的开源框架PACSim。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍了一个用于模拟PACS组装过程的开源框架PACSim。；创新点：开发了首个专门针对PACS实验场景的灵活开源模拟框架PACSim，填补了该领域缺乏通用模拟工具的空白。
papers.method_zh: 基于OpenMM的分子动力学（MD）模拟框架，支持不同相互作用势的实现，并可集成增强采样和机器学习工具。

papers.title: Ultraviolet plastic scintillators based on naphthalene-doped polystyrene and polyvinyltoluene
papers.abstract: This work reports the fabrication and optical characterization of ultraviolet-emitting plastic scintillators based on polystyrene [-(CH2-CH(C6H5))n-] and polyvinyltoluene [-(CH2-CH(C6H4CH3))n-] doped with different concentrations of naphthalene (Naph). Photoluminescence (PL) measurements show that Naph incorporation enhances the emission intensity, inducing a red shift in the emission wavelength of the polystyrene (PS), while Naph-doped polyvinyltoluene (PVT) exhibits a bimodal emission with peaks around 335 and 350 nm. Time-resolved photoluminescence (TRPL) reveals fast decay components for the undoped matrices and a dominant slow component of approximately 87 ns in the doped samples. Scintillation light yield measurements indicate moderate performance for the undoped polymers and a significant enhancement upon Naph doping. Proton irradiation experiments reveal a reduction in light yield for all samples, with Naph-doped PVT retaining a larger fraction of its initial light yield compared to PS-based scintillators, indicating improved radiation tolerance. Overall, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of Naph as a UV emission enhancer and highlight Naph-doped PVT as a promising candidate for compact and radiation-resistant scintillation detectors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“fabrication”、“optical characterization”、“Photoluminescence (PL) measurements”、“Time-resolved photoluminescence (TRPL)”、“Scintillation light yield measurements”、“Proton irradiation experiments”。；研究对象：基于聚苯乙烯（PS）和聚乙烯基甲苯（PVT）掺杂不同浓度萘（Naph）的紫外发光塑料闪烁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 萘掺杂能显著增强聚苯乙烯和聚乙烯基甲苯的发光强度，并引入慢衰减成分（约87 ns）；萘掺杂的聚乙烯基甲苯（Naph-doped PVT）在质子辐照后保留了更高比例的光产额，表现出更优的辐射耐受性，是紧凑型抗辐射闪烁探测器的有前景候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：萘掺杂能显著增强聚苯乙烯和聚乙烯基甲苯的发光强度，并引入慢衰减成分（约87 ns）；萘掺杂的聚乙烯基甲苯（Naph-doped PVT）在质子辐照后保留了更高比例的光产额，表现出更优的辐射耐受性，是紧凑型抗辐射闪烁探测器的有前景候选材料。；创新点：系统比较了萘掺杂对聚苯乙烯和聚乙烯基甲苯两种聚合物基质的紫外发光增强效果，并首次通过质子辐照实验证明了萘掺杂聚乙烯基甲苯具有更优的辐射耐受性。
papers.method_zh: 光致发光（PL）光谱、时间分辨光致发光（TRPL）测量、闪烁光产额测量、质子辐照实验。

papers.title: Wall accumulation of confined active Janus colloids due to effective active diffusivity
papers.abstract: Electrokinetically-driven Janus colloids, e.g., with one metallic and one dielectric hemisphere, confined between parallel walls exhibit a boundary-accumulation mechanism enabled by an effective cross-channel diffusivity which is distinct from wall accumulation of active Brownian or run-andtumble particles. Using density-matched suspensions and three-dimensional confocal imaging, we directly measure the full time-dependent redistribution of particles across the channel under an applied AC electric field. The wall population grows exponentially while the bulk depletes, and data obtained over multiple field strengths collapse onto a single curve when rescaled by the measured relaxation rate, revealing one dominant, confinement-controlled timescale. Propulsion follows the expected induced-charge electrophoretic scaling, with a mean orientation angle lying between 2 degrees and 10 degrees above horizontal, leading to a top-biased accumulation. Comparison with an overdamped Ornstein-Uhlenbeck turning model suggests that persistent stochastic turning about a small out-ofplane angle results in a cross-channel effective drift and diffusion. The drift governs the dominant timescale and the diffusion is strong enough to provide significant accumulation on the bottom wall despite a mean upward orientational bias.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用密度匹配悬浮液和三维共聚焦成像直接测量”，并涉及实验数据与理论模型对比。；研究对象：受限在平行壁之间的电驱动Janus胶体（一个金属半球和一个介电半球），具体研究其边界积累现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种由有效跨通道扩散率驱动的边界积累机制，该机制不同于活性布朗粒子或跑停粒子的壁积累；尽管粒子平均取向有向上的偏置，但扩散足够强，导致底部壁面也出现显著积累。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种由有效跨通道扩散率驱动的边界积累机制，该机制不同于活性布朗粒子或跑停粒子的壁积累；尽管粒子平均取向有向上的偏置，但扩散足够强，导致底部壁面也出现显著积累。；创新点：揭示了由有效活性扩散率而非传统活性布朗运动或跑停机制主导的壁积累新机制，并发现平均向上取向偏置下仍存在底部积累的反直觉现象。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：密度匹配悬浮液、三维共聚焦成像、施加交流电场测量粒子在通道中的全时程再分布。理论框架：过阻尼Ornstein-Uhlenbeck转向模型，用于分析持续随机转向导致的跨通道有效漂移和扩散。

papers.title: Ultrafast electron dynamics of electron-irradiated graphene
papers.abstract: Electron irradiation is essential for materials characterization and modification, though the fundamental interactions between incident electrons and host materials remain under investigation. Here, we employ first-principles simulations to study electron dynamics under external electron irradiation. We quantify differences in key observables, including kinetic energy loss, secondary electron emission, and backscattered electrons, between classical and quantum mechanical descriptions of the incident electron. Around 400 eV incident energy, we identify significant differences in backscattered electron yields between classical point-charge and quantum wave-packet descriptions, whereas the quantum-mechanical effects diminish at incident energies above 600 eV. These differences highlight the critical importance of quantum effects in electron irradiation phenomena that occur in a specific energy range of the incident electron. Our results provide clear guidance for selecting appropriate incident, electron descriptions based on kinetic-energy regimes, identify a targeted experimental window for isolating quantum-only backscattering, and enable the rational design of 2D materials for nanofabrication and high-resolution electron-beam technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles simulations、quantum wave-packet descriptions、classical point-charge descriptions）；研究对象：电子辐照下石墨烯中的超快电子动力学，具体包括入射电子与石墨烯的相互作用、动能损失、二次电子发射和背散射电子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在约400 eV入射能量下，经典点电荷描述与量子波包描述在背散射电子产额上存在显著差异；当入射能量高于600 eV时，量子力学效应减弱。这表明在特定能量范围内，量子效应对电子辐照现象至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在约400 eV入射能量下，经典点电荷描述与量子波包描述在背散射电子产额上存在显著差异；当入射能量高于600 eV时，量子力学效应减弱。这表明在特定能量范围内，量子效应对电子辐照现象至关重要。；创新点：首次通过第一性原理模拟定量揭示了在特定入射能量区间（~400 eV）内，量子力学描述与经典描述在背散射电子产额上的显著差异，为根据动能区间选择恰当的入射电子描述提供了明确指导，并识别出可孤立观测量子背散射效应的实验窗口。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理模拟（first-principles simulations），对比了经典点电荷模型与量子波包模型对入射电子的描述，并量化了动能损失、二次电子发射和背散射电子等关键可观测量的差异。

papers.title: Imaging Interacting Two-Dimensional Anisotropic Electrons
papers.abstract: We directly visualize a two-dimensional anisotropic Wigner crystal and its quantum melting in monolayer 1T-ReSe2 using non-invasive scanning tunnelling microscopy. In crystals with anisotropic effective mass, an electron's quantum wavefunction becomes elongated along the light-mass direction to reduce kinetic energy. At low electron density, such anisotropic electrons are predicted to form an oblique Wigner crystal rather than the familiar triangular lattice of isotropic systems. Despite longstanding theoretical interest, this physics has been little explored experimentally. Here we first image the anisotropic shape of individual electrons in gated monolayer ReSe2, whose wavefunctions are strongly elongated along the light-mass direction. At low density, these electrons crystallize into an oblique Wigner lattice. As the density increases, quantum fluctuations grow more rapidly along the light-mass direction than along the heavy-mass direction, driving a one-dimensional melting of the crystal. The resulting state retains order along one direction but melts along the other, consistent with a smectic electron liquid crystal between the electron solid and Fermi liquid phases. Our work establishes monolayer ReSe2 as a platform for studying anisotropic correlated electrons, quantum melting, and coupled one-dimensional electron chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“scanning tunnelling microscopy”（扫描隧道显微镜）、“directly visualize”（直接可视化）、“imaging”（成像）。；研究对象：单层1T-ReSe₂中的二维各向异性电子体系，具体研究各向异性Wigner晶体及其量子熔化过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次直接成像了各向异性Wigner晶体，并观察到其沿轻质量方向的一维熔化，形成介于电子固体和费米液体之间的近晶型电子液晶相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次直接成像了各向异性Wigner晶体，并观察到其沿轻质量方向的一维熔化，形成介于电子固体和费米液体之间的近晶型电子液晶相。；创新点：首次在实验上直接观测到各向异性电子的波函数形状（沿轻质量方向拉长）以及由此形成的斜方Wigner晶格，并揭示了沿轻质量方向优先发生的量子熔化行为，验证了长期存在的理论预测。
papers.method_zh: 非侵入式扫描隧道显微镜（STM），用于直接可视化单层1T-ReSe₂中栅压调控下的电子波函数形状和晶格结构。

papers.title: Yu-Shiba-Rusinov States in Ising Superconductors
papers.abstract: The nature of the superconducting state in two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides remains under active debate. A widely used description invokes so-called Ising superconductivity. In this work, we investigate theoretically this pairing state by employing single magnetic impurities as local probes of the superconducting condensate. We analyze the formation of Yu-Shiba-Rusinov bound states in the presence of Ising spin-orbit coupling and an in-plane magnetic field to study how their spectral properties encode the underlying pairing structure. We identify distinct features in the bound-state spectrum and tunneling response that differentiate this system from conventional superconductors. Our results demonstrate that magnetic impurities provide a sensitive probe of the structure of the superconducting state and yield experimentally accessible signatures of unconventional aspects of Ising superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“investigate theoretically”、“analyze the formation”、“study how their spectral properties”。；研究对象：二维过渡金属硫族化物中的伊辛超导体，具体研究其超导配对态的性质，以及单个磁性杂质在该体系中诱导的Yu-Shiba-Rusinov束缚态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在伊辛自旋-轨道耦合和面内磁场作用下，Yu-Shiba-Rusinov束缚态的谱特性和隧穿响应呈现出与常规超导体不同的特征，这些特征可用于区分伊辛超导体的非常规配对结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在伊辛自旋-轨道耦合和面内磁场作用下，Yu-Shiba-Rusinov束缚态的谱特性和隧穿响应呈现出与常规超导体不同的特征，这些特征可用于区分伊辛超导体的非常规配对结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。通过将单个磁性杂质作为超导凝聚体的局域探针，在伊辛自旋-轨道耦合和面内磁场存在下，分析Yu-Shiba-Rusinov束缚态的形成及其谱学性质。

papers.title: Activity enhances transport while competing interactions preserve structure in colloidal microphase formers
papers.abstract: Colloidal models with short-range attraction and long range repulsion (SALR) have been extensively studied using theoretical and simulations methods due to their rich and universal equilibrium phase behavior. Using Brownian Dynamics simulations, we study the dynamical phase behavior of active suspensions in which colloidal particles interact with each other via a SALR potential. Upon increasing the self-propulsion force of the particles, we observed that the structural transitions the active suspension undergoes resemble those observed in its passive counterpart by increasing the temperature of the thermal bath. However, when looking at the transport properties of active and passive suspensions with similar structure, we observed a clear mismatch. We demonstrated that increasing the activity enhances the particles mobility within the SALR fluid when simultaneously preserves the structure. This leads to a structure-dynamics decoupling induced by the activity whereas at the same time highlights the structural memory of SALR potentials under non-equilibrium conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Brownian Dynamics simulations、simulations methods。；研究对象：活性胶体悬浮液体系，其中胶体粒子通过短程吸引-长程排斥（SALR）势相互作用，研究其动力学相行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 增加活性（自推进力）可以增强SALR流体中粒子的迁移率，同时保持其结构不变，导致活性诱导的结构-动力学解耦，并凸显了非平衡条件下SALR势的结构记忆效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：增加活性（自推进力）可以增强SALR流体中粒子的迁移率，同时保持其结构不变，导致活性诱导的结构-动力学解耦，并凸显了非平衡条件下SALR势的结构记忆效应。；创新点：揭示了活性胶体体系在保持与被动体系相似结构的同时，其输运性质（粒子迁移率）与被动体系存在明显差异，即活性导致结构-动力学解耦。摘要未突出说明与已有活性SALR研究相比的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 布朗动力学（Brownian Dynamics）模拟。

papers.title: Negative Differential Resistance and Ultra-High TMR in Altermagnetic Tunnel Junctions
papers.abstract: Altermagnets can replace ferromagnets in tunnel junctions, yielding large tunneling magnetoresistance, ultrafast switching, and low-power functionality. While most studies explore the linear-response regime, interesting features emerge at finite bias, where the peculiar electronic structure of altermagnets gives rise to complex non-linear behaviour. Using non-equilibrium Green's functions implemented with density functional theory, we predict that a large low-bias negative differential resistance can be observed in an altermagnetic tunnel junction. Our proposed junction incorporates the orbital-ordered altermagnet KV2Se2O, whose quasi-2D Fermi surface plays a crucial role in realizing the negative differential resistance. Upon the application of a finite bias voltage, the current in the parallel configuration first increases sharply and then decreases, to be almost completely suppressed at around 0.14 V. At the same time, the antiparallel configuration displays a monotonic current-voltage curve. This behaviour, in addition to the negative differential resistance, supports a large tunneling magnetoresistance with sign inversion at 0.13 V. Our results suggest that altermagnetic tunnel junctions can be used as components in applications requiring strong non-linear response at low bias.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用非平衡格林函数结合密度泛函理论（NEGF+DFT）进行计算。；研究对象：交变磁隧道结，具体材料为轨道有序交变磁体 KV₂Se₂O，研究其有限偏压下的非线性输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交变磁隧道结中，平行磁化配置下实现了低偏压大负微分电阻，电流在约0.14 V时几乎完全抑制；同时反平行配置呈现单调电流-电压曲线，导致隧道磁电阻在0.13 V处发生符号反转并具有超高值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交变磁隧道结中，平行磁化配置下实现了低偏压大负微分电阻，电流在约0.14 V时几乎完全抑制；同时反平行配置呈现单调电流-电压曲线，导致隧道磁电阻在0.13 V处发生符号反转并具有超高值。；创新点：首次在交变磁隧道结中预测了低偏压下的显著负微分电阻效应，并发现伴随的隧道磁电阻符号反转现象，揭示了准二维费米面对该非线性行为的决定性作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）实现的非平衡格林函数（NEGF）方法，对交变磁隧道结的有限偏压输运性质进行第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Using a spin-triplet encoding to enhance shuttling fidelities in Si/SiGe quantum wells
papers.abstract: Spatial variations of the valley splitting in a quantum well present a key challenge for conveyor-mode shuttling of electron spins in Si/SiGe, giving rise to Landau-Zener-like excitations that cause leakage outside the qubit subspace. Here, we propose an unconventional two-electron qubit encoding, based on valley-singlet states, that is largely immune to Landau-Zener leakage processes. In contrast to single-electron spins, the shuttling fidelity actually improves for small valley splittings, in this case. We show that high fidelities can be achieved without applying any special procedures, such as fine-tuning of the shuttling path.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“propose”（提出）、“show”（展示）等理论论证性词汇，未提及实验或计算细节。；研究对象：Si/SiGe量子阱中基于自旋三重态编码的双电子量子比特，以及电子自旋的传送模式（conveyor-mode）输运过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于谷-单重态（valley-singlet）的双电子量子比特编码方式，可大幅抑制因谷分裂空间不均匀导致的Landau-Zener泄漏，且在小谷分裂条件下反而能获得更高的传送保真度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于谷-单重态（valley-singlet）的双电子量子比特编码方式，可大幅抑制因谷分裂空间不均匀导致的Landau-Zener泄漏，且在小谷分裂条件下反而能获得更高的传送保真度。；创新点：首次提出利用自旋三重态编码（而非传统单电子自旋编码）来规避Si/SiGe量子阱中谷分裂空间变化引起的退相干问题，并发现小谷分裂反而有利于提高传送保真度，无需精细调节传送路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与模型论证，具体涉及Landau-Zener激发过程的物理图像分析，以及基于谷-单重态编码的保真度评估。

papers.title: On-demand steering of hyperbolic chiral polaritons
papers.abstract: Control of light polarization and propagation in sub-wavelength architectures is foundational to nanophotonic technologies. A frontier direction is to leverage strong optical spin-orbit interactions to realize polarization-selective light steering, known as the photonic spin Hall effect. In this context, hyperbolic plasmon polaritons (HPPs) are of particular interest as they offer large optical spin-orbit coupling from strong confinement and dielectric anisotropy, as well as ray-like propagation. Despite theoretical predictions, however, the hyperbolic spin Hall effect in natural materials has remained elusive. Here, we demonstrate the hyperbolic spin Hall effect in the visible and near-infrared range in the natural hyperbolic van der Waals metal MoOCl2. Enabling this discovery is a novel far-field pump-probe microscope that facilitates the launching and imaging of HPPs with exceptional sensitivity through interference with a high-momentum reference field. This approach preserves excellent control over light polarization, overcoming a key barrier to polarization-selective interrogation of hyperbolic materials. We show that both hyperbolic and surface plasmons in MoOCl2 display chiral fields, and that their propagation direction can be completely switched upon light helicity reversal. Our results demonstrate on-demand steering of chiral plasmons, firmly establishing natural hyperbolic materials as ideal components for reconfigurable nanophotonics and chiral light-matter coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验发现（“demonstrate the hyperbolic spin Hall effect”）和使用的实验技术（“novel far-field pump-probe microscope”）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是天然双曲范德瓦尔斯金属 MoOCl₂，研究的物理现象是双曲等离激元中的手性自旋霍尔效应（hyperbolic spin Hall effect）以及手性等离激元的按需操控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在天然双曲材料 MoOCl₂ 中，实验观测到了可见光至近红外波段的双曲自旋霍尔效应，并实现了通过改变光手性来完全切换双曲等离激元和表面等离激元的传播方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在天然双曲材料 MoOCl₂ 中，实验观测到了可见光至近红外波段的双曲自旋霍尔效应，并实现了通过改变光手性来完全切换双曲等离激元和表面等离激元的传播方向。；创新点：首次在天然材料中实验证实了双曲自旋霍尔效应，并展示了通过光手性对双曲等离激元传播方向进行按需操控的能力，克服了此前对双曲材料进行偏振选择性探测的关键障碍。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段是一种新型的远场泵浦-探测显微镜。该技术通过将高动量参考场与样品信号进行干涉，实现了对双曲等离激元（HPPs）的高灵敏度激发和成像，并保持了对光偏振的精确控制。

papers.title: Direct-write electrochemical nanofabrication of ultrasmall graphene devices
papers.abstract: Graphene nano-ribbons, GNRs, are promising channel materials for next-generation ultra-miniaturised devices due to their exceptional electrical and thermal properties which arise from their atomic thickness, as well as their ability to have a size-dependent band-gap [1-9]. However, despite extensive efforts to reliably fabricate narrow GNR-based field-effect transistors [10-12], their integration into conventional transistor technologies remains hindered by challenges such as high fabrication costs and complex processing requirements [13, 14]. In this study, we present a direct-write, relatively low-cost and robust approach for fabricating sub-10 nm GNR-based FETs using electrochemical atomic force microscopy lithography with an alternating current (AC) bias, obviating the need for electrodes. We also explain the underlying electrochemical process and provide a model which can be used to describe it. Leveraging the high-precision positioning capability of AFM, this method enables precise nanoscale graphene patterning with feature sizes below 10nm. Compared with conventional lithographic techniques, photo- and electron-beam lithography i.e., PL & EBL, respectively [2, 15-20], it offers higher resolution, lower defect density, contamination-free processing, and the capability for in situ nanoscale device modification and characterisation. This work provides an efficient strategy for advancing GNR-based nanoelectronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：direct-write、electrochemical atomic force microscopy lithography、fabrication、characterisation。；研究对象：基于石墨烯纳米带（GNR）的场效应晶体管（FET），具体为亚10纳米尺度的超小型石墨烯器件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种利用交流偏压电化学原子力显微镜光刻技术直接书写制备亚10纳米GNR基FET的低成本、高精度方法，无需电极，且分辨率优于传统光刻和电子束光刻。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种利用交流偏压电化学原子力显微镜光刻技术直接书写制备亚10纳米GNR基FET的低成本、高精度方法，无需电极，且分辨率优于传统光刻和电子束光刻。；创新点：该方法无需电极即可实现直接书写，具有更高分辨率、更低缺陷密度、无污染加工以及原位纳米器件修饰与表征能力，克服了传统光刻和电子束光刻在GNR器件集成中的高成本和复杂工艺挑战。
papers.method_zh: 采用交流偏压电化学原子力显微镜光刻技术（electrochemical AFM lithography with AC bias）进行直接书写纳米加工，并结合AFM的高精度定位能力实现纳米级石墨烯图案化。同时通过实验和模型解释了其背后的电化学过程。

papers.title: Coupled Topological Interface States and Phonon Molecules in GaAs/AlAs Superlattices
papers.abstract: Topological interface states in one-dimensional superlattices provide spatially localized phonon modes protected by the topology of the underlying band structure. In GaAs/AlAs distributed Bragg reflectors (DBRs), such states can be engineered through band inversion between superlattices with opposite Zak phases within the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) framework. Here, we demonstrate topological phonon molecules and extended chains formed by coupled nanophononic interface states. By concatenating three superlattices with alternating topology, we realize two coupled interface states that hybridize into symmetric and antisymmetric modes, whose splitting can be tuned over tens of gigahertz by varying the reflectivity of the central DBR. Extending this concept, we engineer chains of up to N=6 coupled interface states that form narrow topological minibands while remaining strongly localized at the interfaces. We experimentally observe these coupled states in molecular-beam-epitaxy-grown GaAs/AlAs heterostructures using time-domain pump-probe transient reflectivity measurements, and reproduce their behavior using transfer-matrix calculations and a simple analytical model for the mode splitting. These results establish topological interface states as a robust platform for engineering coupled phononic systems and tunable nanophononic architectures in the GHz regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally observe”（实验观察）和“transfer-matrix calculations and a simple analytical model”（转移矩阵计算与解析模型）。；研究对象：GaAs/AlAs 超晶格中的拓扑界面态及其耦合形成的声子分子与链。具体体系为分子束外延生长的 GaAs/AlAs 分布式布拉格反射镜（DBR）异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将三个具有交替拓扑性质的超晶格串联，实现了两个耦合的拓扑界面态，它们杂化形成对称和反对称模式（即“声子分子”），其分裂可通过改变中心 DBR 的反射率在几十 GHz 范围内调谐。进一步扩展该概念，可构建由多达 6 个耦合界面态组成的链，形成窄的拓扑微带，同时保持界面处的强局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将三个具有交替拓扑性质的超晶格串联，实现了两个耦合的拓扑界面态，它们杂化形成对称和反对称模式（即“声子分子”），其分裂可通过改变中心 DBR 的反射率在几十 GHz 范围内调谐。进一步扩展该概念，可构建由多达 6 个耦合界面态组成的链，形成窄的拓扑微带，同时保持界面处的强局域化。；创新点：将 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）框架下的拓扑界面态从单个态扩展到耦合的“声子分子”和有限链，展示了在 GHz 频段通过拓扑保护实现可调谐纳米声子架构的鲁棒平台。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用分子束外延（MBE）生长样品，并使用时间域泵浦-探测瞬态反射率测量来观测耦合态。理论上采用转移矩阵计算和用于模式分裂的简单解析模型进行模拟与验证。

papers.title: Bridging perturbation and variational approaches in brittle fracture
papers.abstract: We present a variational reduced-order model for three-dimensional coplanar propagation of sharp cracks in heterogeneous perfectly brittle solids under mixed-mode I+II+III loading. The approach connects the variational fracture formulation of Francfort and Marigo (1998) and the perturbation theory of Rice (1985) by computing equilibrium crack-front configurations through minimization of the total energy defined as the sum of (i) the elastic potential energy, evaluated asymptotically from front deformations, and (ii) the dissipated energy, set by the fracture energy field. The potential energy and its derivatives are evaluated efficiently using the Fast Fourier Transform. The resulting nonconvex box-constrained minimization problem is solved with a matrix-free Newton conjugate gradient algorithm with a trust region and physics-based preconditioning, enforcing irreversibility while resolving energy barriers and long-range elastic interactions. We validate our implementation against newly derived analytical solutions. We then perform 116,000 large-scale simulations of tensile and shear crack propagation in disordered media to quantify the impact of finite-size effects, disorder intensity, and mode mixity. The simulations reproduce the transition from smooth to intermittent crack growth, and show that mode mixity has limited influence on the onset of intermittency but induces quasi-elliptic fronts in mixed II+III loading. They reveal a size-dependent crossover from disorder-induced weakening to toughening controlled by the emergence of depinning instabilities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“variational reduced-order model”、“minimization of the total energy”、“Fast Fourier Transform”、“Newton conjugate gradient algorithm”等数值计算和理论建模方法，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：三维共面扩展的尖锐裂纹在异质完美脆性固体中的传播行为，具体涉及混合I+II+III型加载下的裂纹前沿构型、有限尺寸效应、无序强度及模式混合度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模拟再现了从光滑裂纹扩展向间歇性裂纹扩展的转变，并发现模式混合度对间歇性起始影响有限，但在混合II+III加载下诱导出准椭圆裂纹前沿；同时揭示了从无序诱导的弱化到增韧的尺寸依赖交叉行为，该交叉由脱钉不稳定性控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模拟再现了从光滑裂纹扩展向间歇性裂纹扩展的转变，并发现模式混合度对间歇性起始影响有限，但在混合II+III加载下诱导出准椭圆裂纹前沿；同时揭示了从无序诱导的弱化到增韧的尺寸依赖交叉行为，该交叉由脱钉不稳定性控制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分降阶模型，将Francfort-Marigo变分断裂公式与Rice微扰理论结合，通过最小化总能量（弹性势能+耗散能）计算平衡裂纹前沿构型；弹性势能及其导数利用快速傅里叶变换高效评估；非凸箱约束最小化问题通过基于物理预条件的矩阵自由牛顿共轭梯度算法（带信赖域）求解，并强制执行不可逆性。共进行了116,000次大规模模拟。

papers.title: Lattice Gauging Interfaces and Noninvertible Defects in Higher Dimensions
papers.abstract: We study gauging interfaces and their defect descendants in lattice models with generalized symmetries in higher dimensions. We construct explicit interface Hamiltonians for gauging a $\mathbb Z_2^{(0)}$ symmetry in $(2+1)d$ and a $\mathbb Z_2^{(1)}$ symmetry in $(3+1)d$. In higher dimensions, and especially in the presence of higher-form symmetries, the topological nature of gauging interfaces is obscured by the fact that the constrained Hilbert space depends on the location of the interface. We resolve this by introducing movement operators acting on a common unconstrained Hilbert space, which transport both the interface Hamiltonians and the associated constraints. As applications, we analyze condensation defects obtained from finite-region gauging and reconstruct the gauging map from movement operators. Finally, we apply the same framework to subgroup gauging, focusing on the example of gauging $\mathbb Z_2\subset \mathbb Z_4$. This produces a dual symmetry carrying a mixed anomaly, which we diagnose on the lattice through symmetry fractionalization on condensation defects. Our results provide an explicit lattice framework for studying topological interfaces, condensation defects, and the associated anomalies arising from gauging in higher-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：lattice models, gauging interfaces, defect descendants, Hamiltonian construction。；研究对象：高维晶格模型中具有广义对称性的规范界面（gauging interfaces）及其缺陷后裔（defect descendants），具体包括(2+1)d中的$\mathbb Z_2^{(0)}$对称性和(3+1)d中的$\mathbb Z_2^{(1)}$对称性，以及$\mathbb Z_2\subset \mathbb Z_4$子群规范。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入作用于公共无约束希尔伯特空间的移动算子（movement operators），解决了高维规范界面拓扑性质因约束希尔伯特空间依赖于界面位置而模糊的问题，并利用该框架重构了规范映射、分析了凝聚缺陷（condensation defects）以及子群规范产生的混合反常。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入作用于公共无约束希尔伯特空间的移动算子（movement operators），解决了高维规范界面拓扑性质因约束希尔伯特空间依赖于界面位置而模糊的问题，并利用该框架重构了规范映射、分析了凝聚缺陷（condensation defects）以及子群规范产生的混合反常。；创新点：首次在高维晶格模型中为规范界面及其缺陷后裔提供了显式的哈密顿量框架，并通过移动算子统一处理了约束空间位置依赖性和规范映射重构问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造：显式构建了规范界面的哈密顿量；引入移动算子处理约束空间依赖性问题；应用有限区域规范（finite-region gauging）分析凝聚缺陷；通过凝聚缺陷上的对称性分数量子化（symmetry fractionalization）在晶格上诊断混合反常。

papers.title: The critical slowing down in diffusion models
papers.abstract: Computational sampling has been central to the sciences since the mid-20th century. While machine-learning-based approaches have recently enabled major advances, their behavior remains poorly understood, with limited theoretical control over when and why they succeed. Here we provide such insight for diffusion models-a class of generative schemes highly effective in practice-by analyzing their application to the $O(n)$ model of statistical field theory in the Gaussian limit $n \to \infty$. In this analytically tractable setting, we show that training a score model with a one-layer network architecture matching the exact solution exhibits a form of critical slowing down in parameter learning. This slowing down also impacts the generation process, indicating that the well-known difficulties of sampling near criticality persist even for learned generative models. To overcome this bottleneck, we demonstrate the power of combining architectural depth with physical locality. We find that using a two-layer architecture drastically reduces the critical slowing down, with the training time scaling logarithmically rather than quadratically with system size. By introducing a local score approximation we show that this acceleration in training time can be achieved without increasing the number of neural network parameters. Taken together, these results demonstrate that diffusion models can overcome the critical slowing down through appropriate architectural design, and establish a controlled framework for understanding and improving learned sampling methods in statistical physics and beyond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytically tractable setting、Gaussian limit、score model training、architectural design）；研究对象：扩散模型在统计场论O(n)模型（高斯极限n→∞）中的应用，以及临界点附近的采样困难问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扩散模型在训练得分模型时会出现临界慢化现象，但通过增加网络架构深度（如采用两层网络）并结合物理局域性，可以显著加速训练，使训练时间从随系统尺寸二次增长变为对数增长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扩散模型在训练得分模型时会出现临界慢化现象，但通过增加网络架构深度（如采用两层网络）并结合物理局域性，可以显著加速训练，使训练时间从随系统尺寸二次增长变为对数增长。；创新点：首次在可解析求解的统计场论模型中揭示了扩散模型训练过程中的临界慢化现象，并证明通过合理的架构设计（深度+局域性）可以克服这一瓶颈，为理解与改进基于学习的采样方法提供了可控的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：在O(n)模型的高斯极限（n→∞）下，使用单层网络架构训练得分模型，并对比两层网络架构；引入局域得分近似，在不增加神经网络参数数量的情况下实现加速。

papers.title: Incommensurate Spin-Density Waves in a Frustrated Maple-Leaf Lattice Ferromagnet
papers.abstract: We study how ferromagnetism breaks down in the spin-$\tfrac12$ nearest-neighbor Heisenberg model on the maple-leaf lattice with ferromagnetic $J_t,J_d$ and antiferromagnetic $J_h$, motivated by the mixed ferro-antiferromagnetic interactions in Na$_2$Mn$_3$O$_7$. Exact diagonalization shows that the ferromagnetic boundary does not feature a zero-field spin-nematic phase on the clusters studied here, but an extended regime of incommensurate spin-density-wave correlations with continuously evolving ordering vector. The phase diagram also contains collinear Néel, canted $120^\circ$, and hexagonal-singlet regimes, separated by regions that remain difficult to classify from exact diagonalization alone. Variational tests of fully symmetric Gutzwiller-projected Abrikosov-fermion U(1) and $\mathbb{Z}_2$ states find no competitive spin-liquid description of the interior unresolved regions. By contrast, on the ruby-lattice boundary we identify a point between the collinear Néel and hexagonal-singlet phases where a projected $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Ansatz reproduces the finite-size energy and spin correlations with good accuracy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Exact diagonalization（精确对角化）、Variational tests（变分检验）、Gutzwiller-projected Abrikosov-fermion states（Gutzwiller投影阿布里科索夫费米子态）。；研究对象：枫叶晶格（maple-leaf lattice）上自旋1/2的最近邻海森堡模型，受Na₂Mn₃O₇中混合铁磁-反铁磁相互作用的启发，研究铁磁性如何被破坏以及非公度自旋密度波等相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在研究的团簇上，铁磁边界并未出现零场自旋向列相，而是存在一个具有连续演化序矢量的非公度自旋密度波关联的扩展区域；全对称Gutzwiller投影的U(1)和Z₂态未能为内部未解析区域提供有竞争力的自旋液体描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在研究的团簇上，铁磁边界并未出现零场自旋向列相，而是存在一个具有连续演化序矢量的非公度自旋密度波关联的扩展区域；全对称Gutzwiller投影的U(1)和Z₂态未能为内部未解析区域提供有竞争力的自旋液体描述。；创新点：首次在枫叶晶格铁磁海森堡模型中系统刻画了铁磁边界附近的相图，排除了零场自旋向列相的存在，并指出非公度自旋密度波是铁磁失稳的主要表现；同时排除了内部未解析区域存在竞争性自旋液体的可能性。摘要未突出说明与已有枫叶晶格研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 精确对角化（Exact diagonalization）计算有限团簇的基态性质；变分检验（Variational tests）使用全对称Gutzwiller投影的阿布里科索夫费米子U(1)和Z₂ Ansätze。

papers.title: Coherent control of spinmons
papers.abstract: The protection of superconducting qubits from certain noise sources often comes at the cost of increased sensitivity to other decoherence channels. Here, we explore a route to avoid this tradeoff by encoding quantum information in quantum states of a transmon entangled with the spin of a trapped Andreev quasiparticle. We term such devices spinmons. We lift the spinmon Kramers degeneracy by introducing a Zeeman field and develop two routes for full qubit control via electrostatic gates and an AC flux drive, providing multiple directions for experimental implementations. Finally, we compute coherence times and verify the qubit robustness against flux and charge noise sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：explore, develop, compute, verify）；研究对象：一种新型量子器件“spinmon”，即transmon与束缚Andreev准粒子自旋纠缠的量子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入塞曼场解除spinmon的Kramers简并，并利用静电门控和AC磁通驱动实现全量子比特控制，同时验证了该器件对磁通噪声和电荷噪声的鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入塞曼场解除spinmon的Kramers简并，并利用静电门控和AC磁通驱动实现全量子比特控制，同时验证了该器件对磁通噪声和电荷噪声的鲁棒性。；创新点：提出一种避免超导量子比特在噪声保护与退相干通道之间权衡的新路径，即利用transmon与束缚Andreev准粒子自旋纠缠的混合态编码量子信息。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值计算：通过引入Zeeman场解除简并，设计静电门控和AC磁通驱动两种控制方案，并计算退相干时间以评估噪声鲁棒性。

papers.title: Reducing cross-sample prediction churn in scientific machine learning
papers.abstract: Scientific machine learning reports predictive performance. It does not report whether the same prediction would survive a different draw of training data. Across $9$ chemistry benchmarks, two classifiers trained on independent bootstraps of the same training set agree on aggregate accuracy to within $1.3\text{--}4.2$ percentage points but disagree on the class label of $8.0\text{--}21.8\%$ of test molecules. We call this gap \emph{cross-sample prediction churn}. The standard parameter-side techniques (deep ensembles, MC dropout, stochastic weight averaging) do not reduce this gap; two data-side methods do. The first is $K$-bootstrap bagging, which cuts the rate $40\text{--}54\%$ on every dataset at no accuracy cost ($K{\times}$-ERM compute). The second is \emph{twin-bootstrap}, our proposal: two networks trained jointly on independent bootstraps with a sym-KL consistency loss between their predictions, which at matched $2{\times}$-ERM compute reduces churn a further median $45\%$ beyond bagging-$K{=}2$. Cross-sample prediction churn deserves a column alongside predictive performance in scientific-ML benchmark reports, because without it the parameter-side and data-side methods are indistinguishable on the metric they actually differ on.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：scientific machine learning, classifiers, benchmarks, bootstraps, bagging, twin-bootstrap）；研究对象：科学机器学习中的分类器预测稳定性问题，具体以9个化学基准数据集上的分子分类任务为测试体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在科学机器学习中，两个独立训练的分类器在总体准确率上差异很小（1.3–4.2个百分点），但对8.0–21.8%的测试分子给出不同标签，这一“跨样本预测波动”无法通过参数侧方法（如深度集成、MC dropout、随机权重平均）降低，但可通过数据侧方法（K-自助袋装和提出的双自助法）显著抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在科学机器学习中，两个独立训练的分类器在总体准确率上差异很小（1.3–4.2个百分点），但对8.0–21.8%的测试分子给出不同标签，这一“跨样本预测波动”无法通过参数侧方法（如深度集成、MC dropout、随机权重平均）降低，但可通过数据侧方法（K-自助袋装和提出的双自助法）显著抑制。；创新点：首次明确提出并量化了科学机器学习中的“跨样本预测波动”问题，并发现参数侧方法对此无效，而数据侧方法（尤其是提出的双自助法）可在相同计算成本下进一步降低波动中位数45%。摘要建议将这一指标与预测性能并列纳入科学ML基准报告。
papers.method_zh: 使用自助法（bootstrap）生成独立训练数据子集，训练两个分类器并比较其预测一致性；采用K-自助袋装（K-bootstrap bagging）和提出的双自助法（twin-bootstrap，即两个网络在独立自助样本上联合训练，并加入对称KL散度一致性损失）进行对比实验。

papers.title: Berry-Phase-Induced Chirality in Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Geometric phases are foundational to isolated quantum systems, yet their thermodynamic role in open systems remains unrevealed Developing a dissipative adiabatic perturbation expansion, we discover a Berry-phase-induced chiral work difference that survives decoherence. This chirality evolves from an interferometric thermodynamic Aharonov-Bohm effect in the unitary regime to a fringe-free signal in the dissipative regime. We illustrate this framework in a two-level system and assess its experimental feasibility. Our findings clarify the role of quantum geometry in the geometric formulation of thermodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：developing a dissipative adiabatic perturbation expansion（发展耗散绝热微扰展开）、theoretical framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：开放量子系统中几何相位（Berry相位）的热力学效应，具体以两能级系统为例进行说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种由Berry相位诱导的手征性功差，该效应在退相干环境下依然存在，并从幺正体系中的干涉型热力学Aharonov-Bohm效应演变为耗散体系中的无条纹信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种由Berry相位诱导的手征性功差，该效应在退相干环境下依然存在，并从幺正体系中的干涉型热力学Aharonov-Bohm效应演变为耗散体系中的无条纹信号。；创新点：揭示了量子几何相位在开放系统热力学中的角色，特别是Berry相位诱导的手征性功差在退相干环境下的存活机制，将几何相位效应从孤立量子系统拓展到耗散热力学体系。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用耗散绝热微扰展开（dissipative adiabatic perturbation expansion）理论框架，结合两能级系统模型进行解析分析，并评估了实验可行性。

papers.title: Deep Learning as Neural Low-Degree Filtering: A Spectral Theory of Hierarchical Feature Learning
papers.abstract: Understanding how deep neural networks learn useful internal representations from data remains a central open problem in the theory of deep learning. We introduce Neural Low-Degree Filtering (Neural LoFi), a stylized limit of gradient-based training in which hierarchical feature learning becomes an explicit iterative spectral procedure. In this limit, the dynamics at each layer decouple: given the current representation, the next layer selects directions with maximal accessible low-degree correlation to the label. This yields a tractable surrogate mechanism for deep learning, together with a natural kernel-space interpretation. Neural LoFi provides a mathematically explicit framework for studying multi-layer feature learning beyond the lazy regime. It predicts how representations are selected layer by layer, explains how emergence of concepts arises with given sample complexity,and gives a concrete mechanism by which depth progressively constructs new features from old ones through low-degree compositionality. We complement the theory with mechanistic experiments on fully connected and convolutional architectures, showing that Neural LoFi improves over lazy random-feature baselines, recovers meaningful structured filters, and predicts representations aligned with early gradient-descent feature discovery with real datasets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算实验）。判断依据：introduce a stylized limit of gradient-based training、tractable surrogate mechanism、mechanistic experiments on fully connected and convolutional architectures。；研究对象：深度神经网络中的层级特征学习机制，具体为从数据中学习有用内部表示的谱理论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出神经低度滤波（Neural LoFi）框架，将层级特征学习显式化为迭代谱过程：每一层在当前表示中选择与标签具有最大可访问低度相关的方向，从而以数学显式的方式解释深度网络如何通过低度组合性逐步从旧特征构建新特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出神经低度滤波（Neural LoFi）框架，将层级特征学习显式化为迭代谱过程：每一层在当前表示中选择与标签具有最大可访问低度相关的方向，从而以数学显式的方式解释深度网络如何通过低度组合性逐步从旧特征构建新特征。；创新点：首次将深度网络中的层级特征学习建模为显式的迭代谱滤波过程（Neural LoFi），提供了超越惰性训练区域的可处理替代机制，并给出了特征逐层选择、概念涌现样本复杂度以及深度组合性构建新特征的具体数学框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：将梯度训练简化为Neural LoFi极限，使每层动力学解耦为谱选择过程；实验验证：在全连接和卷积架构上进行机制性实验，与惰性随机特征基线对比，并检验与真实数据集上早期梯度下降特征发现的一致性。

papers.title: Assessing foundational atomistic models for iron alloys under Earth's core conditions
papers.abstract: We assess the capability of recently developed foundational atomistic models (FAMs) to simulate iron alloys under the extreme pressures and temperatures of Earth's core. Static equations of state of hexagonal close-packed (hcp) and body-centered cubic (bcc) iron computed by 17 FAMs are benchmarked against ab initio calculations. Two representative models, MatterSim and MACE, are further evaluated for their ability to reproduce phonon spectra, liquid structure, and melting relations of iron at core conditions. While both models capture several key properties, MACE substantially overestimates the stability of bcc iron and fails to correctly describe the stability of hcp iron. Their performance is also examined for binary liquids, superionic phases, and a seven-component Fe-Ni-Si-S-O-H-C liquid. Although these FAMs were not explicitly trained on data from core conditions, they can reproduce several structural and dynamical properties across a wide range of compositions. However, none of the tested models consistently reproduces all first-principles benchmarks. By analyzing the origins of these discrepancies, we identify several limitations of current FAMs, particularly the lack of an explicit treatment of thermal electronic excitations, which significantly affect phase stability and thermodynamic properties under core conditions. We further discuss directions for improving FAMs to enable predictive simulations of core-forming materials under extreme conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：assess、benchmarked against ab initio calculations、evaluated、first-principles benchmarks。；研究对象：地球内核极端高温高压条件下的铁合金（包括纯铁、二元液体、超离子相及七组分Fe-Ni-Si-S-O-H-C液体）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当前最先进的几种基础原子模型（FAMs）虽能复现地球内核条件下铁合金的若干结构与动力学性质，但没有任何一个模型能一致地通过所有第一性原理基准测试；其中MACE模型严重高估了bcc铁的稳定性，且未能正确描述hcp铁的稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当前最先进的几种基础原子模型（FAMs）虽能复现地球内核条件下铁合金的若干结构与动力学性质，但没有任何一个模型能一致地通过所有第一性原理基准测试；其中MACE模型严重高估了bcc铁的稳定性，且未能正确描述hcp铁的稳定性。；创新点：系统评估了最新基础原子模型在地球内核极端条件下的适用性，并明确指出当前模型普遍缺乏对热电子激发的显式处理，这是导致相稳定性与热力学性质预测偏差的关键局限。
papers.method_zh: 使用17种基础原子模型（FAMs）计算六方密堆积（hcp）和体心立方（bcc）铁的静态状态方程，并与第一性原理计算结果进行基准对比；进一步选取MatterSim和MACE两个代表性模型，评估它们对声子谱、液态结构及熔化关系的复现能力；同时检验这些模型在二元液体、超离子相及七组分液体中的表现。

papers.title: Ghost State of Light
papers.abstract: We report the observation of a long-lived non-stationary state of light in a single-mode optical cavity. The observed state is a ghost of a saddle-node bifurcation which creates a bottleneck in phase space. While such ghosts are known to exist, accessing them is challenging because it requires a mechanism that steers the relaxation pathway away from the true attractor and into the bottleneck where the ghost emerges. Here we identify such a mechanism, namely a nonlinear response with memory. Our experimental system leverages this mechanism, enabling us to observe ghost states with lifetimes exceeding the cavity photon lifetime by more than ten orders of magnitude, even in the presence of strong fluctuations. The ghost manifests as a plateau in the relaxation dynamics of the cavity transmission, reminiscent of prethermalization. We show how the ghost lifetime depends on the memory time and the distance to the bifurcation, and we observe signatures of scaling in the distribution of ghost lifetimes at fixed driving conditions. Our work establishes minimal conditions for realizing parametrically long-lived non-stationary states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“report the observation”、“experimental system”、“observed state”。；研究对象：单模光学腔中的非稳态光，具体为鞍结分岔的“幽灵态”（ghost state）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验观测到一种寿命极长的非稳态光，其寿命可超过腔光子寿命十个数量级以上。该“幽灵态”源于相空间中的鞍结分岔瓶颈，其弛豫动力学呈现类似预热的平台特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验观测到一种寿命极长的非稳态光，其寿命可超过腔光子寿命十个数量级以上。该“幽灵态”源于相空间中的鞍结分岔瓶颈，其弛豫动力学呈现类似预热的平台特征。；创新点：首次实验观测到并系统研究了光学腔中由鞍结分岔产生的、具有超长寿命的“幽灵态”，并揭示了其寿命对记忆时间和分岔距离的依赖关系，建立了实现这种参数化长寿命非稳态的最小条件。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用具有记忆效应的非线性响应机制，将弛豫路径引导至鞍结分岔的瓶颈区域，从而观测到幽灵态。通过测量腔透射率的弛豫动力学来表征幽灵态。

papers.title: Universal Design and Physical Applications of Non-Uniform Cellular Automata on Translationally Invariant Lattices
papers.abstract: Lattice geometry profoundly shapes physical phenomena such as subsystem symmetry and directed percolation (DP). Among various lattice geometries, hyperbolic lattices are characterized by constant negative curvature and non-Abelian translation symmetry, offering a rich platform for investigating this geometry-physics interplay. However, the exponentially growing lattice size and nontrivial translation symmetry make approaches developed for Euclidean lattices incompatible, a limitation particularly evident in uniform cellular automata (CA). To resolve this, we develop a higher-order non-uniform cellular automata (NUCA) algorithm applicable to both translationally invariant regular Euclidean and hyperbolic lattices. In the algorithm, the non-uniform update rules incorporate nontrivial geometric data through a lattice-deforming procedure. We demonstrate the broad applicability of our algorithm to hyperbolic lattices through several applications on the hyperbolic $\{5,4\}$ lattice. By applying a linear NUCA, we generate subsystem symmetry-protected topological (SSPT) states and spontaneous subsystem symmetry-breaking states associated with regular or irregular subsystem symmetries unattainable on Euclidean lattices. We design the multi-point strange correlators to detect nontrivial SSPT states and derive a sufficient condition for non-Abelian translationally invariant NUCA-generated models. Furthermore, by generalizing the NUCA to non-uniform Clifford quantum cellular automata (CQCA), we generate subsystem symmetries of the hyperbolic cluster state, extending the established correspondence between translationally invariant CQCA and subsystem symmetries. Moreover, we simulate the DP process via a probabilistic NUCA that inherits the treelike structure of the lattice, and numerically estimate percolation thresholds and the phase diagram.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要涉及算法开发、理论推导（如子系统对称性、拓扑态生成、相图分析），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非均匀元胞自动机（NUCA）在平移不变格点（包括欧几里得格点和双曲格点）上的通用设计及其物理应用，具体以双曲{5,4}格点为平台，研究子系统对称性保护拓扑态（SSPT）、子系统对称性破缺态、双曲簇态的子对称性以及定向逾渗（DP）过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种适用于平移不变欧几里得和双曲格点的高阶非均匀元胞自动机算法，通过格点变形过程将非平凡几何数据纳入非均匀更新规则，从而在双曲格点上实现了欧几里得格点无法获得的规则或不规则子系统对称性，并模拟了定向逾渗过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种适用于平移不变欧几里得和双曲格点的高阶非均匀元胞自动机算法，通过格点变形过程将非平凡几何数据纳入非均匀更新规则，从而在双曲格点上实现了欧几里得格点无法获得的规则或不规则子系统对称性，并模拟了定向逾渗过程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 高阶非均匀元胞自动机（NUCA）算法，包括线性NUCA生成SSPT态、非均匀克利福德量子元胞自动机（CQCA）生成子系统对称性、概率性NUCA模拟定向逾渗过程，并采用多点奇异关联子检测非平凡SSPT态。

papers.title: In-situ tunable superconducting diode: towards field-free operation with infinite nonreciprocity
papers.abstract: Efficient, scalable, and magnetic-field-free superconducting diodes are essential for future superconducting electronics; yet, despite significant efforts, such practical devices remain unrealized. The main challenge lies in achieving broad-range in-situ tunability, both for optimization and for achieving transistor-like operation. Here, we study diodes based on four-terminal niobium planar Josephson junctions. We show that the multiterminal structure eliminates the need for an external magnetic field and enables essentially unrestricted in-situ tunability, along with reconfigurability of the diode polarity, leading to new functionality. For example, we demonstrate that such diodes can operate as Gauss neurons via reentrant superconductivity. By deliberately tuning the junction parameters, we obtain effectively infinite nonreciprocity (within experimental resolution) leading to threshold-free ac-current rectification. Such technologically simple, reconfigurable, and broadly tunable diodes could be instrumental for future digital and neuromorphic computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we study diodes based on four-terminal niobium planar Josephson junctions”以及“we demonstrate”等实验性表述。；研究对象：基于四端铌（niobium）平面约瑟夫森结的超导二极管，具体研究其无需外磁场、可原位调谐的非互易输运特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过多端结构实现了无需外磁场的超导二极管，并获得了实验分辨率内无限大的非互易性（即零阈值交流整流），同时实现了二极管极性的可重构和类晶体管操作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过多端结构实现了无需外磁场的超导二极管，并获得了实验分辨率内无限大的非互易性（即零阈值交流整流），同时实现了二极管极性的可重构和类晶体管操作。；创新点：首次在多端约瑟夫森结中实现了无需外磁场的宽范围原位可调谐性、极性可重构以及无限非互易性，并展示了其在数字计算和神经形态计算中的潜在应用。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备了四端铌平面约瑟夫森结，通过多端电极施加调控信号，测量其电流-电压特性及整流行为，并利用回滞超导现象实现高斯神经元功能。

papers.title: Acoustic Chirality
papers.abstract: We reveal a previously unknown continuous symmetry and conservation law in the equations of linear isotropic elasticity, which describe the chirality of elastic waves. We show that the integral chirality is determined by the population imbalance between right- and left-handed transverse phonons, whereas the local chirality density generally involves both transverse and longitudinal wave components. We also introduce the related concepts of acoustic helicity and ``false chirality''. The theory is illustrated with simple interference fields exhibiting distinct distributions of chirality, spin angular momentum, and false chirality. Our results establish chirality as a fundamental property of elastic waves and provide a general theoretical framework for chiral acoustic phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：reveal（揭示）、symmetry and conservation law（对称性与守恒律）、theoretical framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：线性各向同性弹性力学方程中的弹性波手性（chirality），具体涉及横波（横向声子）和纵波成分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了线性各向同性弹性力学方程中一个此前未知的连续对称性及其对应的守恒律，该守恒律描述了弹性波的手性。积分手性由左、右手性横向声子的布居数差决定，而局域手性密度通常同时涉及横波和纵波成分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了线性各向同性弹性力学方程中一个此前未知的连续对称性及其对应的守恒律，该守恒律描述了弹性波的手性。积分手性由左、右手性横向声子的布居数差决定，而局域手性密度通常同时涉及横波和纵波成分。；创新点：首次在弹性力学方程中识别出描述弹性波手性的连续对称性与守恒律，建立了手性作为弹性波基本属性的理论框架，并区分了真实手性与假手性。
papers.method_zh: 基于线性各向同性弹性力学方程进行理论推导，引入声学螺旋度（acoustic helicity）和“假手性”（false chirality）等概念，并通过简单干涉场进行理论示例说明。

papers.title: A hyperbolic cell cycle law for early embryonic developmental timing
papers.abstract: Across metazoans, early embryos exhibit a strikingly conserved slowing down of their cell duplication speed, despite widely varying developmental paces and underlying molecular mechanisms. Here we show that this common behavior arises because early development unfolds along a biochemical rather than a chronological timescale, resulting from the coupling of finite maternal resource consumption to the Michaelis-Menten-like kinetics governing the rates of the biochemical reactions involved in cell duplication. This leads to a hyperbolic growth of the Cell Cycle Length (CCL), approaching a mathematical singularity, which would correspond to developmental arrest. Data from a wide range of organisms -- cnidarians, nematodes, arthropods, molluscs, echinoderms, tunicates, amphibians, and fish -- collapse on a single curve, quantitatively capturing not only a universal CCL dynamical behaviour, but also key hallmarks of early metazoan development, including cell-number temporal evolution, the dependency of CCL on cell size, and, remarkably, gastrulation timing at the predicted singularity. Crucially, experimental modulation of resource availability and consumption rates validate the model and further demonstrate that a source of heterochrony in early development is an altered biochemical timescale of resource depletion. Overall, this work reveals resource consumption rates as a fundamental mechanism driving developmental timing in early embryogenesis across species.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合实验数据验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“show that this common behavior arises because...”，并基于Michaelis-Menten-like动力学建立模型，同时利用来自多个物种的实验数据对模型进行定量验证。；研究对象：早期胚胎发育过程中的细胞分裂时序调控。具体物理现象为：后生动物早期胚胎细胞周期长度（CCL）随发育进程呈现普遍性减慢的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 早期胚胎细胞周期长度遵循双曲线增长规律，并趋近于一个数学奇点（对应发育停滞）；该奇点恰好与原肠胚形成时间吻合。这一行为源于有限母体资源消耗与Michaelis-Menten类反应动力学的耦合，导致发育时序由生化时间尺度而非物理时间尺度主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：早期胚胎细胞周期长度遵循双曲线增长规律，并趋近于一个数学奇点（对应发育停滞）；该奇点恰好与原肠胚形成时间吻合。这一行为源于有限母体资源消耗与Michaelis-Menten类反应动力学的耦合，导致发育时序由生化时间尺度而非物理时间尺度主导。；创新点：首次揭示资源消耗速率是跨物种早期胚胎发育时序的通用驱动力，并证明原肠胚形成时间对应于细胞周期长度双曲线增长的理论奇点，从而将发育停滞的物理极限与关键形态发生事件定量关联。摘要未突出说明该模型是否适用于非后生动物或体外培养体系。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：将细胞分裂速率与母体资源消耗耦合，采用Michaelis-Menten动力学描述生化反应速率，推导出细胞周期长度的双曲线增长方程。实验验证：利用来自刺胞动物、线虫、节肢动物、软体动物、棘皮动物、尾索动物、两栖动物和鱼类等广泛物种的公开数据，将细胞周期长度、细胞数量时间演化、细胞大小依赖性等数据归一化到同一曲线；并通过实验调控资源可用性和消耗速率来检验模型预测。

papers.title: Onsager-variational formulation of diffuse-domain methods for computational modeling of microscale fluid-structure interactions
papers.abstract: Direct numerical simulation of microscale fluid--structure interactions in multicomponent and multiphase flows requires methods that can represent moving boundaries together with fields constrained to evolving interfaces. Diffuse-domain methods (DDMs) address this geometric difficulty by replacing sharp surfaces with diffuse volumetric representations on regular computational domains. Here we formulate DDMs using Onsager's variational principle. Instead of extending sharp-interface equations and boundary conditions term by term, we embed sharp-surface free-energy and dissipation functionals into the bulk through a diffuse surface delta density and derive the governing equations from the Rayleighian. The framework distinguishes balance-law fields, internal nonconserved order parameters, and kinematic or constitutive rate variables. It also clarifies a key moving-surface distinction: conserved surface densities are transported by the full material surface velocity, whereas explicitly tangential vector and tensor internal variables require projected objective or co-rotational rates within their admissible tangential state spaces. For scalar transport on rigid and deformable interfaces, and for interfacial hydrodynamics near rigid walls, the formulation recovers established DDM models and their sharp-interface limits. The same variational construction yields coupled diffuse-domain models for multicomponent deformable vesicles with surface viscosity, tangential slip, and finite areal compressibility, and for active shells carrying chemical and tangential vector order. These results provide a unified route to thermodynamically consistent passive DDMs for interfacial and surface dynamics, while allowing active stresses through active work power. The framework is relevant to soft matter, microfluidic interfaces, biological membranes, and morphogenetic surface dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“formulate”“derive”“framework”等理论构建词汇，核心是提出一种基于Onsager变分原理的数学框架，未涉及实验或具体数值计算。；研究对象：微尺度流体-结构相互作用，具体包括多组分/多相流中的移动边界、可变形囊泡（含表面粘度、切向滑移、有限面积可压缩性）、活性壳（含化学和切向矢量序参量）等软物质与生物膜体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将尖锐界面的自由能和耗散泛函嵌入体相（利用弥散表面delta密度），从Rayleighian出发推导出弥散域方法（DDM）的控制方程，并揭示了守恒表面密度与切向矢量/张量内变量在运动界面上的不同输运规律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将尖锐界面的自由能和耗散泛函嵌入体相（利用弥散表面delta密度），从Rayleighian出发推导出弥散域方法（DDM）的控制方程，并揭示了守恒表面密度与切向矢量/张量内变量在运动界面上的不同输运规律。；创新点：首次将Onsager变分原理系统性地应用于弥散域方法的构建，提供了热力学一致的统一推导路径，避免了逐项扩展尖锐界面方程和边界条件的传统做法，并自然推广到含表面粘度、切向滑移、活性应力的复杂界面动力学模型。
papers.method_zh: Onsager变分原理（Rayleighian最小化）作为理论框架，结合弥散域方法（DDM）的几何表示，对平衡律场、非守恒内序参量、运动学/本构速率变量进行分类处理，并引入投影客观率或共转率处理切向状态空间。

papers.title: Whitham modulation equations for the regularized Boussinesq equation with cubic nonlinearity
papers.abstract: A regularized Boussinesq equation is studied as a dispersive, long-wave (quasicontinuum) approximation of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam lattice with a general cubic interaction force. Explicit periodic traveling wave solutions in terms of Jacobi elliptic functions are classified, and their solitary-wave, kink, and trigonometric limits are obtained. The Whitham modulation equations describing slow modulations of periodic traveling wave solutions are derived using an averaged variational principle. The convexity (strict hyperbolicity, genuine nonlinearity) of the resulting hydrodynamic-type equations is examined numerically in general and analytically in the solitary-wave and harmonic limits. In particular, the loss of hyperbolicity and the formation of complex conjugate characteristic speeds is shown to lead to modulational instability of periodic traveling waves. The onset of modulational instability is verified by numerical computations of linearized spectra for periodic traveling waves and initial value problems that also reveal additional short-wave instabilities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Whitham modulation equations”、“averaged variational principle”、“numerical computations”等理论推导与数值分析关键词。；研究对象：具有一般三次非线性相互作用的Fermi-Pasta-Ulam（FPU）晶格的色散长波（准连续）近似，即正则化Boussinesq方程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了描述周期行波慢调制的Whitham调制方程，并发现周期行波会因双曲性丧失和复特征速度的形成而出现调制不稳定性，该不稳定性通过线性化谱和初值问题的数值计算得到验证，同时揭示了额外的短波不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了描述周期行波慢调制的Whitham调制方程，并发现周期行波会因双曲性丧失和复特征速度的形成而出现调制不稳定性，该不稳定性通过线性化谱和初值问题的数值计算得到验证，同时揭示了额外的短波不稳定性。；创新点：针对具有三次非线性的正则化Boussinesq方程，系统建立了Whitham调制理论，并首次通过数值手段揭示了该系统中调制不稳定性与短波不稳定性共存的现象。
papers.method_zh: 采用平均变分原理推导Whitham调制方程；利用Jacobi椭圆函数对周期行波解进行分类并求其孤立波、扭结和三角极限；通过数值方法检验所得流体力学型方程的凸性（严格双曲性、真正非线性），并计算线性化谱以验证调制不稳定性的发生。

papers.title: Empirical confirmation of bosonic wealth statistics in Bitcoin UTXOs
papers.abstract: Digitalisation transforms money from distinguishable physical objects into fungible informational units. A recent theoretical framework predicts that such indistinguishable wealth obeys bosonic occupancy statistics, leading to geometric ownership distributions and enhanced inequality. Using Bitcoin blockchain data, we test this prediction on 63 UTXO denominations across 72 monthly snapshots (2018--2023). A one-parameter geometric model describes the ownership distributions, reproducing both mean holdings and their temporal evolution; Jensen--Shannon divergence values lie below $0.08$ in $99.74\%$ of cases. The inferred inverse-temperature parameter satisfies the analytic mean--temperature relation to better than $0.1\%$ in every sample -- a self-consistency test that two-parameter alternatives cannot pass -- and remains within a narrow band across eight orders of magnitude in denomination and over six years. Bitcoin UTXO ownership statistics are therefore consistent with bosonic occupancy laws, suggesting that the informational nature of electronic money may act as a structural driver of inequality in digital economies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（基于区块链数据的实证分析）。判断依据关键词：empirical confirmation、test、Bitcoin blockchain data、monthly snapshots。；研究对象：比特币未花费交易输出（UTXO）的持有分布统计，具体研究数字财富（电子货币）在可区分性消失后是否遵循玻色子占据统计规律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 比特币UTXO的持有统计与玻色子占据定律一致，几何分布模型能精确描述不同面额UTXO的持有分布及其时间演化，且自洽性检验优于双参数模型。这表明电子货币的信息本质可能成为数字经济中不平等加剧的结构性驱动因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：比特币UTXO的持有统计与玻色子占据定律一致，几何分布模型能精确描述不同面额UTXO的持有分布及其时间演化，且自洽性检验优于双参数模型。这表明电子货币的信息本质可能成为数字经济中不平等加剧的结构性驱动因素。；创新点：首次通过真实区块链数据（比特币UTXO）实证验证了数字财富服从玻色子占据统计的理论预言，并提出了超越传统双参数模型的自洽性检验标准。摘要未突出说明与已有经济学不平等模型的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于比特币区块链数据，对63种UTXO面额在2018–2023年间72个月快照的持有分布进行统计分析。使用单参数几何分布模型拟合数据，计算Jensen–Shannon散度评估拟合优度，并通过反演逆温度参数验证解析的平均-温度关系（自洽性检验）。

papers.title: Purification of a monitored qubit: exact path-integral solution
papers.abstract: We investigate the purification dynamics of a single qubit under continuous in time monitoring. By employing a collisional model framework where the system interacts sequentially with ancillary qubits, we describe the conditioned evolution of the density matrix through a stochastic master equation. We show that for initial mixed states, the dynamics reduce to a multiplicative Langevin equation for a single scalar parameter representing the state's purity. This stochastic process is solved exactly using the Onsager-Machlup path integral formalism, allowing us to derive the full probability distribution for the qubit's trajectories. Our analytical results reveal that purification is characterized by a dynamical crossover from a diffusion dominated regime to a measurement dominated regime, visible in the emergence of a bimodal state distribution. The analytical solutions are in strong agreement with numerical simulations, providing a robust theoretical benchmark for the study of information extraction in monitored quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“exact path-integral solution”“stochastic master equation”“analytical results”等理论推导关键词。；研究对象：单个量子比特在连续时间监测下的纯化动力学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单量子比特的纯化过程存在从扩散主导到测量主导的动态交叉，表现为双峰态分布的出现；通过Onsager-Machlup路径积分方法可精确求解该随机过程的概率分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单量子比特的纯化过程存在从扩散主导到测量主导的动态交叉，表现为双峰态分布的出现；通过Onsager-Machlup路径积分方法可精确求解该随机过程的概率分布。；创新点：首次对连续监测下单量子比特纯化动力学给出精确路径积分解，揭示了纯化过程中的动态交叉行为及双峰分布特征，为受监测量子系统的信息提取提供了严格的理论基准。
papers.method_zh: 采用碰撞模型框架（系统与辅助量子比特顺序相互作用），通过随机主方程描述密度矩阵的条件演化；将动力学约化为单个标量参数（纯度）的乘法朗之万方程，并利用Onsager-Machlup路径积分形式进行精确求解。

papers.title: Visible-NIR-Frequency Hyperbolic Response in Nodal-Line Semimetal PbTaSe$_2$
papers.abstract: Natural hyperbolic materials offer a powerful platform for light-matter interactions by supporting highly anisotropic electromagnetic modes without the need for artificial patterning. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate that the nodal-line semimetal PbTaSe$_2$ exhibits robust hyperbolic optical behavior in the visible to near-infrared spectral range, which arises intrinsically from its anisotropic electronic structure and layered crystal symmetry. By combining first-principles calculations, ellipsometry, Drude-Lorentz modeling, and reflectance measurements, we establish a consistent experimental and theoretical picture of bulk hyperbolicity in this material. This hyperbolicity is of plasmonic origin and is characterized by a competitive quality factor ($Q_\mathrm{max} \approx 2.8$) and a very large anisotropy parameter ($|R| \approx 231$) at 0.78 eV.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据关键词：first-principles calculations, ellipsometry, Drude-Lorentz modeling, reflectance measurements。；研究对象：节点线半金属PbTaSe₂在可见光至近红外波段的本征双曲光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PbTaSe₂在可见-近红外波段表现出源于等离子体激元的稳健双曲光学行为，具有竞争性的品质因子（Q_max ≈ 2.8）和极大的各向异性参数（|R| ≈ 231 at 0.78 eV）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PbTaSe₂在可见-近红外波段表现出源于等离子体激元的稳健双曲光学行为，具有竞争性的品质因子（Q_max ≈ 2.8）和极大的各向异性参数（|R| ≈ 231 at 0.78 eV）。；创新点：首次在实验上证明节点线半金属PbTaSe₂在可见-近红外波段存在本征双曲光学响应，且该响应源于材料各向异性电子结构和层状晶体对称性，无需人工结构 patterning。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算、椭圆偏振光谱、Drude-Lorentz模型拟合、反射率测量。

papers.title: Different roles of quantum interference in a quantum dot photocell with two intermediate bands
papers.abstract: It is generally believed that quantum interference can improve the transport of photo-generated carriers in a photocell, thereby improve the photoelectric conversion efficiency. In this work, we explicitly explore different roles of quantum interferences in the photoelectric conversion efficiency in a quantum dot (QD) photocell with two intermediate bands. The increasing transition rates from different charge transport channels bring out first increasing, then decreasing, and then monotonically decreasing photoelectric conversion efficiencies. And the photoelectric conversions increase with quantum coherence generated by the upper transition rates owing to their robust quantum interference. However, the conversion efficiency decrease with the quantum interference induced by two lower-transition rates due to the shortened population lifetime in the intermediate bands. These results provide insight into different roles of quantum interferences in photoelectric conversion efficiency, and may provide some artificial strategies to achieve efficient photoelectric conversion via the adjusted quantum interferences in a QD photocell with multi-intermediate bands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“explicitly explore”“provide insight”等理论分析表述，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：具有两个中间带的量子点（QD）光电池体系，具体研究其中量子干涉对光生载流子输运及光电转换效率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子干涉在量子点光电池中扮演双重角色：由高能跃迁速率产生的量子相干性可增强光电转换效率，而由低能跃迁速率诱导的量子干涉因缩短中间带载流子寿命反而降低效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子干涉在量子点光电池中扮演双重角色：由高能跃迁速率产生的量子相干性可增强光电转换效率，而由低能跃迁速率诱导的量子干涉因缩短中间带载流子寿命反而降低效率。；创新点：揭示了同一体系中不同能级跃迁产生的量子干涉对光电转换效率具有相反作用，并指出可通过调控多中间带量子点光电池中的量子干涉来设计高效光电转换策略。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析，基于量子干涉对跃迁速率和量子相干性的调控，系统研究不同电荷输运通道对光电转换效率的影响趋势。

papers.title: Information Thermodynamics in Generalized Probabilistic Theories
papers.abstract: Generalized Probabilistic Theories (GPTs) provide a unified framework for describing probabilistic physical theories, encompassing classical and quantum theories as well as hypothetical theories beyond quantum mechanics. Since most GPTs are highly unrealistic and far removed from known physical theories, it is important to constrain them by physically reasonable principles. One of the most important such principles is consistency with thermodynamics, which has been extensively studied through toy models involving semipermeable membranes (SPMs) implementing measurements. On the other hand, information thermodynamics, which plays a central role in understanding the relationship between measurement and thermodynamics in classical and quantum theory, has remained largely undeveloped in GPTs. In this work, we construct information thermodynamics in GPTs and provide a unified framework for analyzing the relationship between measurement, feedback, information erasure, and the second law of thermodynamics. We also formulate a general framework for SPM models and analyze the thermodynamic cost of measurements implemented by SPMs. As a result, we show that no work can be extracted in contradiction with the second law as long as the measurement processes are consistent with entropy nondecrease, and derive sufficient conditions for this property for several entropy definitions proposed in GPTs. Moreover, by considering measurement processes violating these conditions, we construct explicit GPT systems realizing isothermal SPM cycles from which positive work can be extracted. These results demonstrate that violations of the second law can arise from the lack of fundamental entropy properties or discrepancies between entropy definitions, and provide a unified and model-independent foundation for understanding the relationship between thermodynamics and measurement in GPTs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Generalized Probabilistic Theories (GPTs)、unified framework、theoretical analysis、construct information thermodynamics。；研究对象：广义概率论（GPTs）框架下的信息热力学，特别是测量、反馈、信息擦除与热力学第二定律之间的关系，以及半透膜（SPM）模型中的测量热力学成本。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在GPTs中，只要测量过程与熵不减原理一致，就无法提取违反第二定律的功；反之，若测量过程违反该条件，则可构造出从等温SPM循环中提取正功的GPT系统，从而揭示第二定律的违反可能源于基本熵性质的缺失或不同熵定义之间的不一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在GPTs中，只要测量过程与熵不减原理一致，就无法提取违反第二定律的功；反之，若测量过程违反该条件，则可构造出从等温SPM循环中提取正功的GPT系统，从而揭示第二定律的违反可能源于基本熵性质的缺失或不同熵定义之间的不一致。；创新点：首次在广义概率论（GPTs）中系统构建信息热力学，为分析测量、反馈、信息擦除与第二定律的关系提供了统一且模型无关的基础，并揭示了不同熵定义之间的不一致性可能导致第二定律的表观违反。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义概率论（GPTs）作为统一理论框架，构建信息热力学；通过半透膜（SPM）模型分析测量过程的热力学成本；利用多种GPTs中提出的熵定义推导熵不减的充分条件。
